text: On frymðe wæs Word, and þæt Word wæs mid Gode, and God wæs þæt Word.
text_bare: On frymðe wæs Word, and þæt Word wæs mid Gode, and God wæs þæt Word.

text: Þæt wæs on fruman mid Gode.
text_bare: Þæt wæs on fruman mid Gode.

text: Ealle þing wǣron geworhte ðurh hyne; and nān þing næs geworht būtan him.
text_bare: Ealle þing wæron geworhte ðurh hyne; and nan þing næs geworht butan him.

text: Þæt wæs līf þe on him geworht wæs; and þæt līf wæs manna lēoht.
text_bare: Þæt wæs lif þe on him geworht wæs; and þæt lif wæs manna leoht.

text: And þæt lēoht lȳht on ðȳstrum; and þȳstro þæt ne genāmon.
text_bare: And þæt leoht lyht on ðystrum; and þystro þæt ne genamon.

text: Mann wæs fram Gode āsend, þæs nama wæs Iohannes.
text_bare: Mann wæs fram Gode asend, þæs nama wæs Iohannes.

text: Ðēs cōm tō gewitnesse, þæt hē gewitnesse cȳðde be ðām lēohte, þæt ealle menn þurh hyne gelȳfdon.
text_bare: Ðes com to gewitnesse, þæt he gewitnesse cyðde be ðam leohte, þæt ealle menn þurh hyne gelyfdon.

text: Næs hē lēoht, ac þæt hē gewitnesse forð bǣre be þām lēohte.
text_bare: Næs he leoht, ac þæt he gewitnesse forð bære be þam leohte.

text: Sōð lēoht wæs þæt onlȳht ǣlcne cumendne man on þisne middaneard.
text_bare: Soð leoht wæs þæt onlyht ælcne cumendne man on þisne middaneard.

text: Hē wæs on middanearde, and middaneard wæs geworht þurh hine, and middaneard hine ne gecnēow.
text_bare: He wæs on middanearde, and middaneard wæs geworht þurh hine, and middaneard hine ne gecneow.

text: Tō his āgenum he cōm, and hig hyne ne underfēngon.
text_bare: To his agenum he com, and hig hyne ne underfengon.

text: Sōðlice swā hwylce swā hyne underfēngon, hē sealde him anweald þæt hi wæron Godes bearn, þām ðe gelyfað on his naman:
text_bare: Soðlice swa hwylce swa hyne underfengon, he sealde him anweald þæt hi wæron Godes bearn, þam ðe gelyfað on his naman:

text: ðā ne synt ācennede of blōdum, nē of flǣsces willan, nē of weres willan, ac hig synt of Gode ācennede.
text_bare: ða ne synt acennede of blodum, ne of flæsces willan, ne of weres willan, ac hig synt of Gode acennede.

text: And þæt Word wæs flǣsc geworden, and eardode on ūs, and we gesāwon hys wuldor, swylce āncennedes wuldor of Fæder, þæt wæs ful mid gyfe and sōðfæstnysse.
text_bare: And þæt Word wæs flæsc geworden, and eardode on us, and we gesawon hys wuldor, swylce ancennedes wuldor of Fæder, þæt wæs ful mid gyfe and soðfæstnysse.

text: Iohannes cȳþ gewitnesse be him, and clypaþ þus cweðende, Þēs wæs þe ic sǣde, Sē ðe tō cumenne is æfter mē wæs geworden beforan mē, for ðām hē wæs ǣr þonne ic.
text_bare: Iohannes cyþ gewitnesse be him, and clypaþ þus cweðende, Þes wæs þe ic sæde, Se ðe to cumenne is æfter me wæs geworden beforan me, for ðam he wæs ær þonne ic.

text: And of his gefyllednesse wē ealle onfēngon gyfe for gyfe.
text_bare: And of his gefyllednesse we ealle onfengon gyfe for gyfe.

text: For þām þe ǣ wæs geseald þurh Moysen; and gyfu and sōþfæstnes is geworden þurh Hǣlend Crīst.
text_bare: For þam þe æ wæs geseald þurh Moysen; and gyfu and soþfæstnes is geworden þurh Hælend Crist.

text: Ne geseah nǣfre nān mann God, būtan sē āncenneda Sunu hit cȳðde, sē is on his Fæder bearme.
text_bare: Ne geseah næfre nan mann God, butan se ancenneda Sunu hit cyðde, se is on his Fæder bearme.

text: And þæt is Iohannes gewitnes:
text_bare: And þæt is Iohannes gewitnes:

text: Ðā þā Iudeas sendon hyra sācerdas and hyra dīaconas fram Ierusalem tō him þæt hī āxsodon hine and þus cwǣdon, Hwæt eart þū?
text_bare: Ða þa Iudeas sendon hyra sacerdas and hyra diaconas fram Ierusalem to him þæt hi axsodon hine and þus cwædon, Hwæt eart þu?

text: And hē cȳðde and ne wiðsōc, and þus cwæð, Ne eom ic nā Crīst.
text_bare: And he cyðde and ne wiðsoc, and þus cwæð, Ne eom ic na Crist.

text: And hig āxsodon hine and þus cwǣdon, Eart ðū Elias?
text_bare: And hig axsodon hine and þus cwædon, Eart ðu Elias?

text: And he cwæð, Ne eom ic hit.
text_bare: And he cwæð, Ne eom ic hit.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hī, Eart ðū wītega?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hi, Eart ðu witega?

text: And hē andwyrde and cwæð, Nic.
text_bare: And he andwyrde and cwæð, Nic.

text: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Hwæt eart þū?
text_bare: Hig cwædon to him, Hwæt eart þu?

text: þæt wē andwyrde bringon þām ðe ūs tō þē sendon.
text_bare: þæt we andwyrde bringon þam ðe us to þe sendon.

text: Hwæt segst þū be þē sylfum?
text_bare: Hwæt segst þu be þe sylfum?

text: Hē cwæð, Ic eom clypiendes stefn on wēstene, Gerihtað Drihtnes weg, swā sē witega Isaias cwæð.
text_bare: He cwæð, Ic eom clypiendes stefn on westene, Gerihtað Drihtnes weg, swa se witega Isaias cwæð.

text: And þā þe þær āsende wǣron, þā wǣron of sundorhālgon.
text_bare: And þa þe þær asende wæron, þa wæron of sundorhalgon.

text: And hig āxsodon hine and cwǣdon tō him, Hwī fullast þū, gif þū ne eart Crīst, nē Elias, nē wītega?
text_bare: And hig axsodon hine and cwædon to him, Hwi fullast þu, gif þu ne eart Crist, ne Elias, ne witega?

text: Iohannes him andswarode, Ic fullige on wætere; tōmiddes ēow stōd þe gē ne cunnon.
text_bare: Iohannes him andswarode, Ic fullige on wætere; tomiddes eow stod þe ge ne cunnon.

text: Hē is þe æfter mē tōweard is, sē wæs geworden beforan mē; ne eom ic wyrðe þæt ic unbinde his scēoþwang.
text_bare: He is þe æfter me toweard is, se wæs geworden beforan me; ne eom ic wyrðe þæt ic unbinde his sceoþwang.

text: Ðās ðing wǣron gewordene on Bethania begeondan Iordanen þǣr Iohannes fullode.
text_bare: Ðas ðing wæron gewordene on Bethania begeondan Iordanen þær Iohannes fullode.

text: Ōþre dæg Iohannes geseah þone Hǣlend tō him cumende, and cwæð, Hēr is Godes lamb; hēr is sē þe dēð aweg middaneardes synne.
text_bare: Oþre dæg Iohannes geseah þone Hælend to him cumende, and cwæð, Her is Godes lamb; her is se þe deð aweg middaneardes synne.

text: Þēs is be þām ic sēde, Æfter mē cymð wer þe mē beforan geworden wæs, for ðām þe hē wæs ǣr ðonne ic.
text_bare: Þes is be þam ic sede, Æfter me cymð wer þe me beforan geworden wæs, for ðam þe he wæs ær ðonne ic.

text: And ic hyne nyste; ac ic cōm and fullode on wætere tō ðǣm þæt hē wǣre geswutelud on Israhela folce.
text_bare: And ic hyne nyste; ac ic com and fullode on wætere to ðæm þæt he wære geswutelud on Israhela folce.

text: And Iohannes cȳþde gewitnesse cweðende, Þæt ic geseah nyðer cumendne Gāst of heofenum swā swā culfran, and wunode ofer hine.
text_bare: And Iohannes cyþde gewitnesse cweðende, Þæt ic geseah nyðer cumendne Gast of heofenum swa swa culfran, and wunode ofer hine.

text: And ic hine ne cūðe; ac sē þe mē sende tō fullianne on wætere, hē cwæð tō mē, Ofer þone þe ðū gesyhst nyðer stigendne Gāst and ofer hine wuniendne, þæt is sē ðe fullað on Hālgum Gāste.
text_bare: And ic hine ne cuðe; ac se þe me sende to fullianne on wætere, he cwæð to me, Ofer þone þe ðu gesyhst nyðer stigendne Gast and ofer hine wuniendne, þæt is se ðe fullað on Halgum Gaste.

text: And ic geseah, and gewitnesse cȳðde þæt þēs is Godes Sunu.
text_bare: And ic geseah, and gewitnesse cyðde þæt þes is Godes Sunu.

text: Eft ōðre dæg stōd Iohannes, and twēgen of his leorningcnihtum;
text_bare: Eft oðre dæg stod Iohannes, and twegen of his leorningcnihtum;

text: and hē cwæð, þā he geseah þone Hǣlend gangende, Hēr is Godes lamb.
text_bare: and he cwæð, þa he geseah þone Hælend gangende, Her is Godes lamb.

text: Ðā gehȳrdon hyne twēgen leorningcnihtas sprecende, and fylidon þām Hǣlende.
text_bare: Ða gehyrdon hyne twegen leorningcnihtas sprecende, and fylidon þam Hælende.

text: Þā beseah sē Hǣlend, and geseah hig him fyliende, and cwæð tō him, Hwæt sēce gyt?
text_bare: Þa beseah se Hælend, and geseah hig him fyliende, and cwæð to him, Hwæt sece gyt?

text: Hi cwǣdon to him, Rabbi, þæt is gecweden and gereht, Lārēow, hwār eardast ðū?
text_bare: Hi cwædon to him, Rabbi, þæt is gecweden and gereht, Lareow, hwar eardast ðu?

text: Hē cwǣþ tō him, Cumaþ and gesēoþ.
text_bare: He cwæþ to him, Cumaþ and geseoþ.

text: Hig cōmon and gesāwon hwār hē wunode, and mid him wunodon on ðām dæge; hit was þā sēo tēoðe tīd.
text_bare: Hig comon and gesawon hwar he wunode, and mid him wunodon on ðam dæge; hit was þa seo teoðe tid.

text: Andreas, Simones brōþur Petres, was ōþer of þām twām, þā gehȳrdon æt Iohanne, and him fyligdon.
text_bare: Andreas, Simones broþur Petres, was oþer of þam twam, þa gehyrdon æt Iohanne, and him fyligdon.

text: Ðēs gemētte ǣrost Simonem his brōðor, and cwæð tō him, Wē gemētton Messīam, þæt is gereht Crīst.
text_bare: Ðes gemette ærost Simonem his broðor, and cwæð to him, We gemetton Messiam, þæt is gereht Crist.

text: And hig lǣddon hine tō þām Hǣlende.
text_bare: And hig læddon hine to þam Hælende.

text: Ðā behēold sē Hǣlend hyne, and cwæþ, Þū eart Simon Ionan sunu; þu bist genemned Cephas, þæt is gereht, Petrus.
text_bare: Ða beheold se Hælend hyne, and cwæþ, Þu eart Simon Ionan sunu; þu bist genemned Cephas, þæt is gereht, Petrus.

text: On mergen hē wolde faran on Galilea, and hē gemētte Philippus; and sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Fylig mē.
text_bare: On mergen he wolde faran on Galilea, and he gemette Philippus; and se Hælend cwæð to him, Fylig me.

text: Sōþlīce Philippus was fram Bethzaida, Andreas ceastre and Petres.
text_bare: Soþlice Philippus was fram Bethzaida, Andreas ceastre and Petres.

text: Philippus gemētte Nathanael, and cwæþ tō him, Wē gemētton ðone Hǣlend, Iosepes sunu of Nazareth, þone wrāt Moyses and þā witegan on ðǣre ǣ.
text_bare: Philippus gemette Nathanael, and cwæþ to him, We gemetton ðone Hælend, Iosepes sunu of Nazareth, þone wrat Moyses and þa witegan on ðære æ.

text: And Nathanahel cwæð tō him, Mæg ǣnig þing gōdes bēon of Nazareth?
text_bare: And Nathanahel cwæð to him, Mæg ænig þing godes beon of Nazareth?

text: Philippus cwæð to him, Cum and geseoh.
text_bare: Philippus cwæð to him, Cum and geseoh.

text: Ðā geseah sē Hǣlend Nathanahel tō him cumendne, and cwæð be him, Hēr is Israhelisc wer, on ðām nis nān fācn.
text_bare: Ða geseah se Hælend Nathanahel to him cumendne, and cwæð be him, Her is Israhelisc wer, on ðam nis nan facn.

text: Ðā cwæð Nathanahel tō him, Hwanon cūðest ðū mē?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Nathanahel to him, Hwanon cuðest ðu me?

text: Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Ic geseah þē þā þū wāre under þām fīctreowe, ǣr ðām þe Philippus þē clypode.
text_bare: Þa andswarode se Hælend and cwæð to him, Ic geseah þe þa þu ware under þam fictreowe, ær ðam þe Philippus þe clypode.

text: Him andswarode þā Nathanahel and ðus cwæð, Rabbi, þū eart Godes Sunu, and þū eart Israhela cing.
text_bare: Him andswarode þa Nathanahel and ðus cwæð, Rabbi, þu eart Godes Sunu, and þu eart Israhela cing.

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Þū gesyhst māre þonne þis sȳ, for ðām þe þū gelȳfdest ðā ic cwæð þæt ic gesāwe þē under þām fīctrēowe.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend to him, Þu gesyhst mare þonne þis sy, for ðam þe þu gelyfdest ða ic cwæð þæt ic gesawe þe under þam fictreowe.

text: And hē sǣde him, Sōð ic secge ēow, Gē gesēoð opene heofonas, and Godes englas ūp stīgende and nyðer stīgende ofer mannes Sunu.
text_bare: And he sæde him, Soð ic secge eow, Ge geseoð opene heofonas, and Godes englas up stigende and nyðer stigende ofer mannes Sunu.

text: On þām þriddan dæge wǣron gyfta gewordene on Chanaa Galilee; and þæs Hǣlendes mōdor wæs þǣr.
text_bare: On þam þriddan dæge wæron gyfta gewordene on Chanaa Galilee; and þæs Hælendes modor wæs þær.

text: Sōþlīce sē Hǣlend and his leorningcnihtas wǣron gelaðode tō þām gyfton.
text_bare: Soþlice se Hælend and his leorningcnihtas wæron gelaðode to þam gyfton.

text: And þā þæt wīn getēorude, þā cwæð þæs Hǣlendes mōdor tō him, Hī nabbað wīn.
text_bare: And þa þæt win geteorude, þa cwæð þæs Hælendes modor to him, Hi nabbað win.

text: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Lā wif, hwæt is mē and þē?
text_bare: Þa cwæþ se Hælend to hyre, La wif, hwæt is me and þe?

text: gȳt mīn tīma ne cōm.
text_bare: gyt min tima ne com.

text: Ðā cwæð þæs Hǣlendes mōdor tō þām þēnum, Dōð swā hwæt swā hē ēow secge.
text_bare: Ða cwæð þæs Hælendes modor to þam þenum, Doð swa hwæt swa he eow secge.

text: Þǣr wǣron sōðlīce āset six stǣnene wæterfatu, æfter Iudea geclǣnsunge, ǣlc wæs on twēgra sestra gemete oððe on þrēora.
text_bare: Þær wæron soðlice aset six stænene wæterfatu, æfter Iudea geclænsunge, ælc wæs on twegra sestra gemete oððe on þreora.

text: Ðā bēad sē Hǣlend þæt hig þā fatu mid wætere gefyldon.
text_bare: Ða bead se Hælend þæt hig þa fatu mid wætere gefyldon.

text: And hig gefyldon þā oþ þone brerd.
text_bare: And hig gefyldon þa oþ þone brerd.

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Hladaþ nū, and berað þǣre drihte ealdre.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Hladaþ nu, and berað þære drihte ealdre.

text: And hī nāmon.
text_bare: And hi namon.

text: Ðā sē drihte-ealdor þæs wīnes onbyrigde þe of þām wætere geworden was, hē nyste hwanon hyt cōm, - þā þēnas sōðlice wiston þe þæt water hlōdon; sē drihte-ealdor clypode þone brȳdguman,
text_bare: Ða se drihte-ealdor þæs wines onbyrigde þe of þam wætere geworden was, he nyste hwanon hyt com, - þa þenas soðlice wiston þe þæt water hlodon; se drihte-ealdor clypode þone brydguman,

text: and cwæð tō him, Ǣlc man sylþ ǣrest gōd wīn, and þonne hig druncene bēoð, þæt þe wyrse byð; ðū gehēolde þæt gōde wīn oð þis.
text_bare: and cwæð to him, Ælc man sylþ ærest god win, and þonne hig druncene beoð, þæt þe wyrse byð; ðu geheolde þæt gode win oð þis.

text: Ðis wæs þæt forme tācn þe sē Hǣlend worhte on Chanaa Galilee, and geswutelode his wuldor; and his leorningcnihtas gelȳfdon on hine.
text_bare: Ðis wæs þæt forme tacn þe se Hælend worhte on Chanaa Galilee, and geswutelode his wuldor; and his leorningcnihtas gelyfdon on hine.

text: Æfter þyson he and hys mōdor and his gebrōðru and his leorningcnihtas fōron tō Capharnaum, and wunedon þār fēawa daga.
text_bare: Æfter þyson he and hys modor and his gebroðru and his leorningcnihtas foron to Capharnaum, and wunedon þar feawa daga.

text: And hit was nēah Iudea ēastron, and sē Hǣlend fōr tō Ierusalem,
text_bare: And hit was neah Iudea eastron, and se Hælend for to Ierusalem,

text: and gemētte on þām temple þā ðe sealdon oxan and scēap and culfran, and sittende myneteras.
text_bare: and gemette on þam temple þa ðe sealdon oxan and sceap and culfran, and sittende myneteras.

text: And hē worhte swipan of strengon, and hig ealle of ðām temple ādrāf, ge scēap ge oxan; and hē āgēat þāra mynetera feoh, and tōwearp hyra mȳsan;
text_bare: And he worhte swipan of strengon, and hig ealle of ðam temple adraf, ge sceap ge oxan; and he ageat þara mynetera feoh, and towearp hyra mysan;

text: and sǣde þām þe ðā culfran cȳpton, Dōð þās þing heonon; ne wyrce gē mīnes Fæder hūs tō mangunghūse.
text_bare: and sæde þam þe ða culfran cypton, Doð þas þing heonon; ne wyrce ge mines Fæder hus to mangunghuse.

text: Þā gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt ðe āwriten is, Þīnes hūses anda mē et.
text_bare: Þa gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt ðe awriten is, Þines huses anda me et.

text: Ðā andswaredon him þā Iudeas and cwǣdon, Hwylc tācn ætȳwst þū ūs, for ðām þe þū ðās ðing dēst?
text_bare: Ða andswaredon him þa Iudeas and cwædon, Hwylc tacn ætywst þu us, for ðam þe þu ðas ðing dest?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Tōwurpað þis tempel, and ic hit ārǣre binnan þrīm dagon.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Towurpað þis tempel, and ic hit arære binnan þrim dagon.

text: Ðā Iudeas cwǣdon tō him, Þis tempel wæs getimbrod on six and fēowertigon wintron, and ārǣrst þū hit on þrȳm dagon?
text_bare: Ða Iudeas cwædon to him, Þis tempel wæs getimbrod on six and feowertigon wintron, and arærst þu hit on þrym dagon?

text: Sōðlīce hē hyt cwæð be hys līchaman temple.
text_bare: Soðlice he hyt cwæð be hys lichaman temple.

text: Ðā hē of dēaðe ārās, þā gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt hē hit be him sylfum cwæð; and hī gelȳfdon hālegum gewrite and þǣre sprǣce þe sē Hǣlend spræc.
text_bare: Ða he of deaðe aras, þa gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt he hit be him sylfum cwæð; and hi gelyfdon halegum gewrite and þære spræce þe se Hælend spræc.

text: Ðā hē wæs on Ierusalem on ēastron ōn frēolsdæge, manega gelȳfdon on his naman, þā hī gesāwon ðā tācna þe hē worhte.
text_bare: Ða he wæs on Ierusalem on eastron on freolsdæge, manega gelyfdon on his naman, þa hi gesawon ða tacna þe he worhte.

text: Sē Hǣlend ne geswutelode hine sylfne him, for ðām hē cūðe hī ealle,
text_bare: Se Hælend ne geswutelode hine sylfne him, for ðam he cuðe hi ealle,

text: and for þām him næs nān þearf þæt ǣnig man sǣde gewitnesse be men; hē wiste witodlīce hwat wæs on men.
text_bare: and for þam him næs nan þearf þæt ænig man sæde gewitnesse be men; he wiste witodlice hwat wæs on men.

text: Sōðlīce sum Phariseisc man wæs genemned Nichodemus, sē wæs Iudea ealdor.
text_bare: Soðlice sum Phariseisc man wæs genemned Nichodemus, se wæs Iudea ealdor.

text: Ðēs cōm tō him on niht, and cwæð tō him, Rabbī, þæt is, Lārēow, wē witon þæt þū cōme fram Gode; ne mæg nān man þās tācn wyrcan þe ðū wyrcst, būton God bēo mid him.
text_bare: Ðes com to him on niht, and cwæð to him, Rabbi, þæt is, Lareow, we witon þæt þu come fram Gode; ne mæg nan man þas tacn wyrcan þe ðu wyrcst, buton God beo mid him.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōð ic þē secge, Būton hwā bēo ednīwan gecenned, ne mæg hē gesēon Godes rīce.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Soð ic þe secge, Buton hwa beo edniwan gecenned, ne mæg he geseon Godes rice.

text: Ðā cwæð Nichodemus tō him, Hū mæg man bēon eft ācenned þonne hē bið eald?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Nichodemus to him, Hu mæg man beon eft acenned þonne he bið eald?

text: Cwyst ðū mæg hē eft cuman on his mōdor innoð and bēon eft ācenned?
text_bare: Cwyst ðu mæg he eft cuman on his modor innoð and beon eft acenned?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic þē secge, Būton hwā bēo geedcenned of wætere and of Hāligum Gāste, ne mæg hē in faran on Godes rīce.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Soþ ic þe secge, Buton hwa beo geedcenned of wætere and of Haligum Gaste, ne mæg he in faran on Godes rice.

text: Ðæt þe ācenned is of flǣsce þæt is flǣsc; and þæt þe of Gāste is ācenned þæt is gāst.
text_bare: Ðæt þe acenned is of flæsce þæt is flæsc; and þæt þe of Gaste is acenned þæt is gast.

text: Ne wundra þū for ðām þe ic sǣde þē, Ēow gebyrað þæt gē bēon ācennede ednīwan.
text_bare: Ne wundra þu for ðam þe ic sæde þe, Eow gebyrað þæt ge beon acennede edniwan.

text: Gāst oreðað þār hē wile, and þū gehȳrst his stefne, and þū nāst hwanon hē cymþ, nē hwyder hē gǣþ; swā is ǣlc þe ācenned is of Gāste.
text_bare: Gast oreðað þar he wile, and þu gehyrst his stefne, and þu nast hwanon he cymþ, ne hwyder he gæþ; swa is ælc þe acenned is of Gaste.

text: Ðā andswarode Nichodemus and cwæð, Hu magon þās þing þus geweorðan?
text_bare: Ða andswarode Nichodemus and cwæð, Hu magon þas þing þus geweorðan?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him, Ðu eart lārēow Israhela folce, and þū nāst þās ðing?
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarode and cwæð to him, Ðu eart lareow Israhela folce, and þu nast þas ðing?

text: Sōþ ic þē secge, þæt wē sprecað þæt wē witon, and we cȳðað þæt wē gesāwon; and gē ne underfōð ūre cȳðnesse.
text_bare: Soþ ic þe secge, þæt we sprecað þæt we witon, and we cyðað þæt we gesawon; and ge ne underfoð ure cyðnesse.

text: Gif ic ēow eorþlīce þing sǣde, and gē ne gelȳfað, hūmeta gelȳfe gē gif ic ēow heofonlīce þing secge?
text_bare: Gif ic eow eorþlice þing sæde, and ge ne gelyfað, humeta gelyfe ge gif ic eow heofonlice þing secge?

text: And nān man ne āstīhð tō heofenum, būton sē ðe nyðer cōm of heofonum, mannes Sunu sē ðe cōm of heofonum.
text_bare: And nan man ne astihð to heofenum, buton se ðe nyðer com of heofonum, mannes Sunu se ðe com of heofonum.

text: And swā swā Moyses þā nǣddran ūp āhōf on þām wēstene, swā gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu bēo ūp āhafen:
text_bare: And swa swa Moyses þa næddran up ahof on þam westene, swa gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu beo up ahafen:

text: Þæt nān þāra ne forwurðe þe on hyne gelyfð, ac hæbbe þæt ēce līf.
text_bare: Þæt nan þara ne forwurðe þe on hyne gelyfð, ac hæbbe þæt ece lif.

text: God lufode middaneard swā þæt hē sealde his āncennedan Sunu, þæt nān ne forwurðe þe on hine gelȳfð, ac hæbbe þæt ēce līf.
text_bare: God lufode middaneard swa þæt he sealde his ancennedan Sunu, þæt nan ne forwurðe þe on hine gelyfð, ac hæbbe þæt ece lif.

text: Ne sende God his Sunu on middanearde þæt hē dēmde middanearde, ac þæt middaneard sȳ gehǣled þurh hine.
text_bare: Ne sende God his Sunu on middanearde þæt he demde middanearde, ac þæt middaneard sy gehæled þurh hine.

text: Ne biþ þām gedēmed ðe on hine gelȳfð; sē ðe ne gelȳfð, him biþ gedēmed, for þām þe hē ne gelȳfde on ðone naman þæs āncennedan Godes Suna.
text_bare: Ne biþ þam gedemed ðe on hine gelyfð; se ðe ne gelyfð, him biþ gedemed, for þam þe he ne gelyfde on ðone naman þæs ancennedan Godes Suna.

text: Þæt is sē dōm, þæt lēoht cōm on middaneard, and menn lufedon þȳstro swȳþor ðonne þæt lēoht: hyra weorc wǣron yfele.
text_bare: Þæt is se dom, þæt leoht com on middaneard, and menn lufedon þystro swyþor ðonne þæt leoht: hyra weorc wæron yfele.

text: Ælc ðāra þe yfele dēð hatað þæt lēoht, and hē ne cymþ to lēohte, þæt his weorc ne sȳn gerihtlǣhte.
text_bare: Ælc ðara þe yfele deð hatað þæt leoht, and he ne cymþ to leohte, þæt his weorc ne syn gerihtlæhte.

text: Witodlīce sē ðe wyrcð sōðfæstnesse cymp tō ðām lēohte, þæt his weorc sȳn geswutelude, for ðām þe hig synt on Gode gedōne.
text_bare: Witodlice se ðe wyrcð soðfæstnesse cymp to ðam leohte, þæt his weorc syn geswutelude, for ðam þe hig synt on Gode gedone.

text: Æfter þyson cōm sē Hǣlend and his leorningcnihtas tō Iudea lande, and wunode ðǣr mid him, and fullode.
text_bare: Æfter þyson com se Hælend and his leorningcnihtas to Iudea lande, and wunode ðær mid him, and fullode.

text: And Iohannes fullode on Enon wið Salim, for ðām þe þǣr wǣron manega wætro; and hī tōgædere cōmun, and wǣron gefullode.
text_bare: And Iohannes fullode on Enon wið Salim, for ðam þe þær wæron manega wætro; and hi togædere comun, and wæron gefullode.

text: Ðā gȳt næs Iohannes gedōn on cweartern.
text_bare: Ða gyt næs Iohannes gedon on cweartern.

text: Þā smēadon Iohannes leorningcnihtas and þā Iudeas be þǣre clǣnsunge,
text_bare: Þa smeadon Iohannes leorningcnihtas and þa Iudeas be þære clænsunge,

text: and cōmon tō Iohanne, and cwǣdon tō him, Rabbī, sē ðe mid þē was begeondan Iordane, be ðām þū cȳðdest gewitnesse, nū hē fullaþ, and ealle hig cumaþ tō him.
text_bare: and comon to Iohanne, and cwædon to him, Rabbi, se ðe mid þe was begeondan Iordane, be ðam þu cyðdest gewitnesse, nu he fullaþ, and ealle hig cumaþ to him.

text: Iohannes andwurde and cwæð, Ne mæg mann nān þing underfōn, būton hit bēo him of heofonum geseald.
text_bare: Iohannes andwurde and cwæð, Ne mæg mann nan þing underfon, buton hit beo him of heofonum geseald.

text: Gē sylfe mē synd tō gewitnesse þæt ic sǣde, Ne eom ic Crīst, ac ic eom āsend beforan hine.
text_bare: Ge sylfe me synd to gewitnesse þæt ic sæde, Ne eom ic Crist, ac ic eom asend beforan hine.

text: Sē ðe brȳde hæfð sē is brȳdguma; sē þe is þæs brȳdguman frēond and stent and gehȳrþ hyne, mid gefēan he geblissað for þæs brȳdguman stefne: þēs mīn gefēa is gefylled.
text_bare: Se ðe bryde hæfð se is brydguma; se þe is þæs brydguman freond and stent and gehyrþ hyne, mid gefean he geblissað for þæs brydguman stefne: þes min gefea is gefylled.

text: Hit gebyrað þæt hē weaxe, and þæt ic wanige.
text_bare: Hit gebyrað þæt he weaxe, and þæt ic wanige.

text: Sē ðe ufenan cōm sē is ofer ealle; sē þe of eorðan is sē sprycþ be eorðan; sē þe of heofone cōm sē is ofer ealle.
text_bare: Se ðe ufenan com se is ofer ealle; se þe of eorðan is se sprycþ be eorðan; se þe of heofone com se is ofer ealle.

text: And hē cȳð þæt hē geseah and gehȳrde, and nān man ne underfēhð his cȳðnesse.
text_bare: And he cyð þæt he geseah and gehyrde, and nan man ne underfehð his cyðnesse.

text: Sōðlīce sē þe his cȳðnesse underfēhþ, hē getācnað þæt God is sōðfæstnys.
text_bare: Soðlice se þe his cyðnesse underfehþ, he getacnað þæt God is soðfæstnys.

text: Sē ðe God sende sprycð Godes word; ne sylþ God þone Gāst be gemete.
text_bare: Se ðe God sende sprycð Godes word; ne sylþ God þone Gast be gemete.

text: Fæder lufað þone Sunu, and sealde ealle þing on his hand.
text_bare: Fæder lufað þone Sunu, and sealde ealle þing on his hand.

text: Sē þe gelȳfð on Sunu sē hæfð ēce līf; sē þe þām Suna is ungelēafsum ne gesyhþ hē līf, ac Godes yrre wunað ofer hine.
text_bare: Se þe gelyfð on Sunu se hæfð ece lif; se þe þam Suna is ungeleafsum ne gesyhþ he lif, ac Godes yrre wunað ofer hine.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend wyste þæt þā Pharisei gehȳrdon þæt hē hæfde mā leorningcnihta þonne Iohannes, -
text_bare: Ða se Hælend wyste þæt þa Pharisei gehyrdon þæt he hæfde ma leorningcnihta þonne Iohannes, -

text: þēah sē Hǣlend ne fullode, ac his leorningcnihtas, -
text_bare: þeah se Hælend ne fullode, ac his leorningcnihtas, -

text: ðā forlēt hē Iudea land, and fōr eft on Galilea.
text_bare: ða forlet he Iudea land, and for eft on Galilea.

text: Him gebyrode þæt hē sceolde faran þurh Samaria land.
text_bare: Him gebyrode þæt he sceolde faran þurh Samaria land.

text: Witodlīce hē cōm on Samarian ceastre, þe is genemned Sichar, nēah þām tūne þe Iacob sealde Iosepe his suna;
text_bare: Witodlice he com on Samarian ceastre, þe is genemned Sichar, neah þam tune þe Iacob sealde Iosepe his suna;

text: þǣr wæs Iacobes wyl.
text_bare: þær wæs Iacobes wyl.

text: Sē Hǣlend sæt æt ðām wylle, þā hē wæs wērig gegān; and hit wæs middæg.
text_bare: Se Hælend sæt æt ðam wylle, þa he wæs werig gegan; and hit wæs middæg.

text: Þā cōm þǣr ān wif of Samaria, wolde wæter feccan; ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Syle mē drincan.
text_bare: Þa com þær an wif of Samaria, wolde wæter feccan; ða cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Syle me drincan.

text: His leorningcnihtas fērdon þā tō þǣre ceastre, woldon him mete bicgan.
text_bare: His leorningcnihtas ferdon þa to þære ceastre, woldon him mete bicgan.

text: Þā cwæð þæt Samaritanisce wīf tō him, Hūmeta bitst þū æt mē drincan, þonne ðū eart Iudeisc, and ic eom Samaritanisc wīf?
text_bare: Þa cwæð þæt Samaritanisce wif to him, Humeta bitst þu æt me drincan, þonne ðu eart Iudeisc, and ic eom Samaritanisc wif?

text: ne brūcað Iudeas and Samaritanisce metes ætgædere.
text_bare: ne brucað Iudeas and Samaritanisce metes ætgædere.

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō hyre, Gif þū wistest Godes gyfe, and hwæt sē is þe cwið tō þē, Syle me drincan, witodlīce þū bǣde hine þæt hē sealde þē līfes wæter.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend and cwæð to hyre, Gif þu wistest Godes gyfe, and hwæt se is þe cwið to þe, Syle me drincan, witodlice þu bæde hine þæt he sealde þe lifes wæter.

text: Ðā cwæð þæt wīf tō him, Lēof, ne ðū næfst nān þing mid tō hladanne, and þēs pyt is dēop; hwanon hæfst þū līfes wæter?
text_bare: Ða cwæð þæt wif to him, Leof, ne ðu næfst nan þing mid to hladanne, and þes pyt is deop; hwanon hæfst þu lifes wæter?

text: Cwyst ðū þæt þū sī mǣrra þonne ūre fæder Iacob, sē ðe ūs þisne þytt sealde, and hē and his bearn and his nȳtenu of ðām druncon?
text_bare: Cwyst ðu þæt þu si mærra þonne ure fæder Iacob, se ðe us þisne þytt sealde, and he and his bearn and his nytenu of ðam druncon?

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæþ tō hyre, Ǣlcne ðāra þyrst eft þe of ðyson wætere drincð;
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend and cwæþ to hyre, Ælcne ðara þyrst eft þe of ðyson wætere drincð;

text: witodlīce ǣlc þāra þe drincð of þām wætere þe ic him sylle...
text_bare: witodlice ælc þara þe drincð of þam wætere þe ic him sylle...

text: bið on him will forð rǣsendes wætres on ēce līf.
text_bare: bið on him will forð ræsendes wætres on ece lif.

text: Ðā cwæþ þæt wīf tō him, Hlāford, syle mē þæt water þæt mē ne þyrste, nē ic ne ðurfe hēr feccan.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ þæt wif to him, Hlaford, syle me þæt water þæt me ne þyrste, ne ic ne ðurfe her feccan.

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Ga, clypa þīnne ceorl, and cum hider.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to hyre, Ga, clypa þinne ceorl, and cum hider.

text: Ðā andwurde þæt wīf and cwæð, Næbbe ic nānne ceorl.
text_bare: Ða andwurde þæt wif and cwæð, Næbbe ic nanne ceorl.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend to hyre, Wel þū cwǣde þæt þū næfst ceorl;
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Wel þu cwæde þæt þu næfst ceorl;

text: witodlīce þū hæfdest fīf ceorlas, and sē ðe ðū nū hæfst nis ðīn ceorl; æt þām þū sǣdest sōð.
text_bare: witodlice þu hæfdest fif ceorlas, and se ðe ðu nu hæfst nis ðin ceorl; æt þam þu sædest soð.

text: Ðā cwæð þæt wīf tō him, Lēof, þæs mē ðyncð þū eart wītega.
text_bare: Ða cwæð þæt wif to him, Leof, þæs me ðyncð þu eart witega.

text: Ūre fæderas hig gebǣdon on þissere dūne, and gē secgað þæt on Ierusalem sȳ sēo stōw þæt man on gebidde.
text_bare: Ure fæderas hig gebædon on þissere dune, and ge secgað þæt on Ierusalem sy seo stow þæt man on gebidde.

text: Ðā cwad sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Lā wif, gelȳf mē, þæt sēo tīd cymð þonne gē ne gebiddaþ Fæder nē on þisse dūne nē on Ierusalem.
text_bare: Ða cwad se Hælend to hyre, La wif, gelyf me, þæt seo tid cymð þonne ge ne gebiddaþ Fæder ne on þisse dune ne on Ierusalem.

text: Gē gebiddað þæt gē nyton; we gebiddaþ þæt wē witon; for þām þe hǣl is of Iudeum.
text_bare: Ge gebiddað þæt ge nyton; we gebiddaþ þæt we witon; for þam þe hæl is of Iudeum.

text: Ac seo tid cymð, and nū is, þonne sōþe gebedmen gebiddaþ Fæder on gāste and on sōðfæstnesse; witodlīce Fæder sēcþ swylce þe hyne gebiddon.
text_bare: Ac seo tid cymð, and nu is, þonne soþe gebedmen gebiddaþ Fæder on gaste and on soðfæstnesse; witodlice Fæder secþ swylce þe hyne gebiddon.

text: Gāst is God; and þām þe hyne gebiddað gebyrað þæt hig gebiddon on gāste and on sōðfæstnesse.
text_bare: Gast is God; and þam þe hyne gebiddað gebyrað þæt hig gebiddon on gaste and on soðfæstnesse.

text: Ðæt wīf cwæþ tō him, Ic wāt þæt Messīas cymð þe is genemned Crīst; þonne hē cymð, hē cȳð ūs ealle ðing.
text_bare: Ðæt wif cwæþ to him, Ic wat þæt Messias cymð þe is genemned Crist; þonne he cymð, he cyð us ealle ðing.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Ic hit eom þe wið þē sprece.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to hyre, Ic hit eom þe wið þe sprece.

text: And þǣrrihte cōmon his leorningcnihtas, and hig wundredon þæt hē wiþ þæt wīf spræc; þēah hyra nān ne cwæð, Hwæt sēcst þū?
text_bare: And þærrihte comon his leorningcnihtas, and hig wundredon þæt he wiþ þæt wif spræc; þeah hyra nan ne cwæð, Hwæt secst þu?

text: oððe, Hwæt sprycst þū wið hig?
text_bare: oððe, Hwæt sprycst þu wið hig?

text: Witodlice þæt wīf forlēt hyre wæterfæt, and ēode tō þǣre byrig, and cwæð tō þām mannum, .
text_bare: Witodlice þæt wif forlet hyre wæterfæt, and eode to þære byrig, and cwæð to þam mannum, .

text: Cumað and gesēoð þone man þe mē sǣde ealle þā þing þe ic dyde; cweðe gē is hē Crīst?
text_bare: Cumað and geseoð þone man þe me sæde ealle þa þing þe ic dyde; cweðe ge is he Crist?

text: Ðā ēodon hī ūt of ðǣre byrig, and cōmon tō him.
text_bare: Ða eodon hi ut of ðære byrig, and comon to him.

text: Ongemang þām his leorningcnihtas hine bǣdon, and þus cwǣdon, Lārēow, et.
text_bare: Ongemang þam his leorningcnihtas hine bædon, and þus cwædon, Lareow, et.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Ic hæbbe þone mete tō etanne þe gē nyton.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, Ic hæbbe þone mete to etanne þe ge nyton.

text: Ðā cwædon his leorningcnihtas him betwȳnan, Hwæðer ǣnig man him mete brōhte?
text_bare: Ða cwædon his leorningcnihtas him betwynan, Hwæðer ænig man him mete brohte?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Mīn mete is þæt ic wyrce þæs willan ðe me sende, þæt ic fullfremme his weorc.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Min mete is þæt ic wyrce þæs willan ðe me sende, þæt ic fullfremme his weorc.

text: Hū ne secge gē þæt nū gȳt synt fēowur mōnðas ǣr man rīpan mæge?
text_bare: Hu ne secge ge þæt nu gyt synt feowur monðas ær man ripan mæge?

text: nū ic ēow secge, Hebbað ūpp ēowre ēagan, and gesēoð þās eardas þæt hig synt scīre tō rīpanne.
text_bare: nu ic eow secge, Hebbað upp eowre eagan, and geseoð þas eardas þæt hig synt scire to ripanne.

text: And sē ðe rīpð nimð mēde, and gaderaþ wæstm on ēcum līfe, þæt ætgædere geblission sē þe sǣwþ and sē ðe rīpþ.
text_bare: And se ðe ripð nimð mede, and gaderaþ wæstm on ecum life, þæt ætgædere geblission se þe sæwþ and se ðe ripþ.

text: On þyson is witodlīce sōð word, for ðām ōþer is sē ðe sǣwþ, ōþer is sē ðe rīpþ.
text_bare: On þyson is witodlice soð word, for ðam oþer is se ðe sæwþ, oþer is se ðe ripþ.

text: Ic sende ēow tō rīpanne þæt þæt gē ne beswuncon; ōðre swuncon, and gē ēodun on hyra geswinc.
text_bare: Ic sende eow to ripanne þæt þæt ge ne beswuncon; oðre swuncon, and ge eodun on hyra geswinc.

text: Witodlīce manige Samaritanisce of ðǣre ceastre gelȳfdon on hyne for þæs wīfes wordon þe be him cȳþde, Þæt hē sǣde mē ealle þā þing þe ic dyde.
text_bare: Witodlice manige Samaritanisce of ðære ceastre gelyfdon on hyne for þæs wifes wordon þe be him cyþde, Þæt he sæde me ealle þa þing þe ic dyde.

text: Ðā þā Samaritaniscean cōmon tō him, hig gebǣdon hine þæt hē wunode ðǣr; and hē wunode þǣr twēgen dagas.
text_bare: Ða þa Samaritaniscean comon to him, hig gebædon hine þæt he wunode ðær; and he wunode þær twegen dagas.

text: And mycle mā gelȳfdon for his spǣce;
text_bare: And mycle ma gelyfdon for his spæce;

text: and cwǣdon tō þām wīfe, Ne gelȳfe wē nā for ðīnre sprǣce; wē sylfe gehȳrdon, and wē witon þæt hē is sōþ middaneardes Hǣlend.
text_bare: and cwædon to þam wife, Ne gelyfe we na for ðinre spræce; we sylfe gehyrdon, and we witon þæt he is soþ middaneardes Hælend.

text: Sōðlīce after twām dagon hē fērde þanone, and fōr tō Galilea.
text_bare: Soðlice after twam dagon he ferde þanone, and for to Galilea.

text: Sē Hǣlend sylf cȳþde gewitnesse þæt nān wītega næfð nānne wurðscype on hys āgenum earde.
text_bare: Se Hælend sylf cyþde gewitnesse þæt nan witega næfð nanne wurðscype on hys agenum earde.

text: Þā hē cōm tō Galileam, þā underfēngon hī hine, þā hi gesāwon ealle þā þing þe hē worhte on Ierusalem on frēolsdæge; and hī cōmun tō þām frēolsdage.
text_bare: Þa he com to Galileam, þa underfengon hi hine, þa hi gesawon ealle þa þing þe he worhte on Ierusalem on freolsdæge; and hi comun to þam freolsdage.

text: And hē cōm eft tō Chanaa Galilee, þǣr hē worhte þæt wīn of watere.
text_bare: And he com eft to Chanaa Galilee, þær he worhte þæt win of watere.

text: Sum undercyning wæs, þæs sunu was gesȳclod on Capharnaum.
text_bare: Sum undercyning wæs, þæs sunu was gesyclod on Capharnaum.

text: Þā þā sē gehȳrde þæt sē Hælend fōr fram Iudea tō Galilea, hē com tō him and bæd hine þæt hē fōre and gehǣlde his sunu; sōðlīce hē læg æt forðfōre.
text_bare: Þa þa se gehyrde þæt se Hælend for fram Iudea to Galilea, he com to him and bæd hine þæt he fore and gehælde his sunu; soðlice he læg æt forðfore.

text: Ðā cwǣþ sē Hǣlend tō him, Buton gē tācna and forebēacna gesēon, ne gelȳfe gē.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to him, Buton ge tacna and forebeacna geseon, ne gelyfe ge.

text: Ðā cwæð sē undercing tō him, Ðrihten, far ǣr mīn sunu swelte.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se undercing to him, Ðrihten, far ær min sunu swelte.

text: And sē Hælend cwæð, Gā, þīn sunu leofað.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð, Ga, þin sunu leofað.

text: Ðā ēode hē, and gelȳfde þǣre sprǣce þe sē Hǣlend him sǣde.
text_bare: Ða eode he, and gelyfde þære spræce þe se Hælend him sæde.

text: Ðā hē fōr, þā urnon his þēowas ongēan hyne, and sǣdon þæt his sunu leofode.
text_bare: Ða he for, þa urnon his þeowas ongean hyne, and sædon þæt his sunu leofode.

text: Ðā āxode hē tō hwylcon tīman him bet wǣre.
text_bare: Ða axode he to hwylcon timan him bet wære.

text: And hī sǣdon him, Gyrstandæg tō þǣre seofoþan tīde sē fēfor hine forlēt.
text_bare: And hi sædon him, Gyrstandæg to þære seofoþan tide se fefor hine forlet.

text: Ðā ongeat sē fæder þæt hit was on þǣre tīde ðe sē Hǣlend cwæð, Þīn sunu leofað.
text_bare: Ða ongeat se fæder þæt hit was on þære tide ðe se Hælend cwæð, Þin sunu leofað.

text: And hē gelȳfde and eall his hīwrǣden.
text_bare: And he gelyfde and eall his hiwræden.

text: Sē Hǣlend worhte þis tācen eft ōþre sīþe, þā hē cōm fram Iudea lande tō Galilea.
text_bare: Se Hælend worhte þis tacen eft oþre siþe, þa he com fram Iudea lande to Galilea.

text: Æfter þyson wæs Iudea frēolsdæg, and sē Hǣlend fōr tō Ierusalem.
text_bare: Æfter þyson wæs Iudea freolsdæg, and se Hælend for to Ierusalem.

text: On Ierusalem ys ān mere, sē is genemned on Ebrēisc Bethsaida; sē mere hæfð fīf porticas.
text_bare: On Ierusalem ys an mere, se is genemned on Ebreisc Bethsaida; se mere hæfð fif porticas.

text: On þām porticon læg mycel menigeo geādludra, blindra, and healtra, and forscruncenra, and geanbīdedon þæs wæteres styrunge.
text_bare: On þam porticon læg mycel menigeo geadludra, blindra, and healtra, and forscruncenra, and geanbidedon þæs wæteres styrunge.

text: Drihtenes engel cōm tō his tīman on þone mere, and þæt water was āstyred; and sē þe raþust cōm on þone mere after þæs wateres styrunge wearþ gehǣled fram swā hwylcere untrumnysse swā hē on wæs.
text_bare: Drihtenes engel com to his timan on þone mere, and þæt water was astyred; and se þe raþust com on þone mere after þæs wateres styrunge wearþ gehæled fram swa hwylcere untrumnysse swa he on wæs.

text: Ðær was sum man eahta and þrīttig wintra on his untrumnysse.
text_bare: Ðær was sum man eahta and þrittig wintra on his untrumnysse.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend geseah þysne licgean, and wiste þæt hē þǣr lange tīde wæs, ðā cwæþ hē tō him, Wylt þū hāl bēon?
text_bare: Þa se Hælend geseah þysne licgean, and wiste þæt he þær lange tide wæs, ða cwæþ he to him, Wylt þu hal beon?

text: Ðā andswarode sē sēoca him and cwæþ, Drihten, ic næbbe nānne man þæt mē dō on þone mere, þonne þæt wæter āstyred bið; þonne ic cume, þonne biþ ōþer beforan mē.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se seoca him and cwæþ, Drihten, ic næbbe nanne man þæt me do on þone mere, þonne þæt wæter astyred bið; þonne ic cume, þonne biþ oþer beforan me.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Arīs, nim þīn bed, and gā.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Aris, nim þin bed, and ga.

text: And sē man wæs sōna hāl, and hē nam his bed, and ēode.
text_bare: And se man wæs sona hal, and he nam his bed, and eode.

text: Hit was restedæg on ðām dæge.
text_bare: Hit was restedæg on ðam dæge.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas tō þām þe þǣr gehǣled wæs, Hit is restedæg; nis ðē ālȳfed þæt þū þīn bedd bere.
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa Iudeas to þam þe þær gehæled wæs, Hit is restedæg; nis ðe alyfed þæt þu þin bedd bere.

text: Hē andswarude him and cwæð, Sē ðe mē gehǣlde sē cwæð tō mē, Nim þīn bedd, and gā.
text_bare: He andswarude him and cwæð, Se ðe me gehælde se cwæð to me, Nim þin bedd, and ga.

text: Ðā āxsodon hī hine, Hwæt sē man wǣre þe þē sǣde, Nīm þīn bedd, and gā?
text_bare: Ða axsodon hi hine, Hwæt se man wære þe þe sæde, Nim þin bedd, and ga?

text: Sē þe þǣr gehǣled wæs nyste hwā hit wæs; sē Hǣlend sōþlīce bēah fram þǣre gegaderunge.
text_bare: Se þe þær gehæled wæs nyste hwa hit wæs; se Hælend soþlice beah fram þære gegaderunge.

text: Æfter þām sē Hǣlend hine gemētte on þām temple, and cwæþ tō him, Nū þū eart hāl geworden; ne synga þū, þē læs þe þē on sumon þingon wyrs getīde.
text_bare: Æfter þam se Hælend hine gemette on þam temple, and cwæþ to him, Nu þu eart hal geworden; ne synga þu, þe læs þe þe on sumon þingon wyrs getide.

text: Ðā fōr sē man, and cȳðde hit þām Iudean þæt hit wǣre sē Hǣlend þe hyne hǣlde.
text_bare: Ða for se man, and cyðde hit þam Iudean þæt hit wære se Hælend þe hyne hælde.

text: For þām þā Iudeas ēhton þone Hǣlend, for ðām þe hē dyde þās þing on restedæge.
text_bare: For þam þa Iudeas ehton þone Hælend, for ðam þe he dyde þas þing on restedæge.

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, Mīn Fæder wyrcð oþ þis nū gȳt, and ic wyrce.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend him and cwæð, Min Fæder wyrcð oþ þis nu gyt, and ic wyrce.

text: Þæs þē mā þā Iudeas sōhton hine tō ofslēanne, næs nā for þām ānum þe he þone restedæg bræc, ac for þām þe hē cwæð þæt God wǣre his Fæder, and hine sylfne dyde Gode gelīcne.
text_bare: Þæs þe ma þa Iudeas sohton hine to ofsleanne, næs na for þam anum þe he þone restedæg bræc, ac for þam þe he cwæð þæt God wære his Fæder, and hine sylfne dyde Gode gelicne.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæþ tō him, Sōð ic ēow secge, Ne mæg sē Sunu nān þing dōn, būton þæt he gesyhþ his Fæder dōn; ðā þing þe he wyrcþ, sē Sunu wyrcð gelīce.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend andswarode and cwæþ to him, Soð ic eow secge, Ne mæg se Sunu nan þing don, buton þæt he gesyhþ his Fæder don; ða þing þe he wyrcþ, se Sunu wyrcð gelice.

text: Sē lufað þone Sunu, and geswutelað him ealle þā ping þe hē wyrcþ; and māran weorc þonne þās sȳn hē geswutelað him, þæt gē wundrigeon.
text_bare: Se lufað þone Sunu, and geswutelað him ealle þa ping þe he wyrcþ; and maran weorc þonne þas syn he geswutelað him, þæt ge wundrigeon.

text: Swā sē Fǣder āwecð þā dēadan and gelīffæst, swā ēac sē Sunu gelīffæst þā ðe hē wyle.
text_bare: Swa se Fæder awecð þa deadan and geliffæst, swa eac se Sunu geliffæst þa ðe he wyle.

text: Nē sē Fæder ne dēmo nānum menn, ac hē sealde ǣlcne dōm þām Suna;
text_bare: Ne se Fæder ne demo nanum menn, ac he sealde ælcne dom þam Suna;

text: þæt ealle ārwurþigeon þone Sunu, swā swa hig ārwurþigeaþ þone Fæder.
text_bare: þæt ealle arwurþigeon þone Sunu, swa swa hig arwurþigeaþ þone Fæder.

text: Sē ðe ne ārwurðaþ þone Sunu, ne arwurþaþ hē þone Fæder þe hine sende.
text_bare: Se ðe ne arwurðaþ þone Sunu, ne arwurþaþ he þone Fæder þe hine sende.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, þæt sē þe mīn word gehyrð, and þām gelȳfð þe mē sende, sē hæfð ēce līf, and ne cymþ æt þām dōme, ac færð fram dēaðe tō līfe.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, þæt se þe min word gehyrð, and þam gelyfð þe me sende, se hæfð ece lif, and ne cymþ æt þam dome, ac færð fram deaðe to life.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Þæt sēo tīd cymð, and nū is, þonne þā dēadan gehȳrað Godes Suna stefne; and þā lybbað þe hig gehȳrað.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Þæt seo tid cymð, and nu is, þonne þa deadan gehyrað Godes Suna stefne; and þa lybbað þe hig gehyrað.

text: Swā sē Fæder hæfþ līf on him sylfon, swā he sealde þām Suna þæt hē hæfde līf on him syluon;
text_bare: Swa se Fæder hæfþ lif on him sylfon, swa he sealde þam Suna þæt he hæfde lif on him syluon;

text: and sealde him anweald þæt hē mōste dēman, for ðām þe hē is mannes Sunu.
text_bare: and sealde him anweald þæt he moste deman, for ðam þe he is mannes Sunu.

text: Ne wundrigeon gē ðæs þæt sēo tid cymð þæt ealle gehȳrað his stefne þe on byrgenum synt;
text_bare: Ne wundrigeon ge ðæs þæt seo tid cymð þæt ealle gehyrað his stefne þe on byrgenum synt;

text: and þā þe gōd worhton farað on līfes ǣreste; and þā þe yfel dydon, on dōmes ǣreste.
text_bare: and þa þe god worhton farað on lifes æreste; and þa þe yfel dydon, on domes æreste.

text: Ne mæg ic nān þing dōn fram mē sylfum; ic dēme swā swā ic gehȳre, and mīn dōm is ryht, for ðām ic ne sēce mīnne willan ac þæs þe mē sende.
text_bare: Ne mæg ic nan þing don fram me sylfum; ic deme swa swa ic gehyre, and min dom is ryht, for ðam ic ne sece minne willan ac þæs þe me sende.

text: Gif ic gewitnesse be mē cȳþe, mīn gewitnes nis sōð.
text_bare: Gif ic gewitnesse be me cyþe, min gewitnes nis soð.

text: Ōþer is sē ðe cȳþ gewitnesse be mē; and ic wāt þæt sēo cȳðnes is sōð þe hē cȳþ be mē.
text_bare: Oþer is se ðe cyþ gewitnesse be me; and ic wat þæt seo cyðnes is soð þe he cyþ be me.

text: Gē sendon tō Iohanne, and hē cȳðde sōþfæstnesse gewitnesse.
text_bare: Ge sendon to Iohanne, and he cyðde soþfæstnesse gewitnesse.

text: Ic ne onfō gewitnesse fram menn; ac þās þing ic secge þæt gē sȳn hāle.
text_bare: Ic ne onfo gewitnesse fram menn; ac þas þing ic secge þæt ge syn hale.

text: Hē wæs byrnende lēohtfæt and lȳhtende; gē woldon sume hwīle geblissian on his lēohte.
text_bare: He wæs byrnende leohtfæt and lyhtende; ge woldon sume hwile geblissian on his leohte.

text: Ic hæbbe māran gewitnesse þonne Iohannes; witodlīce þā weorc þe Fæder mē sealde þæt ic hig fullfremme, ðā weorc þe ic wyrce cȳþað gewitnesse be mē þæt Fæder mē āsende.
text_bare: Ic hæbbe maran gewitnesse þonne Iohannes; witodlice þa weorc þe Fæder me sealde þæt ic hig fullfremme, ða weorc þe ic wyrce cyþað gewitnesse be me þæt Fæder me asende.

text: And sē Fæder þe mē sende cȳþ gewitnesse be mē.
text_bare: And se Fæder þe me sende cyþ gewitnesse be me.

text: Nē gē nǣfre his stefne ne gehȳrdon, nē gē his hīw ne gesāwon.
text_bare: Ne ge næfre his stefne ne gehyrdon, ne ge his hiw ne gesawon.

text: And gē nabbað his word on ēow wunigende; for þām þe gē ne gelȳfað þām ðe hē sende.
text_bare: And ge nabbað his word on eow wunigende; for þam þe ge ne gelyfað þam ðe he sende.

text: Smēageað hālige gewritu, for ðām þe gē awēnað þæt gē habbon ēce līf on þām; and hig synt þe gewitnesse cȳþaþ be mē;
text_bare: Smeageað halige gewritu, for ðam þe ge awenað þæt ge habbon ece lif on þam; and hig synt þe gewitnesse cyþaþ be me;

text: and gē nellað cuman tō mē þæt gē habbon līf.
text_bare: and ge nellað cuman to me þæt ge habbon lif.

text: Ne underfō ic nāne beorhtnesse æt mannum.
text_bare: Ne underfo ic nane beorhtnesse æt mannum.

text: Ac ic gecnēow ēow, þæt gē nabbaþ Godes lufe on ēow.
text_bare: Ac ic gecneow eow, þæt ge nabbaþ Godes lufe on eow.

text: Ic cōm on mīnes Fæder naman, and gē mē ne underfēngon; gyf ōþer cymþ on his āgenum naman, hyne gē underfōð.
text_bare: Ic com on mines Fæder naman, and ge me ne underfengon; gyf oþer cymþ on his agenum naman, hyne ge underfoð.

text: Hū mage gē gelȳfan þe ēow betwēonan wuldor underfōð, and ne sēceaþ þæt wuldor þe is fram Gode syluum?
text_bare: Hu mage ge gelyfan þe eow betweonan wuldor underfoð, and ne seceaþ þæt wuldor þe is fram Gode syluum?

text: Ne wēne gē þæt ic ēow wrēge tō Fæder; sē is þe ēow wrēgð, Moyses on þone gē gehyhtað.
text_bare: Ne wene ge þæt ic eow wrege to Fæder; se is þe eow wregð, Moyses on þone ge gehyhtað.

text: Witodlīce gif gē gelȳfdon on Moyse, gē gelȳfdon ēac mē; sōðlīce hē wrāt be mē.
text_bare: Witodlice gif ge gelyfdon on Moyse, ge gelyfdon eac me; soðlice he wrat be me.

text: Gif gē his stafum ne gelȳfað, hū gelȳfe gē mīnum wordum?
text_bare: Gif ge his stafum ne gelyfað, hu gelyfe ge minum wordum?

text: Æfter þyson fōr sē Hǣlend ofer þā Galileiscan sǣ, sēo is Tiberiadis.
text_bare: Æfter þyson for se Hælend ofer þa Galileiscan sæ, seo is Tiberiadis.

text: And him fylide mycel folc, for þām þe hig gesāwon þā tācna þe hē worhte on þām þe wǣron geuntrumode.
text_bare: And him fylide mycel folc, for þam þe hig gesawon þa tacna þe he worhte on þam þe wæron geuntrumode.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend āstāh on ānne munt, and sæt þār mid his leorningcnihton.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend astah on anne munt, and sæt þar mid his leorningcnihton.

text: Hit was gehende ēastron, Iudea frēolsdæge.
text_bare: Hit was gehende eastron, Iudea freolsdæge.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend his ēagan ūp āhōf and geseah þæt micel folc cōm tō him, hē cwæð tō Philippe, Hwǣr bicge wē hlāfas þæt þās eton?
text_bare: Ða se Hælend his eagan up ahof and geseah þæt micel folc com to him, he cwæð to Philippe, Hwær bicge we hlafas þæt þas eton?

text: Þæt hē cwæþ his fandigende; hē wiste hwæt hē dōn wolde.
text_bare: Þæt he cwæþ his fandigende; he wiste hwæt he don wolde.

text: Ðā andwurde him Philippus and cwæð, Nabbað hī genōh on twēgera hundred penega wurþe hlāfes, þæt ǣlc sumne dǣl nyme.
text_bare: Ða andwurde him Philippus and cwæð, Nabbað hi genoh on twegera hundred penega wurþe hlafes, þæt ælc sumne dæl nyme.

text: Ðā andwyrde him ān his leorningcnihta, Andreas, Simones brōþur Petres,
text_bare: Ða andwyrde him an his leorningcnihta, Andreas, Simones broþur Petres,

text: Hēr is ān cnapa þe hæfp fīf berene hlāfas and twēgen fixas; ac hwæt synt þā þing betwux swā manegum mannum?
text_bare: Her is an cnapa þe hæfp fif berene hlafas and twegen fixas; ac hwæt synt þa þing betwux swa manegum mannum?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Dōð þæt þās men sitton.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Doð þæt þas men sitton.

text: On þǣre stōwe wæs mycel gærs; ðǣr sǣton þā swylce fīf þūsendo manna.
text_bare: On þære stowe wæs mycel gærs; ðær sæton þa swylce fif þusendo manna.

text: Sē Hǣlend nam þā hlāfas, and þanc wurðlīce dyde, and hig tōdǣlde þām sittendum, and eall swā of þām fixum swā mycel swā hig woldon.
text_bare: Se Hælend nam þa hlafas, and þanc wurðlice dyde, and hig todælde þam sittendum, and eall swa of þam fixum swa mycel swa hig woldon.

text: Ðā hig fulle wǣron, þā cwæð hē tō his leorningcnihton, Gaderiaþ þā brytsena þe þār tō lāfe wǣron, þæt hig ne losigeon.
text_bare: Ða hig fulle wæron, þa cwæð he to his leorningcnihton, Gaderiaþ þa brytsena þe þar to lafe wæron, þæt hig ne losigeon.

text: Hig gegaderedon, and fyldon twelf wyligeon fulle þǣra brytsena of þām þe þā lǣfdon þþe of þām fīf berenan hlāfon ǣton.
text_bare: Hig gegaderedon, and fyldon twelf wyligeon fulle þæra brytsena of þam þe þa læfdon þþe of þam fif berenan hlafon æton.

text: Ðā men cwǣdon, þā hig gesāwon þæt hē þæt tācen worhte, Þæt þēs is sōðlīce wītega þe on middangeard cymþ.
text_bare: Ða men cwædon, þa hig gesawon þæt he þæt tacen worhte, Þæt þes is soðlice witega þe on middangeard cymþ.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend wiste þæt hig woldon cuman and hine gelæccean and tō cynge dōn, þā flēah hē āna uppon þone munt.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend wiste þæt hig woldon cuman and hine gelæccean and to cynge don, þa fleah he ana uppon þone munt.

text: And þā hig ēodon on scyp, hi cōmon ofer þā sǣ tō Capharnaum; hit wearð þā þȳstre, and sē Hǣlend ne cōm tō him.
text_bare: And þa hig eodon on scyp, hi comon ofer þa sæ to Capharnaum; hit wearð þa þystre, and se Hælend ne com to him.

text: Mycel wind blēow, and hit was hrēoh sǣ.
text_bare: Mycel wind bleow, and hit was hreoh sæ.

text: Witodlīce þā hig hæfdon gerōwen swylce twēntig furlanga oððe þrīttig, þā gesāwon hig þone Hǣlend uppan þǣre sǣ gān, and þæt hē wæs gehende þām scype; and hig him ondrēdon.
text_bare: Witodlice þa hig hæfdon gerowen swylce twentig furlanga oððe þrittig, þa gesawon hig þone Hælend uppan þære sæ gan, and þæt he wæs gehende þam scype; and hig him ondredon.

text: Hē cwæð þā tō him, Ic hit eom; ne ondrǣdað ēow.
text_bare: He cwæð þa to him, Ic hit eom; ne ondrædað eow.

text: Hig woldon hyne niman on þæt scyp; and sōna þæt scyp wæs æt þām lande þe hig woldon tō faran.
text_bare: Hig woldon hyne niman on þæt scyp; and sona þæt scyp wæs æt þam lande þe hig woldon to faran.

text: Sōþlīce ōþre dæg sēo menigeo þe stōd begeondan þām mere geseah þæt þǣr næs būtan ān scyp, and þæt sē Hǣlend ne ēode on scyp mid his leorningcnihtan, ac his leorningcnihtas sylfe āna fōron;-
text_bare: Soþlice oþre dæg seo menigeo þe stod begeondan þam mere geseah þæt þær næs butan an scyp, and þæt se Hælend ne eode on scyp mid his leorningcnihtan, ac his leorningcnihtas sylfe ana foron;-

text: ōðre scypu cōmon fram Tiberiade wið þā stōwe þār hig þone hlāf ǣton, Drihtne þanciende;-
text_bare: oðre scypu comon fram Tiberiade wið þa stowe þar hig þone hlaf æton, Drihtne þanciende;-

text: ðā sēo menigeo geseah þæt sē Hǣlend þār næs nē his leorningcnihtas, þā ēodon hig on scipu, and cōman tō Capharnaum, sōhton ðone Hǣlend.
text_bare: ða seo menigeo geseah þæt se Hælend þar næs ne his leorningcnihtas, þa eodon hig on scipu, and coman to Capharnaum, sohton ðone Hælend.

text: And þā hig gemētton hyne begeondan þām mere, hig cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, hwænne cōme þū hider?
text_bare: And þa hig gemetton hyne begeondan þam mere, hig cwædon to him, Lareow, hwænne come þu hider?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ne sēce gē mē for ðām þe gē tācnu gesāwon, ac for þām þe gē ǣton of ðām hlāfon, and synt fulle.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Soþ ic eow secge, Ne sece ge me for ðam þe ge tacnu gesawon, ac for þam þe ge æton of ðam hlafon, and synt fulle.

text: Ne wyrceaþ æfter þām mete þe forwyrð, ac æfter þām þe þurhwunað on ēce līf, ðone mannes Sunu ēow sylþ; þone God Fæder getācnode.
text_bare: Ne wyrceaþ æfter þam mete þe forwyrð, ac æfter þam þe þurhwunað on ece lif, ðone mannes Sunu eow sylþ; þone God Fæder getacnode.

text: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Hwæt dō wē þæt wē wyrceon Godes weorc?
text_bare: Hig cwædon to him, Hwæt do we þæt we wyrceon Godes weorc?

text: Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, þæt is Godes weorc, þæt gē gelȳfan on ðone þe hē sende.
text_bare: Þa andswarode se Hælend and cwæð to him, þæt is Godes weorc, þæt ge gelyfan on ðone þe he sende.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig, Hwat dēst þū tō tācne þæt wē gesēon and gelȳfon þæt þū hit wyrce?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig, Hwat dest þu to tacne þæt we geseon and gelyfon þæt þu hit wyrce?

text: Ūre fæderas ton heofonlīcne mete on wēstene; swā hit āwriten is, Hē sealde him etan hlāf of heofone.
text_bare: Ure fæderas ton heofonlicne mete on westene; swa hit awriten is, He sealde him etan hlaf of heofone.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne sealde Moyses ēow hlāf of heofonum; ac mīn Fæder ēow sylþ soðne hlāf of heofonum.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Soð ic secge eow, Ne sealde Moyses eow hlaf of heofonum; ac min Fæder eow sylþ soðne hlaf of heofonum.

text: Hit is Godes hlāf þe of heofone cōm, and sylþ middanearde līf.
text_bare: Hit is Godes hlaf þe of heofone com, and sylþ middanearde lif.

text: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Drihten, syle ūs þysne hlāf.
text_bare: Hig cwædon to him, Drihten, syle us þysne hlaf.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom līfes hlāf; ne hingrað þone þe tō mē cymð, and ne þyrst þone nǣfre ðe on mē gelyfð.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Ic eom lifes hlaf; ne hingrað þone þe to me cymð, and ne þyrst þone næfre ðe on me gelyfð.

text: Ac ic ēow sǣde þæt gē gesāwon mē, and ne gelȳfdon.
text_bare: Ac ic eow sæde þæt ge gesawon me, and ne gelyfdon.

text: Eall þæt Fæder mē sylþ cymð tō mē; and ic ne wyrpe ūt ðone þe to mē cymð.
text_bare: Eall þæt Fæder me sylþ cymð to me; and ic ne wyrpe ut ðone þe to me cymð.

text: For þām þe ic ne cōm of heofonum þæt ic mīnne willan dō, ac þæs willan þe mē sende.
text_bare: For þam þe ic ne com of heofonum þæt ic minne willan do, ac þæs willan þe me sende.

text: Ðæt is þæs Fæder willa ðe mē sende, þæt ic nān þing ne forlēose of ðām þe hē mē sealde, ac āwecce þæt on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: Ðæt is þæs Fæder willa ðe me sende, þæt ic nan þing ne forleose of ðam þe he me sealde, ac awecce þæt on þam ytemestan dæge.

text: Ðis is mīnes Fæder willa þe mē sende, þæt ǣlc þe ðone Sunu gesyhþ and on hine gelȳfð hæbbe ēce līf; and ic hine awecce on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: Ðis is mines Fæder willa þe me sende, þæt ælc þe ðone Sunu gesyhþ and on hine gelyfð hæbbe ece lif; and ic hine awecce on þam ytemestan dæge.

text: Ðā murcnodon þā Iudeas be him for þām þe hē cwæð, Ic eom hlāf þe of heofonum cōm.
text_bare: Ða murcnodon þa Iudeas be him for þam þe he cwæð, Ic eom hlaf þe of heofonum com.

text: And hig cwǣdon, Hū nis þis sē Hǣlend, Iosepes sunu?
text_bare: And hig cwædon, Hu nis þis se Hælend, Iosepes sunu?

text: wē cunnon his fæder and his mōdor; hūmeta segð þēs, Ic cōm of heofonum?
text_bare: we cunnon his fæder and his modor; humeta segð þes, Ic com of heofonum?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð tō him, Ne murcniaþ ēow betwȳnan.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð to him, Ne murcniaþ eow betwynan.

text: Ne mæg nān man cuman tō mē, būton sē Fæder þe mē sende hyne tēo; and ic hine ārǣre on ðām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: Ne mæg nan man cuman to me, buton se Fæder þe me sende hyne teo; and ic hine arære on ðam ytemestan dæge.

text: On ðǣra wītegena bōcum is āwriten, Ealle ēaðlǣre beoð Godes.
text_bare: On ðæra witegena bocum is awriten, Ealle eaðlære beoð Godes.

text: Ǣlc þe gehȳrde æt Fæder, and leornode, cymð tō mē.
text_bare: Ælc þe gehyrde æt Fæder, and leornode, cymð to me.

text: Ne geseah nān man Fæder, būton sē ðe is of Gode, sē gesyhþ Fæder.
text_bare: Ne geseah nan man Fæder, buton se ðe is of Gode, se gesyhþ Fæder.

text: Sōð ic secge ēow, Sē hæfð ēce līf þe on mē gelȳfð.
text_bare: Soð ic secge eow, Se hæfð ece lif þe on me gelyfð.

text: Ic eom līfes hlāf.
text_bare: Ic eom lifes hlaf.

text: Ūre fæderas ǣton heofunlīcne mete on wēstene, and hig synd dēade.
text_bare: Ure fæderas æton heofunlicne mete on westene, and hig synd deade.

text: Ðis is sē hlāf þe of heofonum cōm, þæt ne swelte sē ðe of him ytt.
text_bare: Ðis is se hlaf þe of heofonum com, þæt ne swelte se ðe of him ytt.

text: Ic eom lybbende hlāf þe of heofonum cōm; swā hwā swā ytt of ðyson hlāfe, hē leofað on ēcnysse; and sē hlāf þe ic sylle is mīn flǣsc, for middaneardes līfe.
text_bare: Ic eom lybbende hlaf þe of heofonum com; swa hwa swa ytt of ðyson hlafe, he leofað on ecnysse; and se hlaf þe ic sylle is min flæsc, for middaneardes life.

text: Þā Iudeas fliton him betwȳnan and cwǣdon, Hū mæg þēs his flǣsc us syllan tō etanne?
text_bare: Þa Iudeas fliton him betwynan and cwædon, Hu mæg þes his flæsc us syllan to etanne?

text: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō him,
text_bare: Þa cwæþ se Hælend to him,

text: Sōþ ic secge ēow, Næbbe gē līf on ēow, būton gē eton mannes Suna flǣsc and his blōd drincon.
text_bare: Soþ ic secge eow, Næbbe ge lif on eow, buton ge eton mannes Suna flæsc and his blod drincon.

text: Sē hæfð ēce līf þe ytt mīn flǣsc and drincð mīn blōd; and ic hine ārǣre on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: Se hæfð ece lif þe ytt min flæsc and drincð min blod; and ic hine arære on þam ytemestan dæge.

text: Sōþlīce mīn flæsc is mete, and mīn blōd is drinc.
text_bare: Soþlice min flæsc is mete, and min blod is drinc.

text: Sē ðe ytt mīn flǣsc and drincð mīn blōd, hē wunað on mē, and ic on him.
text_bare: Se ðe ytt min flæsc and drincð min blod, he wunað on me, and ic on him.

text: Swā swā lybbende Fæder mē sende, and ic lybbe þurh Fæder; and sē ðe mē ytt, hē leofað þurh mē.
text_bare: Swa swa lybbende Fæder me sende, and ic lybbe þurh Fæder; and se ðe me ytt, he leofað þurh me.

text: Þis is sē hlāf þe of heofonum cōm; nā swā swā ūre fæderas ǣton heofonlīcne mete, and dēade wǣron; sē þe ytt þysne hlāf, he leofað on ēcnysse.
text_bare: Þis is se hlaf þe of heofonum com; na swa swa ure fæderas æton heofonlicne mete, and deade wæron; se þe ytt þysne hlaf, he leofað on ecnysse.

text: Ðās þing hē sǣde on gesamnunge, þā hē lǣrde on Capharnaum.
text_bare: Ðas þing he sæde on gesamnunge, þa he lærde on Capharnaum.

text: Manega his leorningcnihta cwǣdon, þā hig ðis gehȳrdon, Heard is þēos sprǣc; hwā mæg hig gehȳran?
text_bare: Manega his leorningcnihta cwædon, þa hig ðis gehyrdon, Heard is þeos spræc; hwa mæg hig gehyran?

text: Ðā wiste sē Hǣlend þæt his leorningcnihtas murcnedon betweox him sylfon be þison, and hē cwæð tō him, þæt ēow beswīcð?
text_bare: Ða wiste se Hælend þæt his leorningcnihtas murcnedon betweox him sylfon be þison, and he cwæð to him, þæt eow beswicð?

text: Gyf gē gesēoþ mannes Sunu āstīgendne þǣr hē ǣr wæs?
text_bare: Gyf ge geseoþ mannes Sunu astigendne þær he ær wæs?

text: Gāst is sē ðe gelīffæst; flǣsc ne fremað nān þing; þā word þe ic ēow sǣde synt gāst and līf.
text_bare: Gast is se ðe geliffæst; flæsc ne fremað nan þing; þa word þe ic eow sæde synt gast and lif.

text: Ac sume gē ne gelȳfað.
text_bare: Ac sume ge ne gelyfað.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend wiste æt fruman hwæt þā gelȳfedan wǣron, and hwā hine belǣwon wolde.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend wiste æt fruman hwæt þa gelyfedan wæron, and hwa hine belæwon wolde.

text: And hē cwæð, For þig ic ēow sǣde þæt nān man ne mæg cuman to mē, būton mīn Fæder hit him sylle.
text_bare: And he cwæð, For þig ic eow sæde þæt nan man ne mæg cuman to me, buton min Fæder hit him sylle.

text: Syððan manega his leorningcnihta cyrdon on bæc, and ne ēodun mid him.
text_bare: Syððan manega his leorningcnihta cyrdon on bæc, and ne eodun mid him.

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō þām twelfum, Cweðe gē wylle gē fram mē?
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to þam twelfum, Cweðe ge wylle ge fram me?

text: Þā andwyrde him Simon Petrus and cwæð, Drihten, tō hwām gā wē?
text_bare: Þa andwyrde him Simon Petrus and cwæð, Drihten, to hwam ga we?

text: þū hæfst ēces līfes word.
text_bare: þu hæfst eces lifes word.

text: And wē gelȳfað and witon þæt þū eart Crīst, Godes Sunu.
text_bare: And we gelyfað and witon þæt þu eart Crist, Godes Sunu.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Hū ne gecēas ic ēow twelfe, and ēower ān is dēofol?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Hu ne geceas ic eow twelfe, and eower an is deofol?

text: Hē hyt cwæþ be Iuda Scarioþe; þēs hine belǣwde, þā hē wæs ān þāra twelfa.
text_bare: He hyt cwæþ be Iuda Scarioþe; þes hine belæwde, þa he wæs an þara twelfa.

text: Syþþan fōr sē Hǣlend tō Galilea; hē nolde faran tō Iudea, for þām þe þā Iudeas hine sōhton and woldon hyne ofslēan.
text_bare: Syþþan for se Hælend to Galilea; he nolde faran to Iudea, for þam þe þa Iudeas hine sohton and woldon hyne ofslean.

text: Hit was gehende Iudea frēolsdæge.
text_bare: Hit was gehende Iudea freolsdæge.

text: His brōðra cwǣdon to him, Far heonon and gā on Iudea land, þæt þīne leorningcnihtas gesēon þā weorc þe þū wyrcst.
text_bare: His broðra cwædon to him, Far heonon and ga on Iudea land, þæt þine leorningcnihtas geseon þa weorc þe þu wyrcst.

text: Ne dēð nan man nān þing on dīglum, ac sēcþ þæt hit open sȳ.
text_bare: Ne deð nan man nan þing on diglum, ac secþ þæt hit open sy.

text: Gif ðū þās þing dēst, geswutela þē sylfne middanearde.
text_bare: Gif ðu þas þing dest, geswutela þe sylfne middanearde.

text: Witodlīce nē his māgas ne gelȳfdon on hyne.
text_bare: Witodlice ne his magas ne gelyfdon on hyne.

text: Ðā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō him, Gȳt ne cōm min tīd; ēower tīd is symble gearu.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to him, Gyt ne com min tid; eower tid is symble gearu.

text: Ne mæg middaneard ēow hatigean; ac hē hatað mē, for þām ic cȳþe gewitnesse be him þæt his weorc synt yfele.
text_bare: Ne mæg middaneard eow hatigean; ac he hatað me, for þam ic cyþe gewitnesse be him þæt his weorc synt yfele.

text: Fare gē to þison frēolsdæge; ic ne fare tō þison frēolsdæge, for þām mīn tīd nis gȳt gefylled.
text_bare: Fare ge to þison freolsdæge; ic ne fare to þison freolsdæge, for þam min tid nis gyt gefylled.

text: Hē wunede on Galilea, þā hē þās þing sǣde.
text_bare: He wunede on Galilea, þa he þas þing sæde.

text: Eft þā his gebrōðru fōron, þā fōr hē ēac tō ðām freolsdæge, næs nā openlīce ac dīgollīce.
text_bare: Eft þa his gebroðru foron, þa for he eac to ðam freolsdæge, næs na openlice ac digollice.

text: Ðā Iudeas hyne sōhton on þām frēolsdæge, and cwǣdon, Hwār is hē?
text_bare: Ða Iudeas hyne sohton on þam freolsdæge, and cwædon, Hwar is he?

text: And mycel gehlȳd wæs on þǣre menigeo be him.
text_bare: And mycel gehlyd wæs on þære menigeo be him.

text: Sume cwǣdon, He is gōd; ōðre cwǣdon, Nese, ac he beswīcð þis folc.
text_bare: Sume cwædon, He is god; oðre cwædon, Nese, ac he beswicð þis folc.

text: Þeah hwæþere ne spæc nān man openlīce be him for þǣra Iudea ege.
text_bare: Þeah hwæþere ne spæc nan man openlice be him for þæra Iudea ege.

text: Þā hit wæs mid dæg þæs frēolsdæges, þā ēode sē Hǣlend intō þām temple, and lǣrde.
text_bare: Þa hit wæs mid dæg þæs freolsdæges, þa eode se Hælend into þam temple, and lærde.

text: And þā Iudeas wundredon and cwǣdon, Hūmeta cann þēs stafas, þonne hē ne leornode?
text_bare: And þa Iudeas wundredon and cwædon, Humeta cann þes stafas, þonne he ne leornode?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Mīn lār nis nā mīn, ac þæs þe mē sende.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæþ, Min lar nis na min, ac þæs þe me sende.

text: Gyf hwā wyle his willan dōn, hē gecnǣwð be þǣre lāre, hwæþer hēo sī of Gode, hwæþer þe ic be mē sylfum spece.
text_bare: Gyf hwa wyle his willan don, he gecnæwð be þære lare, hwæþer heo si of Gode, hwæþer þe ic be me sylfum spece.

text: Sē þe be him sylfum sprycð sēcþ his āgen wuldor; sē þe sēcþ þæs wuldor þe hyne sende, sē is sōþfæst, and nis nān unrihtwisnys on him.
text_bare: Se þe be him sylfum sprycð secþ his agen wuldor; se þe secþ þæs wuldor þe hyne sende, se is soþfæst, and nis nan unrihtwisnys on him.

text: Hū ne sealde Moyses ēow ǣ, and ēower nān ne healt þā ǣ?
text_bare: Hu ne sealde Moyses eow æ, and eower nan ne healt þa æ?

text: Hwi sece gē mē tō ofslēanne?
text_bare: Hwi sece ge me to ofsleanne?

text: Þā andswarode sēo menigeo and cwæð, Dēofol þe sticað on; hwā sēcð þē tō ofslēanne?
text_bare: Þa andswarode seo menigeo and cwæð, Deofol þe sticað on; hwa secð þe to ofsleanne?

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Ān weorc ic worhte, and ealle gē wundrigeaþ.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend and cwæð to him, An weorc ic worhte, and ealle ge wundrigeaþ.

text: For ðȳ Moyses ēow sealde ymbsnidenesse; næs nā for þī þe hēo of Moyse sȳ, ac of fæderon; and on restedæge gē ymbsnīðaþ mann,
text_bare: For ðy Moyses eow sealde ymbsnidenesse; næs na for þi þe heo of Moyse sy, ac of fæderon; and on restedæge ge ymbsniðaþ mann,

text: þæt Moyses ǣ ne sȳ tōworpen; and gē belgaþ wið mē for ðām þe ic gehǣlde ānne man on restedæge?
text_bare: þæt Moyses æ ne sy toworpen; and ge belgaþ wið me for ðam þe ic gehælde anne man on restedæge?

text: Ne dēme gē be ansȳne, ac dēmað rihtne dōm.
text_bare: Ne deme ge be ansyne, ac demað rihtne dom.

text: Sume cwǣdon þā ðe wǣron of Ierusalem, Hū nis ðis sē ðe hī sēceaþ tō ofslēanne?
text_bare: Sume cwædon þa ðe wæron of Ierusalem, Hu nis ðis se ðe hi seceaþ to ofsleanne?

text: And nu hē spycþ openlīce, and hig ne cweðaþ nān ðing tō him.
text_bare: And nu he spycþ openlice, and hig ne cweðaþ nan ðing to him.

text: Cweðe wē hwæþer þā ealdras ongyton þæt þis is Crīst?
text_bare: Cweðe we hwæþer þa ealdras ongyton þæt þis is Crist?

text: Ac wē witon hwanon þēs is; ðonne Crīst cymþ, þonne nāt nān mann hwanon hē biþ.
text_bare: Ac we witon hwanon þes is; ðonne Crist cymþ, þonne nat nan mann hwanon he biþ.

text: Sē Hǣlend clypode and lærde on þām temple and cwæð, Mē gē cunnon, and gē witon hwanon ic eom; and ic ne cōm fram mē sylfum, ac sē is sōð þe mē sende, þone gē ne cunnon.
text_bare: Se Hælend clypode and lærde on þam temple and cwæð, Me ge cunnon, and ge witon hwanon ic eom; and ic ne com fram me sylfum, ac se is soð þe me sende, þone ge ne cunnon.

text: Ic hyne can; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic bēo lēas, and ēow gelīc.
text_bare: Ic hyne can; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic beo leas, and eow gelic.

text: Ic hyne can, and ic eom of him, and hē mē sende.
text_bare: Ic hyne can, and ic eom of him, and he me sende.

text: Hig hine sōhton tō nimanne; and hyra nān hys ne æthrān, for ðām þe his tīd ne cōm þā gyt.
text_bare: Hig hine sohton to nimanne; and hyra nan hys ne æthran, for ðam þe his tid ne com þa gyt.

text: Manega of ðǣre menigeo gelȳfdon on hine, and cwǣdon, Cweþe gē wyrcð Crīst mā tācna þonne he cymð þonne þēs dēð?
text_bare: Manega of ðære menigeo gelyfdon on hine, and cwædon, Cweþe ge wyrcð Crist ma tacna þonne he cymð þonne þes deð?

text: Þā Pharisei gehȳrdon þā menigeo þus murcnigende be him.
text_bare: Þa Pharisei gehyrdon þa menigeo þus murcnigende be him.

text: Ðā ealdras and ðā Pharisei sendon hyra þēnas þæt hig woldon hine gefōn.
text_bare: Ða ealdras and ða Pharisei sendon hyra þenas þæt hig woldon hine gefon.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Gȳt ic bēo sume hwīle mid ēow, and ic gā tō ðām þe mē sende.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Gyt ic beo sume hwile mid eow, and ic ga to ðam þe me sende.

text: Gē sēcað mē, and ne findaþ; and gē ne magon cuman þār ic eom.
text_bare: Ge secað me, and ne findaþ; and ge ne magon cuman þar ic eom.

text: Þā Iudeas cwǣdon betwēonan him sylfum, Hwyder wyle þēs faran þæt wē hine ne findon?
text_bare: Þa Iudeas cwædon betweonan him sylfum, Hwyder wyle þes faran þæt we hine ne findon?

text: cwyst ðū wyle hē faran on ðēoda tōdrǣfednysse, and hig lǣran?
text_bare: cwyst ðu wyle he faran on ðeoda todræfednysse, and hig læran?

text: Hwæt is ðēos spræc þe hē sprycð, Gē sēceaþ mē, and ne findaþ; and gē ne magon cuman þār ic eom?
text_bare: Hwæt is ðeos spræc þe he sprycð, Ge seceaþ me, and ne findaþ; and ge ne magon cuman þar ic eom?

text: On þām æftemestan mǣran frēolsdæge stōd sē Hǣlend and clypode, Cume tō mē sē ðe hine þyrste, and drince.
text_bare: On þam æftemestan mæran freolsdæge stod se Hælend and clypode, Cume to me se ðe hine þyrste, and drince.

text: Se þe gelyfþ on mē, swā þæt gewrit cwyð, lybbendes wætres flōd flowað of his innoðe.
text_bare: Se þe gelyfþ on me, swa þæt gewrit cwyð, lybbendes wætres flod flowað of his innoðe.

text: Þæt he cwæð be þām Gāste þe þā sceoldon underfōn þe on hyne gelyfdon; þā gyt næs sē Gāst geseald, for þām pe sē Hǣlend næs ðā gȳt gewuldrud.
text_bare: Þæt he cwæð be þam Gaste þe þa sceoldon underfon þe on hyne gelyfdon; þa gyt næs se Gast geseald, for þam pe se Hælend næs ða gyt gewuldrud.

text: Of ðǣre tide sēo menigeo cwæð, þā hēo gehȳrde ðās his sprǣce, Ðēs is sōð wītega.
text_bare: Of ðære tide seo menigeo cwæð, þa heo gehyrde ðas his spræce, Ðes is soð witega.

text: Sume cwǣdon, Hē is Crīst.
text_bare: Sume cwædon, He is Crist.

text: Sume cwǣdon, Cweðe gē cymþ Crīst fram Galilea?
text_bare: Sume cwædon, Cweðe ge cymþ Crist fram Galilea?

text: Hū ne cwyð þæt gewrit þæt Crīst cymð of Dauides cynne, and of Bethleem ceastre, þār þār Dauid wæs?
text_bare: Hu ne cwyð þæt gewrit þæt Crist cymð of Dauides cynne, and of Bethleem ceastre, þar þar Dauid wæs?

text: Witodlīce ungeþwǣrnes wæs geworden on þǣre menigeo for him.
text_bare: Witodlice ungeþwærnes wæs geworden on þære menigeo for him.

text: Sume hig woldon hine niman; ac hyra nān his ne æthrān.
text_bare: Sume hig woldon hine niman; ac hyra nan his ne æthran.

text: Þā þēnas comon tō þām bisceopum and tō þām Phariseon; and hig cwǣdon to him, For hwī ne brōhton gē hine hider?
text_bare: Þa þenas comon to þam bisceopum and to þam Phariseon; and hig cwædon to him, For hwi ne brohton ge hine hider?

text: Þā andwyrdon þā þēnas and cwǣdon, Ne spræc nǣfre nān man swā þēs man sprycþ.
text_bare: Þa andwyrdon þa þenas and cwædon, Ne spræc næfre nan man swa þes man sprycþ.

text: Þā cwǣdon þā Pharisei tō him, Synt gē beswicene?
text_bare: Þa cwædon þa Pharisei to him, Synt ge beswicene?

text: Cweðe gē gelȳfde ǣnig þǣra ealdra oððe þǣra Pharisea on hyne?
text_bare: Cweðe ge gelyfde ænig þæra ealdra oððe þæra Pharisea on hyne?

text: Ac þēos menigeo þe ne cūðe þā ǣ, hig synt āwyrgede.
text_bare: Ac þeos menigeo þe ne cuðe þa æ, hig synt awyrgede.

text: Ða cwæð Nichodemus tō him, - sē þe cōm tō him on nyht sē wæs hyra ān, - .
text_bare: Ða cwæð Nichodemus to him, - se þe com to him on nyht se wæs hyra an, - .

text: Cwyst þū dēmð ūre ǣ ǣnigne man, būton hyne man ǣr gehȳre, and wite hwæt hē dō?
text_bare: Cwyst þu demð ure æ ænigne man, buton hyne man ær gehyre, and wite hwæt he do?

text: Hig andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Cwyst þū þæt þū sī Galileisc?
text_bare: Hig andswaredon and cwædon to him, Cwyst þu þæt þu si Galileisc?

text: Smēa, and geseoh þæt nān wītega ne cymð fram Galilea.
text_bare: Smea, and geseoh þæt nan witega ne cymð fram Galilea.

text: And hig cyrdon ealle hām.
text_bare: And hig cyrdon ealle ham.

text: Sē Hǣlend fōr on Oliuetes dūne.
text_bare: Se Hælend for on Oliuetes dune.

text: And cōm eft on dægrēd tō þām temple, and eall þæt folc cōm tō him; and hē sæt, and lǣrde hig.
text_bare: And com eft on dægred to þam temple, and eall þæt folc com to him; and he sæt, and lærde hig.

text: Ða lǣddon þā Pharisei and ðā bōceras tō him ān wīf, sēo wǣs āparod on unrihthǣmede, and setton hig tōmiddes hyra,
text_bare: Ða læddon þa Pharisei and ða boceras to him an wif, seo wæs aparod on unrihthæmede, and setton hig tomiddes hyra,

text: and cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, þis wīf wæs āfunden on unrihtum hǣmede.
text_bare: and cwædon to him, Lareow, þis wif wæs afunden on unrihtum hæmede.

text: Moyes ūs bebead on þǣre ǣ þæt wē sceoldon þus gerāde mid stānum oftorfian; hwæt cwyst þū?
text_bare: Moyes us bebead on þære æ þæt we sceoldon þus gerade mid stanum oftorfian; hwæt cwyst þu?

text: Ðis hig cwǣdon his fandiende, þæt hig hine wrēhton.
text_bare: Ðis hig cwædon his fandiende, þæt hig hine wrehton.

text: Sē Hǣlend ābēah nyþer, and wrāt mid his fingre on þǣre eorþan.
text_bare: Se Hælend abeah nyþer, and wrat mid his fingre on þære eorþan.

text: Þā hig þurhwunedon hine āxsiende, þā ārās hē ūpp, and cwæð tō him, Lōca, hwylc ēower sī synlēas, wurpe ǣrest stān on hī.
text_bare: Þa hig þurhwunedon hine axsiende, þa aras he upp, and cwæð to him, Loca, hwylc eower si synleas, wurpe ærest stan on hi.

text: And hē ābēah eft, and wrāt on þǣre eorþan.
text_bare: And he abeah eft, and wrat on þære eorþan.

text: Ðā hig þis gehȳrdon, þā ēodon hig ūt, ān æfter ānum; and hē gebād þār sylf, and þæt wīf stōd þǣr on middan.
text_bare: Ða hig þis gehyrdon, þa eodon hig ut, an æfter anum; and he gebad þar sylf, and þæt wif stod þær on middan.

text: Sē Hǣlend ārās upp, and cwæð tō hyre, Wīf, hwǣr synd þā ðe þē wrēgdon?
text_bare: Se Hælend aras upp, and cwæð to hyre, Wif, hwær synd þa ðe þe wregdon?

text: ne fordēmde þē nān man?
text_bare: ne fordemde þe nan man?

text: And hēo cwæð, Nā, Drihten.
text_bare: And heo cwæð, Na, Drihten.

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð, Nē ic þē ne fordēme; dō gā, and ne synga þū nǣfre mā.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð, Ne ic þe ne fordeme; do ga, and ne synga þu næfre ma.

text: Eft sē Hǣlend spræc þās þing tō him and cwæð, Ic eom middaneardes lēoht; sē þe mē fyliþ ne gǣð hē ōn þȳstro, ac hē hæfð līfes lēoht.
text_bare: Eft se Hælend spræc þas þing to him and cwæð, Ic eom middaneardes leoht; se þe me fyliþ ne gæð he on þystro, ac he hæfð lifes leoht.

text: Ða Pharisei cwǣdon tō him, Þū cȳþst gewitnesse be ðē sylfon; nis ðīn gewitnes sōð.
text_bare: Ða Pharisei cwædon to him, Þu cyþst gewitnesse be ðe sylfon; nis ðin gewitnes soð.

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarede and cwæð tō him, Gif ic cȳþe gewitnesse be mē sylfum, mīn gewitnes is sōþ; for þām þe ic wāt hwanon ic cōm, and hwyder ic gā; gē nyton hwanon ic cōm, nē hwyder ic gā.
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarede and cwæð to him, Gif ic cyþe gewitnesse be me sylfum, min gewitnes is soþ; for þam þe ic wat hwanon ic com, and hwyder ic ga; ge nyton hwanon ic com, ne hwyder ic ga.

text: Gē dēmað æfter flǣsce; ic ne dēme nānum men.
text_bare: Ge demað æfter flæsce; ic ne deme nanum men.

text: And gif ic dēme, mīn dōm is sōð; for ðām þe ic ne eom āna, ac ic and sē Fæder þe mē sende.
text_bare: And gif ic deme, min dom is soð; for ðam þe ic ne eom ana, ac ic and se Fæder þe me sende.

text: And on ēowre ǣ is āwriten þæt twēgra manna gewitnes is sōð.
text_bare: And on eowre æ is awriten þæt twegra manna gewitnes is soð.

text: Ic eom þe cȳpe gewitnesse be mē sylfum, and sē Fæder þe mē sende cȳþ gewitnesse be mē.
text_bare: Ic eom þe cype gewitnesse be me sylfum, and se Fæder þe me sende cyþ gewitnesse be me.

text: Witodlīce hig cwǣdon to him, Hwār is þin Fæder?
text_bare: Witodlice hig cwædon to him, Hwar is þin Fæder?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Nē cunne gē mē, nē mīnne Fæder; gyf gē mē cūþon, wēn is þæt gē cūþon minne Fæder.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Ne cunne ge me, ne minne Fæder; gyf ge me cuþon, wen is þæt ge cuþon minne Fæder.

text: Ðās word hē spæc æt cēapsceamule; and nān man hyne ne nam, for þām þe hys tīd ne cōm þā gȳt.
text_bare: Ðas word he spæc æt ceapsceamule; and nan man hyne ne nam, for þam þe hys tid ne com þa gyt.

text: Witodlīce eft sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him,
text_bare: Witodlice eft se Hælend cwæþ to him,

text: Ic fare, and gē mē sēceað, and gē sweltaþ; on ēowre synne; ne mage gē cuman þyder ic fare.
text_bare: Ic fare, and ge me seceað, and ge sweltaþ; on eowre synne; ne mage ge cuman þyder ic fare.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas, Cweðe gē ofslyhþ hē hine sylfne, for þām hē segð, Gē ne magon cuman þyder ic fare?
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa Iudeas, Cweðe ge ofslyhþ he hine sylfne, for þam he segð, Ge ne magon cuman þyder ic fare?

text: Ðā cwæþ hē tō him, Gē synt nyþane; and ic eom ufane: ge synt of þison middanearde; ic ne eom of þissan middanearde.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he to him, Ge synt nyþane; and ic eom ufane: ge synt of þison middanearde; ic ne eom of þissan middanearde.

text: Ic ēow sǣde þæt gē sweltað on ēowrum synnum; gif gē ne gelȳfað þæt ic hit sȳ, gē sweltað on ēowre synne.
text_bare: Ic eow sæde þæt ge sweltað on eowrum synnum; gif ge ne gelyfað þæt ic hit sy, ge sweltað on eowre synne.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hī tō him, Hwæt eart þū?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hi to him, Hwæt eart þu?

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom fruma þe tō ēow sprece.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Ic eom fruma þe to eow sprece.

text: Ic haebbe fela be ēow tō sprecenne and tō dēmenne; ac sē þe mē sende is soðfæst; and ic sprece on middanearde þā þing þe ic æt him gehȳrde.
text_bare: Ic haebbe fela be eow to sprecenne and to demenne; ac se þe me sende is soðfæst; and ic sprece on middanearde þa þing þe ic æt him gehyrde.

text: And hig ne undergēaton þæt hē tealde him God tō Fæder.
text_bare: And hig ne undergeaton þæt he tealde him God to Fæder.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Þonne gē mannes Sunu ūpp āhebbaþ, þonne gecnāwe gē þæt ic hit eom, and ic ne dō nān þing of mē sylfum, ac ic sprece þās þing swā Fæder mē lǣrde.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Þonne ge mannes Sunu upp ahebbaþ, þonne gecnawe ge þæt ic hit eom, and ic ne do nan þing of me sylfum, ac ic sprece þas þing swa Fæder me lærde.

text: And sē ðe mē sende is mid mē; and hē ne forlǣt mē ānne; for þām þe ic wyrce symble þā þing þe him synt gecwēme.
text_bare: And se ðe me sende is mid me; and he ne forlæt me anne; for þam þe ic wyrce symble þa þing þe him synt gecweme.

text: Ðā he ðās ðing spræc, manega gelȳfdon on hine,
text_bare: Ða he ðas ðing spræc, manega gelyfdon on hine,

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæð tō þām Iudeon þe him gelȳfdon, Gif gē wunegeað on mīnre spǣce, sōðlīce gē bēoð mīne leorningcnihtas;
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend cwæð to þam Iudeon þe him gelyfdon, Gif ge wunegeað on minre spæce, soðlice ge beoð mine leorningcnihtas;

text: and gē oncnāwað sōðfæstnysse, and sōþfæstnes ēow ālȳst.
text_bare: and ge oncnawað soðfæstnysse, and soþfæstnes eow alyst.

text: Ðā andswarodon hī him and cwǣdon, Wē synt Abrahames cynnes, and ne þēowedon wē nanum men nǣfre; hūmeta cwyst þū, Gē bēoð frīge?
text_bare: Ða andswarodon hi him and cwædon, We synt Abrahames cynnes, and ne þeowedon we nanum men næfre; humeta cwyst þu, Ge beoð frige?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Þæt þe synne wyrcð is þǣre synne þēow.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarude and cwæð, Soþ ic eow secge, Þæt þe synne wyrcð is þære synne þeow.

text: Witodlīce sē þēow ne wunaþ on hūse on ēcnesse; sē sunu wunaþ on ēcnesse.
text_bare: Witodlice se þeow ne wunaþ on huse on ecnesse; se sunu wunaþ on ecnesse.

text: Gif sē Sunu ēow alyst, gē bēoð soðlīce frīge.
text_bare: Gif se Sunu eow alyst, ge beoð soðlice frige.

text: Ic wāt þæt gē synt Abrahames bearn; ac gē sēceað mē tō ofslēanne, for þām mīn spǣc ne wunaþ on ēow.
text_bare: Ic wat þæt ge synt Abrahames bearn; ac ge seceað me to ofsleanne, for þam min spæc ne wunaþ on eow.

text: Ic sprece þæt þe ic mid Fæder geseah; and gē dōð þā þing þē gē mid ēowrum fæder gesāwon.
text_bare: Ic sprece þæt þe ic mid Fæder geseah; and ge doð þa þing þe ge mid eowrum fæder gesawon.

text: Ðā andswarodon hig and cwǣdon tō him, Abraham is ūre fæder.
text_bare: Ða andswarodon hig and cwædon to him, Abraham is ure fæder.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gif gē Abrahames bearn synt, wyrceað Abrahames weorc.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Gif ge Abrahames bearn synt, wyrceað Abrahames weorc.

text: Nū gē seceað mē tō ofslēanne, þone man þe ēow sǣde sōðfæstnesse, þā þe ic gehȳrde of Gode; ne dyde Abraham swā.
