text_bare: Nu ge seceað me to ofsleanne, þone man þe eow sæde soðfæstnesse, þa þe ic gehyrde of Gode; ne dyde Abraham swa.

text: Gē wyrceað ēowres fæder weorc.
text_bare: Ge wyrceað eowres fæder weorc.

text: Hig cwǣdon witodlīce tō him, Ne synt wē of forligere acennede; we habbað ānne God tō Fæder.
text_bare: Hig cwædon witodlice to him, Ne synt we of forligere acennede; we habbað anne God to Fæder.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him, Gif God wǣre ēowre Faeder, witodlīce gē lufedon mē.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend cwæþ to him, Gif God wære eowre Faeder, witodlice ge lufedon me.

text: Ic cōm of Gode; nē cōm ic nā fram mē sylfon, ac hē mē sende.
text_bare: Ic com of Gode; ne com ic na fram me sylfon, ac he me sende.

text: Hwī ne gecnāwe gē mīne sprǣce?
text_bare: Hwi ne gecnawe ge mine spræce?

text: for þām þe gē ne magon gehȳran mīne spǣce.
text_bare: for þam þe ge ne magon gehyran mine spæce.

text: Gē synt dēofles bearn, and gē wyllaþ wyrcean ēowres fæder willan.
text_bare: Ge synt deofles bearn, and ge wyllaþ wyrcean eowres fæder willan.

text: Hē wæs fram frymþe manslaga, and hē ne wunode on sōðfæstnesse, for ðām þe sōðfæstnes nis on him.
text_bare: He wæs fram frymþe manslaga, and he ne wunode on soðfæstnesse, for ðam þe soðfæstnes nis on him.

text: Ðonne he sprycð lēasunga, hē sprycþ of him sylfum, for þām þe hē is lēas and his fæder ēac.
text_bare: Ðonne he sprycð leasunga, he sprycþ of him sylfum, for þam þe he is leas and his fæder eac.

text: Witodlīce gē ne gelȳfað mē, for þām þe ic secge ēow sōdfæstnysse.
text_bare: Witodlice ge ne gelyfað me, for þam þe ic secge eow sodfæstnysse.

text: Hwylc ēower āscunað mē for synne?
text_bare: Hwylc eower ascunað me for synne?

text: Gif ic sōð secge, hwī ne gelȳfe gē mē?
text_bare: Gif ic soð secge, hwi ne gelyfe ge me?

text: Sē þe is of Gode gehȳrð Godes word; for þig gē ne gehȳrað, for þām þe gē ne synt of Gode.
text_bare: Se þe is of Gode gehyrð Godes word; for þig ge ne gehyrað, for þam þe ge ne synt of Gode.

text: Witodlīce þā Iudeas andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Hwi ne cweþe wē wel þæt ðū eart Samaritanisc, and eart wōd?
text_bare: Witodlice þa Iudeas andswaredon and cwædon to him, Hwi ne cweþe we wel þæt ðu eart Samaritanisc, and eart wod?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð, Ne eom ic wōd; ac ic ārwurþige mīnne Fæder, and gē unārwurðedon mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarude and cwæð, Ne eom ic wod; ac ic arwurþige minne Fæder, and ge unarwurðedon me.

text: Witodlīce ne sēce ic mīn wuldor; sē is þe sēcð and dēmð.
text_bare: Witodlice ne sece ic min wuldor; se is þe secð and demð.

text: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Gif hwā mīne sprǣce gehealt, ne gesyhþ hē dēað nǣfre.
text_bare: Soðlice ic secge eow, Gif hwa mine spræce gehealt, ne gesyhþ he deað næfre.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas, Nū wē witon þæt þū eart wōd.
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa Iudeas, Nu we witon þæt þu eart wod.

text: Abraham wæs dēad, and þā witegan; and þū cwyst, Gif hwā mīne sprǣce gehealt, ne bið hē nǣfre dēad.
text_bare: Abraham wæs dead, and þa witegan; and þu cwyst, Gif hwa mine spræce gehealt, ne bið he næfre dead.

text: Cwyst þū þæt þū sȳ mǣrra þonne ūre fæder Abraham, sē wæs dēad?
text_bare: Cwyst þu þæt þu sy mærra þonne ure fæder Abraham, se wæs dead?

text: and þā wītegan wǣron dēade; hwæt þincð þē þæt þū sȳ?
text_bare: and þa witegan wæron deade; hwæt þincð þe þæt þu sy?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Gif ic wuldrige mē sylfne, nis mīn wuldor nāht; mīn Fæder is þe mē wuldrað, be þæm gē cweðaþ; þæt hē sȳ ūre God.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode, Gif ic wuldrige me sylfne, nis min wuldor naht; min Fæder is þe me wuldrað, be þæm ge cweðaþ; þæt he sy ure God.

text: And gē ne cūðon hine.
text_bare: And ge ne cuðon hine.

text: Ic hyne cann; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic bēo lēasē and ēow gelīc; ac ic hyne cann, and ic healde his sprǣce.
text_bare: Ic hyne cann; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic beo lease and eow gelic; ac ic hyne cann, and ic healde his spræce.

text: Abraham ēower fæder geblissode þæt hē gesāwe mīnne dæg; and hē geseah, and geblissode.
text_bare: Abraham eower fæder geblissode þæt he gesawe minne dæg; and he geseah, and geblissode.

text: Ðā Iudeas cwǣdon tō him, Gȳt þū ne eart fīftigwintre, and gesāwe þū Abraham?
text_bare: Ða Iudeas cwædon to him, Gyt þu ne eart fiftigwintre, and gesawe þu Abraham?

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him, Ic wæs ǣr þām þe Abraham wæs.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæþ to him, Ic wæs ær þam þe Abraham wæs.

text: Hig nāmon stanas tō þām þæt hig woldon hyne torfian; sē Hǣlend hine bedīglode, and ēode of ðām temple.
text_bare: Hig namon stanas to þam þæt hig woldon hyne torfian; se Hælend hine bediglode, and eode of ðam temple.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend fōr, þā gesēah hē ānne man þe wæs blind geboren.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend for, þa geseah he anne man þe wæs blind geboren.

text: And his leorningcnihtas hine āxodon and cwǣdon, Lārēow, hwæt syngode, þēs oððe his māgas, þæt hē wǣre blind geboren?
text_bare: And his leorningcnihtas hine axodon and cwædon, Lareow, hwæt syngode, þes oððe his magas, þæt he wære blind geboren?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð, ne syngode hē nē his māgas; ac þæt Godes weorc wǣre geswutelod on him.
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarude and cwæð, ne syngode he ne his magas; ac þæt Godes weorc wære geswutelod on him.

text: Mē gebyrað tō wyrceanne þæs weorc þe mē sende, þā hwīle þe hit dæg is; niht cymþ, þonne nān man wyrcan ne mæg.
text_bare: Me gebyrað to wyrceanne þæs weorc þe me sende, þa hwile þe hit dæg is; niht cymþ, þonne nan man wyrcan ne mæg.

text: Ic eom middaneardes lēoht, þā hwīle þe ic on middanearde eom.
text_bare: Ic eom middaneardes leoht, þa hwile þe ic on middanearde eom.

text: Ðā hē þās þing sǣde, þā spǣtte hē on þā eorþan, and worhte fenn of his spātle, and smyrede mid þām fenne ofer his ēagan,
text_bare: Ða he þas þing sæde, þa spætte he on þa eorþan, and worhte fenn of his spatle, and smyrede mid þam fenne ofer his eagan,

text: and cwæð tō him, Gā and þweah þē on Syloes mere.
text_bare: and cwæð to him, Ga and þweah þe on Syloes mere.

text: Hē fōr and þwōh hine, and cōm gesēonde.
text_bare: He for and þwoh hine, and com geseonde.

text: Witodlīce his nēahgebūras and þā þe hine gesāwon þā hē wǣdla was cwǣdon, Hū nis þis se ðe sæt and wǣdlode?
text_bare: Witodlice his neahgeburas and þa þe hine gesawon þa he wædla was cwædon, Hu nis þis se ðe sæt and wædlode?

text: Sume cwǣdon, Hē hyt is; sume cwǣdon, Nese, ac is him gelīc.
text_bare: Sume cwædon, He hyt is; sume cwædon, Nese, ac is him gelic.

text: Hē cwæþ sōðlīce, Ic hit eom.
text_bare: He cwæþ soðlice, Ic hit eom.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hū wǣron þīne ēagan geopenede?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig to him, Hu wæron þine eagan geopenede?

text: Hē andswarode and cwæð, Sē man þe is genemned Hǣlend worhte fenn, and smyrede mīne ēagan, and cwæð tō mē, Gā tō Syloes mere, and þweah þē; and ic ēode and þwōh mē, and geseah.
text_bare: He andswarode and cwæð, Se man þe is genemned Hælend worhte fenn, and smyrede mine eagan, and cwæð to me, Ga to Syloes mere, and þweah þe; and ic eode and þwoh me, and geseah.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hwār is hē?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig to him, Hwar is he?

text: Þā cwæð hē, Ic nāt.
text_bare: Þa cwæð he, Ic nat.

text: Hig lǣddon tō þām Phariseon þone þe þār blind wæs.
text_bare: Hig læddon to þam Phariseon þone þe þar blind wæs.

text: Hit was restedæg þā sē Hǣlend worhte þæt fenn, and his ēagan untȳnde.
text_bare: Hit was restedæg þa se Hælend worhte þæt fenn, and his eagan untynde.

text: Eft þā Pharisei hyne āxsedon hū hē gesāwe.
text_bare: Eft þa Pharisei hyne axsedon hu he gesawe.

text: He cwæð tō him, Hē dyde fenn ofer mīne ēagan, and ic þwōh, and ic gesēo.
text_bare: He cwæð to him, He dyde fenn ofer mine eagan, and ic þwoh, and ic geseo.

text: Sume þā Pharisei cwadon, Nis ðēs man of Gode þe restedæg ne healt.
text_bare: Sume þa Pharisei cwadon, Nis ðes man of Gode þe restedæg ne healt.

text: Sume cwǣdon, Hū mæg synful mann þās tācn wyrcean?
text_bare: Sume cwædon, Hu mæg synful mann þas tacn wyrcean?

text: And hig fliton him betwēonan.
text_bare: And hig fliton him betweonan.

text: Hig cwǣdon eft tō þām blindan, Hwæt segst þū be þām þe þīne ēagan untȳnde?
text_bare: Hig cwædon eft to þam blindan, Hwæt segst þu be þam þe þine eagan untynde?

text: Hē cwæð, Hē is wītega.
text_bare: He cwæð, He is witega.

text: Ne gelyfdon þā Iudeas be him, þæt hē blind wǣre and gesāwe, ǣr þam þe hig clypodon his māgas þe gesāwon,
text_bare: Ne gelyfdon þa Iudeas be him, þæt he blind wære and gesawe, ær þam þe hig clypodon his magas þe gesawon,

text: and āxodon hig and cwǣdon, Is ðis ēower sunu þe gē secgað þæt blind wǣre ācenned?
text_bare: and axodon hig and cwædon, Is ðis eower sunu þe ge secgað þæt blind wære acenned?

text: hūmeta gesyhþ hē nū?
text_bare: humeta gesyhþ he nu?

text: Hys māgas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, We witon þæt þēs is ūre sunu, and þæt hē wæs blind ācenned;
text_bare: Hys magas him andswaredon and cwædon, We witon þæt þes is ure sunu, and þæt he wæs blind acenned;

text: wē nyton hūmete hē nū gesyhþ, nē hwā his ēagan untȳnde; axiað hine sylfne; ylde hē hæfð; sprece for hine sylfne.
text_bare: we nyton humete he nu gesyhþ, ne hwa his eagan untynde; axiað hine sylfne; ylde he hæfð; sprece for hine sylfne.

text: His māgas spǣcon þās þing, for þām þe hig ondrēdon þā Iudeas; ðā gedihton þā Iudeas, gif hwā Crīst andette, þæt hē wǣre būtan hyra gefērrǣdene.
text_bare: His magas spæcon þas þing, for þam þe hig ondredon þa Iudeas; ða gedihton þa Iudeas, gif hwa Crist andette, þæt he wære butan hyra geferrædene.

text: For þām cwǣdon his māgas, Hē hæfþ ylde; āxiað hine sylfne.
text_bare: For þam cwædon his magas, He hæfþ ylde; axiað hine sylfne.

text: Ðā clypodon hig eft þone mann þe ǣr blind wæs, and cwǣdon tō him, Sege Gode wuldor; wē witon þæt hē is synful.
text_bare: Ða clypodon hig eft þone mann þe ær blind wæs, and cwædon to him, Sege Gode wuldor; we witon þæt he is synful.

text: And hē cwæð, Gif hē synful is, þæt ic nāt; ān þing ic wāt, þæt ic wæs blind, and þæt ic nū gesēo.
text_bare: And he cwæð, Gif he synful is, þæt ic nat; an þing ic wat, þæt ic wæs blind, and þæt ic nu geseo.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hwæt dyde hē þē?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hig to him, Hwæt dyde he þe?

text: hū ontȳnde hē þīne ēagan?
text_bare: hu ontynde he þine eagan?

text: Hē andswarode him and cwæð, Ic ēow sǣde ǣr, and gē gehȳrdon; hwī wylle gē hyt eft gehȳran?
text_bare: He andswarode him and cwæð, Ic eow sæde ær, and ge gehyrdon; hwi wylle ge hyt eft gehyran?

text: cweðe gē wylle gē bēon his leorningcnihtas?
text_bare: cweðe ge wylle ge beon his leorningcnihtas?

text: Þā wyrigdon hig hine, and cwǣdon, Sī þū his leorningcniht; wē synt Moyses leorningcnihtas.
text_bare: Þa wyrigdon hig hine, and cwædon, Si þu his leorningcniht; we synt Moyses leorningcnihtas.

text: Wē witon þæt God spæc wiþ Moyses; nyte wē hwanon þēs is.
text_bare: We witon þæt God spæc wiþ Moyses; nyte we hwanon þes is.

text: Sē man andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þæt is wundorlīc þæt gē nyton hwanon hē is, and hē untȳnde mīne ēagan.
text_bare: Se man andswarode and cwæð to him, Þæt is wundorlic þæt ge nyton hwanon he is, and he untynde mine eagan.

text: Wē witon sōþlīce þæt God ne gehȳrþ synfulle; ac gif hwā is Gode gecoren, and his willan wyrcð, þone hē gehȳrð.
text_bare: We witon soþlice þæt God ne gehyrþ synfulle; ac gif hwa is Gode gecoren, and his willan wyrcð, þone he gehyrð.

text: Ne gehȳrde wē nǣfre on worulde þæt ǣnig ontȳnde þæs ēagan þe wǣre blind geboren.
text_bare: Ne gehyrde we næfre on worulde þæt ænig ontynde þæs eagan þe wære blind geboren.

text: Ne mihte þēs nān þing dōn, gif hē nǣre of Gode.
text_bare: Ne mihte þes nan þing don, gif he nære of Gode.

text: Hig andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Eall þū eart on synnum geboren, and þū lǣrst ūs?
text_bare: Hig andswaredon and cwædon to him, Eall þu eart on synnum geboren, and þu lærst us?

text: And hig drifon hine ūt.
text_bare: And hig drifon hine ut.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend gehȳrde þæt hig hyne drifon ūt, þā cwæð hē tō him, þā hē hine gemitte, Gelȳfst þū on Godes Sunu?
text_bare: Ða se Hælend gehyrde þæt hig hyne drifon ut, þa cwæð he to him, þa he hine gemitte, Gelyfst þu on Godes Sunu?

text: Hē andswarude and cwæð, Hwylc is, Drihten, þæt ic on hine gelȳfe?
text_bare: He andswarude and cwæð, Hwylc is, Drihten, þæt ic on hine gelyfe?

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, þū hine gesāwe, and sē ðe wið þē sprycð, sē hit is.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to him, þu hine gesawe, and se ðe wið þe sprycð, se hit is.

text: Ðā cwæþ hē, Drihten, ic gelȳfe.
text_bare: Ða cwæþ he, Drihten, ic gelyfe.

text: And hē fēoll nyþer, and geēaðmēdde hyne.
text_bare: And he feoll nyþer, and geeaðmedde hyne.

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic cōm on þysne middaneard tō dēmenne, þæt þā sceolon gesēon þe ne gesēoð; and bēon blinde þā þe gesēoð.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to him, Ic com on þysne middaneard to demenne, þæt þa sceolon geseon þe ne geseoð; and beon blinde þa þe geseoð.

text: Ðā þæt gehyrdon þā Pharisei þe mid him wǣron, ðā cwǣdon hig tō hym, Cwyst þū synt wē blinde?
text_bare: Ða þæt gehyrdon þa Pharisei þe mid him wæron, ða cwædon hig to hym, Cwyst þu synt we blinde?

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Gif gē blinde wǣron, næfde gē nāne synne.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to him, Gif ge blinde wæron, næfde ge nane synne.

text: Nu gē secgað þæt gē gesēon; þæt is ēowre synn.
text_bare: Nu ge secgað þæt ge geseon; þæt is eowre synn.

text: Sōþ ic secge ēow, Sē þe ne gǣð æt þām gete intō scēapa falde, ac stȳhþ elles ofer, hē is þēof and sceaða.
text_bare: Soþ ic secge eow, Se þe ne gæð æt þam gete into sceapa falde, ac styhþ elles ofer, he is þeof and sceaða.

text: Sē þe in gǣþ æt þām geate, hē is scēapa hyrde.
text_bare: Se þe in gæþ æt þam geate, he is sceapa hyrde.

text: Þone sē geatweard lǣt in; and þā scēap gehȳrað his stefne; and hē nemð his āgene scēap be naman, and lǣt hig ūt.
text_bare: Þone se geatweard læt in; and þa sceap gehyrað his stefne; and he nemð his agene sceap be naman, and læt hig ut.

text: And þonne hē his āgene scēap lǣt ūt, hē gǣð beforan him, and þā scēap him fyligeað, for þām þe hig gecnāwað his stefne.
text_bare: And þonne he his agene sceap læt ut, he gæð beforan him, and þa sceap him fyligeað, for þam þe hig gecnawað his stefne.

text: Ne fyligeaþ hig uncūþum, ac flēoð fram him, for ðām þe hig ne gecnēowun uncūðra stefne.
text_bare: Ne fyligeaþ hig uncuþum, ac fleoð fram him, for ðam þe hig ne gecneowun uncuðra stefne.

text: Ðis bigspell sē Hǣlend him sǣde; hig nyston hwæt hē spræc tō him.
text_bare: Ðis bigspell se Hælend him sæde; hig nyston hwæt he spræc to him.

text: Eft sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ic eom scēapa geat.
text_bare: Eft se Hælend cwæð to him, Soþ ic eow secge, Ic eom sceapa geat.

text: Ealle þā þe cōmun wǣron þēofas and sceaþan; ac þā scēap hig ne gehȳrdon.
text_bare: Ealle þa þe comun wæron þeofas and sceaþan; ac þa sceap hig ne gehyrdon.

text: Ic eom geat; swā hwylc swā þurh mē gǣð byð hāl, and gǣð in and ūt, and fint lǣse.
text_bare: Ic eom geat; swa hwylc swa þurh me gæð byð hal, and gæð in and ut, and fint læse.

text: Þēof ne cymð būton þæt hē stele, and slēa, and fordō; ic com tō þām þæt hig habbon līf, and habbon genōh.
text_bare: Þeof ne cymð buton þæt he stele, and slea, and fordo; ic com to þam þæt hig habbon lif, and habbon genoh.

text: Ic eom gōd hyrde; gōd hyrde sylþ his līf for his scēapon.
text_bare: Ic eom god hyrde; god hyrde sylþ his lif for his sceapon.

text: Sē hȳra, sē þe nis hyrde, and sē þe nāh þā scēap, þonne hē þone wulf gesyhþ, þonne flȳhþ hē and forlǣt þā scēap, and sē wulf nimð and tōdrīfð ðā scēap.
text_bare: Se hyra, se þe nis hyrde, and se þe nah þa sceap, þonne he þone wulf gesyhþ, þonne flyhþ he and forlæt þa sceap, and se wulf nimð and todrifð ða sceap.

text: Sē hȳra flȳhþ for þām þe hē bið āhȳrod, and him ne gebyrað tō þām scēapum.
text_bare: Se hyra flyhþ for þam þe he bið ahyrod, and him ne gebyrað to þam sceapum.

text: Ic eom gōd hyrde; and ic gecnāwe mīne scēap, and hig gecnāwað mē,
text_bare: Ic eom god hyrde; and ic gecnawe mine sceap, and hig gecnawað me,

text: swā mīn Fæder can mē, and ic can mīnne Fæder; and ic sylle mīn āgen līf for mīnum scēapum.
text_bare: swa min Fæder can me, and ic can minne Fæder; and ic sylle min agen lif for minum sceapum.

text: And ic hæbbe ōðre scēap, þā ne synt of ðisse heorde; and hit gebyrað þæt ic lǣde þā, and hig gehȳrað mīne stefne; and hyt byþ ān heord, and ān hyrde.
text_bare: And ic hæbbe oðre sceap, þa ne synt of ðisse heorde; and hit gebyrað þæt ic læde þa, and hig gehyrað mine stefne; and hyt byþ an heord, and an hyrde.

text: For þām Fæder mē lufað, for þām pe ic sylle mīne sāwle, and hig eft nime.
text_bare: For þam Fæder me lufað, for þam pe ic sylle mine sawle, and hig eft nime.

text: Ne nimð hig nān man æt mē, ac lǣte hig fram mē sylfum.
text_bare: Ne nimð hig nan man æt me, ac læte hig fram me sylfum.

text: Ic hæbbe anweald mīne sāwle tō ālǣtanne, and ic hæbbe anweald hig eft tō nimanne.
text_bare: Ic hæbbe anweald mine sawle to alætanne, and ic hæbbe anweald hig eft to nimanne.

text: Þis bebod ic nam æt mīnum Fæder.
text_bare: Þis bebod ic nam æt minum Fæder.

text: Eft wæs ungeðwǣrnes geworden betwyx þām Iudeum for þysum sprǣcum.
text_bare: Eft wæs ungeðwærnes geworden betwyx þam Iudeum for þysum spræcum.

text: Manega hyra cwǣdon, Dēofol is on him, and hē wēt; hwī hlyste gē him?
text_bare: Manega hyra cwædon, Deofol is on him, and he wet; hwi hlyste ge him?

text: Sume cwǣdon, Ne synt nā þās wōdes mannes word.
text_bare: Sume cwædon, Ne synt na þas wodes mannes word.

text: Cwyst þū mæg wōd man blindra manna ēagan ontȳnan?
text_bare: Cwyst þu mæg wod man blindra manna eagan ontynan?

text: Þā wāron templhālgunga on Ierusalem, and hit wæs winter.
text_bare: Þa waron templhalgunga on Ierusalem, and hit wæs winter.

text: And sē Hǣlend ēode on þām temple on Salomones portice.
text_bare: And se Hælend eode on þam temple on Salomones portice.

text: Ðā bestōdon þā Iudeas hyne ūtan, and cwǣdon tō him, Hū lange gǣlst þū ūre līf?
text_bare: Ða bestodon þa Iudeas hyne utan, and cwædon to him, Hu lange gælst þu ure lif?

text: Sege ūs openlīce hwæþer þū Crīst sȳ.
text_bare: Sege us openlice hwæþer þu Crist sy.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Ic spece tō ēow, and gē ne gelȳfað; þā weorc þe ic wyrce on mīnes Fæder naman, þā cȳþaþ gewitnesse be mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæþ, Ic spece to eow, and ge ne gelyfað; þa weorc þe ic wyrce on mines Fæder naman, þa cyþaþ gewitnesse be me.

text: Ac gē ne gelȳfað, for þām þe gē ne synt of mīnum scēapum.
text_bare: Ac ge ne gelyfað, for þam þe ge ne synt of minum sceapum.

text: Mīne scēap gehȳraþ mīne stefne, and ic gecnāwe hig, and hig folgiað mē;
text_bare: Mine sceap gehyraþ mine stefne, and ic gecnawe hig, and hig folgiað me;

text: and ic him sylle ēce līf, and hig ne forwurðaþ nǣfre, and ne nimð hig nān man of mīnre handa.
text_bare: and ic him sylle ece lif, and hig ne forwurðaþ næfre, and ne nimð hig nan man of minre handa.

text: Þæt þe mīn Fæder mē sealde is mǣrre þonne ǣnig ōðer ðing; and ne mæg hit nān man niman of mīnes Fæder handa.
text_bare: Þæt þe min Fæder me sealde is mærre þonne ænig oðer ðing; and ne mæg hit nan man niman of mines Fæder handa.

text: Ic and Fæder synt ān.
text_bare: Ic and Fæder synt an.

text: Ðā Iudeas nāmon stānas þæt hig woldon hyne torfian.
text_bare: Ða Iudeas namon stanas þæt hig woldon hyne torfian.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Manega gōde weorc ic ēow ætēowde be mīnum Fæder; for hwylcum þǣra weorca wylle gē mē hǣnan?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Manega gode weorc ic eow æteowde be minum Fæder; for hwylcum þæra weorca wylle ge me hænan?

text: Þā Iudeas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, Ne hǣne we ðē for gōdum weorce; ac for þīnre bysmorspǣce; and for þām þe þū eart man, and wyrcst þē tō Gode.
text_bare: Þa Iudeas him andswaredon and cwædon, Ne hæne we ðe for godum weorce; ac for þinre bysmorspæce; and for þam þe þu eart man, and wyrcst þe to Gode.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hū nys hit āwriten on ēowre ǣ, Þæt ic sǣde, Gē synt godas?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Hu nys hit awriten on eowre æ, Þæt ic sæde, Ge synt godas?

text: Gif hē þā tealde godas þe Godes spǣc tō wæs geworden, - and þæt hālige gewrit ne mæg bēon āwend,-
text_bare: Gif he þa tealde godas þe Godes spæc to wæs geworden, - and þæt halige gewrit ne mæg beon awend,-

text: þe Fæder gehālgode and sende on middaneard, gē secgað, þæt þū bysmor spycst; for þām ic sǣde, Ic eom Godes Sunu?
text_bare: þe Fæder gehalgode and sende on middaneard, ge secgað, þæt þu bysmor spycst; for þam ic sæde, Ic eom Godes Sunu?

text: Gif ic ne wyrce mīnes Fæder weorc, ne gelȳfað mē.
text_bare: Gif ic ne wyrce mines Fæder weorc, ne gelyfað me.

text: Gif ic wyrce mīnes Fæder weorc, and gif gē mē nellað gelȳfan, gelȳfað þām weorcum; þæt gē oncnāwun and gelȳfon þæt Fæder ys on mē, and ic on Fæder.
text_bare: Gif ic wyrce mines Fæder weorc, and gif ge me nellað gelyfan, gelyfað þam weorcum; þæt ge oncnawun and gelyfon þæt Fæder ys on me, and ic on Fæder.

text: Hig smēadon witodlīce embe þæt hig woldon hine gefōn; and hē ēode ūt fram him.
text_bare: Hig smeadon witodlice embe þæt hig woldon hine gefon; and he eode ut fram him.

text: And hē fōr eft ofer Iordanen tō þǣre stowe þe Iohannes wæs, and ǣrest on fullode; and hē wunode þār.
text_bare: And he for eft ofer Iordanen to þære stowe þe Iohannes wæs, and ærest on fullode; and he wunode þar.

text: And manega cōmon tō him, and cwǣdon, Witodlīce ne worhte Iohannes nān tācn; ealle þā þing þe Iohannes sǣde be þyson wǣron sōðe.
text_bare: And manega comon to him, and cwædon, Witodlice ne worhte Iohannes nan tacn; ealle þa þing þe Iohannes sæde be þyson wæron soðe.

text: And manega gelȳfdon on hyne.
text_bare: And manega gelyfdon on hyne.

text: Witodlīce sum sēoc man wæs genemned Lazarus, of Bethania, of Marian ceastre and of Martham his swustra.
text_bare: Witodlice sum seoc man wæs genemned Lazarus, of Bethania, of Marian ceastre and of Martham his swustra.

text: Hit was sēo Maria þe smyrede Drihten mid þǣre sealfe, and drīgde his fēt mid hyre loccon; Lazarus hyre brōðor wæs geyfled.
text_bare: Hit was seo Maria þe smyrede Drihten mid þære sealfe, and drigde his fet mid hyre loccon; Lazarus hyre broðor wæs geyfled.

text: His swustra sendon tō him and cwǣdon, Drihten, nū is sēoc sē ðe þū lufast.
text_bare: His swustra sendon to him and cwædon, Drihten, nu is seoc se ðe þu lufast.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend þæt gehȳrde, þā cwæð hē tō him, Nys þēos untrumnys nā for dēaðe, ac for Godes wuldre, þæt Godes Sunu sī gewuldrod þurh hyne.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þæt gehyrde, þa cwæð he to him, Nys þeos untrumnys na for deaðe, ac for Godes wuldre, þæt Godes Sunu si gewuldrod þurh hyne.

text: Sōðlīce sē Hælend lufode Martham, and hyre swustor Mariam, and Lazarum hyra brōðor.
text_bare: Soðlice se Hælend lufode Martham, and hyre swustor Mariam, and Lazarum hyra broðor.

text: Witodlīce hē was twēgen dagas on ðǣre sylfan stōwe, þā hē gehȳrde þǣt hē sēoc wæs.
text_bare: Witodlice he was twegen dagas on ðære sylfan stowe, þa he gehyrde þæt he seoc wæs.

text: Æfter þisson hē cwæð tō his leorningcnihton, Uton faran eft tō Iudea lande.
text_bare: Æfter þisson he cwæð to his leorningcnihton, Uton faran eft to Iudea lande.

text: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, nū þā Iudeas sōhton ðē þæt hig woldon þē hǣnan; and wylt þū eft faran ðyder?
text_bare: His leorningcnihtas cwædon to him, Lareow, nu þa Iudeas sohton ðe þæt hig woldon þe hænan; and wylt þu eft faran ðyder?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hū ne synt twelf tīda þæs dæges?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Hu ne synt twelf tida þæs dæges?

text: Gif hwā gǣð on dæg, ne ætspyrnð hē, for þām hē gesyhþ þyses middaneardes lēoht.
text_bare: Gif hwa gæð on dæg, ne ætspyrnð he, for þam he gesyhþ þyses middaneardes leoht.

text: Gif hē gǣð on niht, hē ætspyrnð, for þām þe lēoht nis on hyre.
text_bare: Gif he gæð on niht, he ætspyrnð, for þam þe leoht nis on hyre.

text: Ðās ðing hē cwæð; and syððan hē cwæð tō him, Lazarus ūre frēond slǣpð; ac ic wylle gān and āwreccan hyne of slǣpe.
text_bare: Ðas ðing he cwæð; and syððan he cwæð to him, Lazarus ure freond slæpð; ac ic wylle gan and awreccan hyne of slæpe.

text: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon, Drihten, gif hē slǣpð, hē byþ hāl.
text_bare: His leorningcnihtas cwædon, Drihten, gif he slæpð, he byþ hal.

text: Sē Hǣlend hit cwæð be his dēaþe; hi wēndon sōðlice þæt hē hyt sǣde be swefnes slǣpe.
text_bare: Se Hælend hit cwæð be his deaþe; hi wendon soðlice þæt he hyt sæde be swefnes slæpe.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend openlice tō him, Ladzarus ys dēad.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend openlice to him, Ladzarus ys dead.

text: And ic ēom blīþe for ēowrum þingon, þæt gē gelȳfon, for þām ic næs þār; ac uton gān tō him.
text_bare: And ic eom bliþe for eowrum þingon, þæt ge gelyfon, for þam ic næs þar; ac uton gan to him.

text: Ðā cwææð Thomas tō hys gefēran, Uton gān and sweltan mid him.
text_bare: Ða cwææð Thomas to hys geferan, Uton gan and sweltan mid him.

text: Ðā for sē Hǣlend, and gemette þæt hē wæs forðfaren, and for fēower dagon bebyrged.
text_bare: Ða for se Hælend, and gemette þæt he wæs forðfaren, and for feower dagon bebyrged.

text: Bethania ys gehende Ierusalem ofer fȳftȳne furlang.
text_bare: Bethania ys gehende Ierusalem ofer fyftyne furlang.

text: Manega þāra Iudea cōmon tō Martham and tō Marian þæt hig woldon hī frēfrian for hyra brōðor þingon.
text_bare: Manega þara Iudea comon to Martham and to Marian þæt hig woldon hi frefrian for hyra broðor þingon.

text: Ðā Martha gehȳrde þæt sē Hǣlend cōm, þā arn hēo ongēan hyne; and Maria sæt æt hām.
text_bare: Ða Martha gehyrde þæt se Hælend com, þa arn heo ongean hyne; and Maria sæt æt ham.

text: Ðā cwæð Martha to þām Hǣlende, Drihten, gif þū wǣre hēr, nǣre mīn brōðor dēad.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Martha to þam Hælende, Drihten, gif þu wære her, nære min broðor dead.

text: And ēac ic wāt nū þā þæt God þē sylð swā hwæt swā ðū hyne bitst.
text_bare: And eac ic wat nu þa þæt God þe sylð swa hwæt swa ðu hyne bitst.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Þīn brōðor ārīst.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Þin broðor arist.

text: And Martha cwæþ tō him, Ic wāt þæt hē ārīst on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: And Martha cwæþ to him, Ic wat þæt he arist on þam ytemestan dæge.

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Ic eom ǣryst, and līf; sē ðe gelȳfð on mē, þēah hē dead sȳ, hē leofað;
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð to hyre, Ic eom æryst, and lif; se ðe gelyfð on me, þeah he dead sy, he leofað;

text: and ne swylt nān þāra þe leofað and gelȳfð on mē.
text_bare: and ne swylt nan þara þe leofað and gelyfð on me.

text: Gelȳfst þū þyses?
text_bare: Gelyfst þu þyses?

text: Hēo cwæð tō him, Witodlīce Drihten, ic gelȳfe þæt þū eart Crīst, Godes Sunu, þe on middaneard cōme.
text_bare: Heo cwæð to him, Witodlice Drihten, ic gelyfe þæt þu eart Crist, Godes Sunu, þe on middaneard come.

text: And þā hēo ðās þing sǣde, hēo ēode and clypode diglīce Marian hyre swustor, þus cweþende, Hēr is ūre Lārēow, and clypað þē.
text_bare: And þa heo ðas þing sæde, heo eode and clypode diglice Marian hyre swustor, þus cweþende, Her is ure Lareow, and clypað þe.

text: Ðā hēo þæt gehȳrde, hēo ārās raðe and cōm tō him.
text_bare: Ða heo þæt gehyrde, heo aras raðe and com to him.

text: Þā gȳt ne cōm sē Hǣlend binnan þā ceastre, ac wæs ðā gȳt on ðǣre stōwe þār Martha him ongēan cōm.
text_bare: Þa gyt ne com se Hælend binnan þa ceastre, ac wæs ða gyt on ðære stowe þar Martha him ongean com.

text: Þā Iudeas þe wǣron mid hyre on hūse and hī frēfrodon, þā hig gesāwon þæt Maria ārās and mid ofste ūt ēode, hig fyligdon hyre, ðus cweþende, Hēo gǣð tō his byrgenne þæt hēo wēpe þār.
text_bare: Þa Iudeas þe wæron mid hyre on huse and hi frefrodon, þa hig gesawon þæt Maria aras and mid ofste ut eode, hig fyligdon hyre, ðus cweþende, Heo gæð to his byrgenne þæt heo wepe þar.

text: Ðā Maria cōm þār sē Hǣlend wæs, and hēo hine geseah, hēo fēoll tō his fōtum, and cwæð tō him, Drihten, gif ðū wǣre hēr, nǣre mīn brōðor dēad.
text_bare: Ða Maria com þar se Hælend wæs, and heo hine geseah, heo feoll to his fotum, and cwæð to him, Drihten, gif ðu wære her, nære min broðor dead.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend geseah þæt hēo wēop, and þæt þā Iudeas wēopon þe mid hyre cōmon, hē gēomrode on hys gāste and gedrēfde hyne sylfne,
text_bare: Ða se Hælend geseah þæt heo weop, and þæt þa Iudeas weopon þe mid hyre comon, he geomrode on hys gaste and gedrefde hyne sylfne,

text: and cwæð, Hwār lēde gē hine?
text_bare: and cwæð, Hwar lede ge hine?

text: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Drihten, gā and geseoh.
text_bare: Hig cwædon to him, Drihten, ga and geseoh.

text: And sē Hǣlend wēop.
text_bare: And se Hælend weop.

text: And þā Iudeas cwǣdon, Lōca nū hū hē hyne lufode.
text_bare: And þa Iudeas cwædon, Loca nu hu he hyne lufode.

text: Sume hī cwǣdon, Ne mihte ðēs, þe ontȳnde blindes ēagan, dōn ēac þæt þēs nǣre dēad?
text_bare: Sume hi cwædon, Ne mihte ðes, þe ontynde blindes eagan, don eac þæt þes nære dead?

text: Eft sē Hǣlend gēomrode on him sylfum, and cōm tō þǣre byrgenne.
text_bare: Eft se Hælend geomrode on him sylfum, and com to þære byrgenne.

text: Hit was ān scræf, and þār wæs ān stān onuppan gelēd.
text_bare: Hit was an scræf, and þar wæs an stan onuppan geled.

text: And sē Hǣlend cwæð, Dōð aweg þone stān.
text_bare: And se Hælend cwæð, Doð aweg þone stan.

text: Ðā cwæð Martha tō him, þæs swustor þe þār dēadē wæs, Drihten, nū hē stincð; hē wæs for fēowur dagon dēad.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Martha to him, þæs swustor þe þar deade wæs, Drihten, nu he stincð; he wæs for feowur dagon dead.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Hū ne sǣde ic ðe þæt þū gesyhst Godes wuldor, gif ðū gelȳfst?
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to hyre, Hu ne sæde ic ðe þæt þu gesyhst Godes wuldor, gif ðu gelyfst?

text: Þā dydon hig aweg þone stān.
text_bare: Þa dydon hig aweg þone stan.

text: Sē Hǣlend āhōf ūpp his ēagan, and cwæð, Fæder ic dō þē þancas for þām þū gehyrdest mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend ahof upp his eagan, and cwæð, Fæder ic do þe þancas for þam þu gehyrdest me.

text: Ic wāt þæt þū mē symle gehȳrst; ac ic cwæð for þām folce þe hēr ymbūtan stent, þæt hig gelȳfon þæt þū mē āsendest.
text_bare: Ic wat þæt þu me symle gehyrst; ac ic cwæð for þam folce þe her ymbutan stent, þæt hig gelyfon þæt þu me asendest.

text: Ðā hē ðās þing sǣde, hē clypode mycelre stefne, Lazarus, gā ūt.
text_bare: Ða he ðas þing sæde, he clypode mycelre stefne, Lazarus, ga ut.

text: And sōna stōp forð sē ðe dēad wæs, gebunden handan and fōtan; and hys nebb wæs mid swātlīne gebunden.
text_bare: And sona stop forð se ðe dead wæs, gebunden handan and fotan; and hys nebb wæs mid swatline gebunden.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Unbindað hine, and lǣtað gān.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Unbindað hine, and lætað gan.

text: Manega þāra Iudea þe cōmon tō Marian and gesāwon ðā þing þe hē dyde gelȳfdon on hine.
text_bare: Manega þara Iudea þe comon to Marian and gesawon ða þing þe he dyde gelyfdon on hine.

text: Hī sume fōron tō þām Phariseon, and sǣdon him þā ðing þe sē Hǣlend dyde.
text_bare: Hi sume foron to þam Phariseon, and sædon him þa ðing þe se Hælend dyde.

text: Witodlīce þā bisceopas and þā Pharisei gaderydon gemōt, and cwǣdun, Hwæt dō wē?
text_bare: Witodlice þa bisceopas and þa Pharisei gaderydon gemot, and cwædun, Hwæt do we?

text: for þām þēs man wyrcð mycel tācn.
text_bare: for þam þes man wyrcð mycel tacn.

text: Gif wē hine forlǣtaþ, ealle gelȳfað on hine; and Romane cumað and nimað ūre land and ūrne þēodscipe.
text_bare: Gif we hine forlætaþ, ealle gelyfað on hine; and Romane cumað and nimað ure land and urne þeodscipe.

text: Hyra ān wæs genemned Caiphas, sē wæs ðā on gēre bisceop, and cwæð tō him, Gē nyton nān þing,
text_bare: Hyra an wæs genemned Caiphas, se wæs ða on gere bisceop, and cwæð to him, Ge nyton nan þing,

text: nē ne geþenceað þæt ūs ys betere þæt ān man swelte for folce, and eall þēod ne forwurde.
text_bare: ne ne geþenceað þæt us ys betere þæt an man swelte for folce, and eall þeod ne forwurde.

text: Ne cwæð hē þæt of him sylfum; ac þā hē wæs þæt gēr bisceop, hē wītgode þæt sē Hǣlend sceolde sweltan for ðǣre þēode;
text_bare: Ne cwæð he þæt of him sylfum; ac þa he wæs þæt ger bisceop, he witgode þæt se Hælend sceolde sweltan for ðære þeode;

text: and nā synderlīce for þǣre dēode, ac þæt hē wolde gesomnian tōgædere Godes bearn þe tōdrifene wǣron.
text_bare: and na synderlice for þære deode, ac þæt he wolde gesomnian togædere Godes bearn þe todrifene wæron.

text: Of þām dæge hig þōhton þæt hī woldon hyne ofslēan.
text_bare: Of þam dæge hig þohton þæt hi woldon hyne ofslean.

text: Þā ne fōr sē Hǣlend nā openlīce gemang ððām Iudeon, ac fōr on þæt land wið þæt wēsten, on þā burh þe ys genemned Effrem, and wunode þǣr myd his leorningcnihton.
text_bare: Þa ne for se Hælend na openlice gemang ððam Iudeon, ac for on þæt land wið þæt westen, on þa burh þe ys genemned Effrem, and wunode þær myd his leorningcnihton.

text: Iudea ēastron wǣron gehende; and manega fōron of ðām lande tō Ierusalem ǣr þām ēastron, þæt hig woldon hig sylfe gehālgian.
text_bare: Iudea eastron wæron gehende; and manega foron of ðam lande to Ierusalem ær þam eastron, þæt hig woldon hig sylfe gehalgian.

text: Hig sōhton þone Hǣlend, and sprǣcon him betwȳnan ðǣr hig stōdon on ðām temple, and þus cwǣdon, Hwat wēne gē?
text_bare: Hig sohton þone Hælend, and spræcon him betwynan ðær hig stodon on ðam temple, and þus cwædon, Hwat wene ge?

text: Þæt hē ne cume tō frēolsdæge?
text_bare: Þæt he ne cume to freolsdæge?

text: Þā bisceopas and þā Pharisei hæfdon beboden, gif hwā wiste hwār hē wǣre, þæt hē hyt cȳdde, þæt hig mihton hine niman.
text_bare: Þa bisceopas and þa Pharisei hæfdon beboden, gif hwa wiste hwar he wære, þæt he hyt cydde, þæt hig mihton hine niman.

text: Sē Hǣlend cōm syx dagon ǣr þām ēastron tō Bethania, þār Lazarus wæs dēad þe sē Hǣǣlend āwrehte.
text_bare: Se Hælend com syx dagon ær þam eastron to Bethania, þar Lazarus wæs dead þe se Hæælend awrehte.

text: Hig wrohton him þǣr bēorscipe; and Marða þēnode.
text_bare: Hig wrohton him þær beorscipe; and Marða þenode.

text: Ladzarus wæs ān þǣra þe mid him sæt.
text_bare: Ladzarus wæs an þæra þe mid him sæt.

text: Maria nam ān pund dēorwyrðre sealfe mid þām wyrtgemange þe hig nardus hātað, and smyrede ðæs Hǣlendes fēt and drīgde mid hyre loccon; and þæt hūs was gefylled of ðǣre sealfe swæcce.
text_bare: Maria nam an pund deorwyrðre sealfe mid þam wyrtgemange þe hig nardus hatað, and smyrede ðæs Hælendes fet and drigde mid hyre loccon; and þæt hus was gefylled of ðære sealfe swæcce.

text: Þā cwæð ān his leorningcnihta, Iudas Scarioð þe hine belǣwde,
text_bare: Þa cwæð an his leorningcnihta, Iudas Scarioð þe hine belæwde,

text: Hwī ne sealde hēo þās sealfe wiþ þrīm hundred penegon, þæt man mihte syllan þearfon?
text_bare: Hwi ne sealde heo þas sealfe wiþ þrim hundred penegon, þæt man mihte syllan þearfon?

text: Ne cwæð hē nā þæt for þig þe him gebyrode tō þām þearfon, ac for þām þe hē wæs þēof, and hæfde scrīn, and bær þā ðing þe man sende.
text_bare: Ne cwæð he na þæt for þig þe him gebyrode to þam þearfon, ac for þam þe he wæs þeof, and hæfde scrin, and bær þa ðing þe man sende.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lǣt hig þæt hēo healde þā oð þone dæg þe man mē bebyrge.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Læt hig þæt heo healde þa oð þone dæg þe man me bebyrge.

text: Gē habbað symle þearfan mid ēow; ac gē nabbað mē symle.
text_bare: Ge habbað symle þearfan mid eow; ac ge nabbað me symle.

text: Micel menio þāra Iudea gecnēow þæt hē wæs ðǣr; and hig cōmon, næs nā for þæs Hǣlendes þingon syndorlīce, ac þæt hig woldon gesēon Ladzarum þe hē āwehte of dēaðe.
text_bare: Micel menio þara Iudea gecneow þæt he wæs ðær; and hig comon, næs na for þæs Hælendes þingon syndorlice, ac þæt hig woldon geseon Ladzarum þe he awehte of deaðe.

text: Ðāra sācerda ealdras þōhton þæt hig woldon Lazarum ofslēan;
text_bare: Ðara sacerda ealdras þohton þæt hig woldon Lazarum ofslean;

text: for þām þe manega fōron fram þām Iudeon for his þingon, and gelȳfdon on þone Hǣlend.
text_bare: for þam þe manega foron fram þam Iudeon for his þingon, and gelyfdon on þone Hælend.

text: On mergen mycel menio þe cōm tō þām freolsdage, þā hig gehȳrdon þæt sē Hǣlend cōm tō Ierusalem,
text_bare: On mergen mycel menio þe com to þam freolsdage, þa hig gehyrdon þæt se Hælend com to Ierusalem,

text: hī nāmon palmtrȳwa twigu, and ēodon ūt ongean hine, and clypedon, Sī Israhela Cing hāl and geblētsod þe cōm on Drihtnes naman.
text_bare: hi namon palmtrywa twigu, and eodon ut ongean hine, and clypedon, Si Israhela Cing hal and gebletsod þe com on Drihtnes naman.

text: And sē Hǣlend gemētte ānne assan and rād onuppan þām; swā hit āwriten ys,
text_bare: And se Hælend gemette anne assan and rad onuppan þam; swa hit awriten ys,

text: Ne ondrǣd þū, Siones dohtor; nū þīn cing cymp uppan assan folan sittende.
text_bare: Ne ondræd þu, Siones dohtor; nu þin cing cymp uppan assan folan sittende.

text: Ne undergēton hys leorningcnihtas þās þing ǣrest; ac þā sē ǣlend wæs gewuldrod, þā gemundon hig þæt þās þing wāron āwritene be him, and þās þing hig dydon him.
text_bare: Ne undergeton hys leorningcnihtas þas þing ærest; ac þa se ælend wæs gewuldrod, þa gemundon hig þæt þas þing waron awritene be him, and þas þing hig dydon him.

text: Sēo menio þe wæs mid him, þā hē Ladzarum clypode of ðǣre byrgene and hine āwehte of dēaðe, cȳðde gewitnesse.
text_bare: Seo menio þe wæs mid him, þa he Ladzarum clypode of ðære byrgene and hine awehte of deaðe, cyðde gewitnesse.

text: And for ðī him cōm sēo menio ongēan, for ðām þe hī gehȳrdon þæt hē worhte þæt tācn.
text_bare: And for ði him com seo menio ongean, for ðam þe hi gehyrdon þæt he worhte þæt tacn.

text: Ðā Pharisei cwǣdon betwux him sylfon, Wē gesēoð þæt wē nān þing ne fremiað; nū wyle eall middaneard æfter him.
text_bare: Ða Pharisei cwædon betwux him sylfon, We geseoð þæt we nan þing ne fremiað; nu wyle eall middaneard æfter him.

text: Sume ðā wǣron hǣðene þe fōron þæt hig woldon hī gebiddan on ðām frēolsdæge;
text_bare: Sume ða wæron hæðene þe foron þæt hig woldon hi gebiddan on ðam freolsdæge;

text: ðā genēalǣhton tō Philippe, sē wæs of þǣre Galileiscean Bethsaida, and hī bǣdon hine, and cwǣdon, Lēof, wē wyllað gesēon þone Hǣlend.
text_bare: ða genealæhton to Philippe, se wæs of þære Galileiscean Bethsaida, and hi bædon hine, and cwædon, Leof, we wyllað geseon þone Hælend.

text: Ðā ēode Philippus and sǣde hit Andree; and eft Andreas and Philippus hit sǣdon þām Hǣlende.
text_bare: Ða eode Philippus and sæde hit Andree; and eft Andreas and Philippus hit sædon þam Hælende.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Sēo tīd cymð þæt mannes Sunu by geswutelod.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Seo tid cymð þæt mannes Sunu by geswutelod.

text: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Þæt hwǣtene corn wunað āna, būton hyt fealle on eorpan and sȳ dēad; gif hit bið dēad, hit bringð mycelne wæstm.
text_bare: Soðlice ic secge eow, Þæt hwætene corn wunað ana, buton hyt fealle on eorpan and sy dead; gif hit bið dead, hit bringð mycelne wæstm.

text: Sē þe lufað his sāwle forspilþ hig; and sē þe hataþ his sāwle on þison middanearde gehylt hī on ēceon līfe.
text_bare: Se þe lufað his sawle forspilþ hig; and se þe hataþ his sawle on þison middanearde gehylt hi on eceon life.

text: Gif hwā þēnige mē, fylige mē; and mīn þēn bið þǣr þǣr ic eom.
text_bare: Gif hwa þenige me, fylige me; and min þen bið þær þær ic eom.

text: Gif me hwa þēnað, mīn Fæder hine wurðað.
text_bare: Gif me hwa þenað, min Fæder hine wurðað.

text: Nū mīn sawl ys gedrēfed; and hwæt secge ic, Fæder, gehǣl mē of ðisse tīde.
text_bare: Nu min sawl ys gedrefed; and hwæt secge ic, Fæder, gehæl me of ðisse tide.

text: Ac for ðām ic cōm on þās tīd.
text_bare: Ac for ðam ic com on þas tid.

text: Fæder, gewuldra þīnne naman.
text_bare: Fæder, gewuldra þinne naman.

text: Ðā cōm stefn of heofone þus cweðende, And ic gewuldrode, and eft ic gewuldrige.
text_bare: Ða com stefn of heofone þus cweðende, And ic gewuldrode, and eft ic gewuldrige.

text: Sēo menio þe þǣr stōd and þæt gehȳrde sǣdon þæt hyt þunrode; sume sǣdon þæt engel spǣce wið hyne.
text_bare: Seo menio þe þær stod and þæt gehyrde sædon þæt hyt þunrode; sume sædon þæt engel spæce wið hyne.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne cōm þēos stefn for mīnon þingon, ac for ēowrum þingon.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne com þeos stefn for minon þingon, ac for eowrum þingon.

text: Nū ys middaneardes dōm; nū byð ðysses middaneardes ealdor ūt āworpen.
text_bare: Nu ys middaneardes dom; nu byð ðysses middaneardes ealdor ut aworpen.

text: And gif ic bēo ūpp āhafen fram eorðan, ic tēo ealle þing tō me sylfon.
text_bare: And gif ic beo upp ahafen fram eorðan, ic teo ealle þing to me sylfon.

text: Ðæt hē sǣde and tācnode hwylcum dēaðe hē wolde sweltan.
text_bare: Ðæt he sæde and tacnode hwylcum deaðe he wolde sweltan.

text: Sēo menio him andswarode and cwæð, Wē gehȳrdon on þǣre ǣ þæt Crīst bið on ēcnysse, and hūmeta segest þū, Hit gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu bēo ūpp āhafen?
text_bare: Seo menio him andswarode and cwæð, We gehyrdon on þære æ þæt Crist bið on ecnysse, and humeta segest þu, Hit gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu beo upp ahafen?

text: hwæt ys þēs mannes Sunu?
text_bare: hwæt ys þes mannes Sunu?

text: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Nū gȳt ys lȳtel lēoht on ēow.
text_bare: Þa cwæð se Hælend, Nu gyt ys lytel leoht on eow.

text: Gāþ þā hwile þe gē lēoht habbað, þæt þȳstro ēow ne befōn; sē þe gǣð on þȳstro, hē nāt hwyder hē gǣð.
text_bare: Gaþ þa hwile þe ge leoht habbað, þæt þystro eow ne befon; se þe gæð on þystro, he nat hwyder he gæð.

text: Þā hwīle þe gē lēoht habbon, gelȳfað on lēoht, þæt gē sȳn lēohtes bearn.
text_bare: Þa hwile þe ge leoht habbon, gelyfað on leoht, þæt ge syn leohtes bearn.

text: Ðās þing sē Hǣlend him sǣde, and ēode and bedīglode hine fram him.
text_bare: Ðas þing se Hælend him sæde, and eode and bediglode hine fram him.

text: Ðā hē swā mycele tācn dyde beforan him, hī ne gelȳfdon on hyne:
text_bare: Ða he swa mycele tacn dyde beforan him, hi ne gelyfdon on hyne:

text: þæt ðæs wītegan word Isaias wǣre gefylled þā hē cwæð, Drihten, hwā gelȳfde þæs þe wē gehȳrdon?
text_bare: þæt ðæs witegan word Isaias wære gefylled þa he cwæð, Drihten, hwa gelyfde þæs þe we gehyrdon?

text: and hwām wæs Drihtnes strencð geswutelod?
text_bare: and hwam wæs Drihtnes strencð geswutelod?

text: For þī hī ne mihton gelȳfan, for þām Isaias cwæþ eft,
text_bare: For þi hi ne mihton gelyfan, for þam Isaias cwæþ eft,

text: Hē āblende hyra ēagan, and āhyrde hyra heortan; þæt hī ne gesēon mid hyra ēagon, and mid hyra heortan ne ongyton, and sȳn gecyrrede, and ic hig gehǣle.
text_bare: He ablende hyra eagan, and ahyrde hyra heortan; þæt hi ne geseon mid hyra eagon, and mid hyra heortan ne ongyton, and syn gecyrrede, and ic hig gehæle.

text: Isaias sǣde ðās þing þā hē geseah hys wuldor, and spræc be him.
text_bare: Isaias sæde ðas þing þa he geseah hys wuldor, and spræc be him.

text: And þēah manega of ðām ealdron gelȳfdon on hyne; ac hī hit ne cȳddon, for þǣra Pharisea þingon, þē lǣs hig man ūt ādrife of hyra gesomnunge.
text_bare: And þeah manega of ðam ealdron gelyfdon on hyne; ac hi hit ne cyddon, for þæra Pharisea þingon, þe læs hig man ut adrife of hyra gesomnunge.

text: Hī lufodon manna wuldor swīðor þonne Godes wuldor.
text_bare: Hi lufodon manna wuldor swiðor þonne Godes wuldor.

text: Sē Hǣlend clypode and cwæð tō him, Sē þe gelȳfað on mē, ne gelȳfþ hē nā on mē, ac on þone þe mē sende.
text_bare: Se Hælend clypode and cwæð to him, Se þe gelyfað on me, ne gelyfþ he na on me, ac on þone þe me sende.

text: And sē ðe mē gesyhþ gesyhð þone þe mē sende.
text_bare: And se ðe me gesyhþ gesyhð þone þe me sende.

text: Ic cōm tō lēohte on middaneard, and nān ðāra þe gelȳfð on mē ne wunað on þȳstron.
text_bare: Ic com to leohte on middaneard, and nan ðara þe gelyfð on me ne wunað on þystron.

text: And gif hwā gehȳrð mīne word, and ne gehylt, ne dēme ic hine; ne cōm ic middaneard tō dēmanne, ac þæt ic gehǣle middaneard.
text_bare: And gif hwa gehyrð mine word, and ne gehylt, ne deme ic hine; ne com ic middaneard to demanne, ac þæt ic gehæle middaneard.

text: Se þe mē forhigð, and mīne word ne underfēhð, hē hæfþ hwā him dēme; sēo spǣc þe ic spæc, sēo him dēmð on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
text_bare: Se þe me forhigð, and mine word ne underfehð, he hæfþ hwa him deme; seo spæc þe ic spæc, seo him demð on þam ytemestan dæge.

text: For þām þe ic ne spece of mē sylfon; ac sē Fæder þe mē sende, hē mē bebēad hwæt ic cweþe, and hwæt ic spece.
text_bare: For þam þe ic ne spece of me sylfon; ac se Fæder þe me sende, he me bebead hwæt ic cweþe, and hwæt ic spece.

text: And ic wāt þæt his bebod ys ēce līf; þā þing
text_bare: And ic wat þæt his bebod ys ece lif; þa þing

text: þe ic sprece ic sprece swā Fæder mē sǣde.
text_bare: þe ic sprece ic sprece swa Fæder me sæde.

text: Ǣr þām ēsterfrēolsdæge, sē Hǣlend wiste þæt his tīd cōm þæt hē wolde gewītan of þyson middanearde tō his Fæder, þā hē lufode his leorningcnihtas þe wǣron on middanearde, on ende hē hig lufode.
text_bare: Ær þam esterfreolsdæge, se Hælend wiste þæt his tid com þæt he wolde gewitan of þyson middanearde to his Fæder, þa he lufode his leorningcnihtas þe wæron on middanearde, on ende he hig lufode.

text: And þā Drihtnes þēnung wæs gemacud, þā fōr sē dēofol on Iudas heortan Scariothes þæt hē hine belǣwde.
text_bare: And þa Drihtnes þenung wæs gemacud, þa for se deofol on Iudas heortan Scariothes þæt he hine belæwde.

text: Hē wiste þæt Fæder sealde ealle þing on his handa, and þæt hē cōm of Gode, and cymð tō Gode;
text_bare: He wiste þæt Fæder sealde ealle þing on his handa, and þæt he com of Gode, and cymð to Gode;

text: hē ārās fram his þēnunge, and lēde his rēaf, and nam līnen hrægel and begyrde hyne.
text_bare: he aras fram his þenunge, and lede his reaf, and nam linen hrægel and begyrde hyne.

text: Æfter þām hē dyde water on fæt, and þwōh his leorningcnihta fēt, and drīgde hig mid þǣre linwāde þe hē wæs mid begyrd.
text_bare: Æfter þam he dyde water on fæt, and þwoh his leorningcnihta fet, and drigde hig mid þære linwade þe he wæs mid begyrd.

text: Ðā cōm hē tō Simone Petre.
text_bare: Ða com he to Simone Petre.

text: And Petrus cwæð tō him, Drihten, scealt þū ðwēan mīne fēt?
text_bare: And Petrus cwæð to him, Drihten, scealt þu ðwean mine fet?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þū nāst nū þæt ic dō, ac þū wāst syððan.
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarode and cwæð to him, Þu nast nu þæt ic do, ac þu wast syððan.

text: Petrus cwæð tō him, Ne þwyhst þū næfre mine fēt.
text_bare: Petrus cwæð to him, Ne þwyhst þu næfre mine fet.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Gif ic þē ne þwēa, næfst þū nānne dǣl myd mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæþ, Gif ic þe ne þwea, næfst þu nanne dæl myd me.

text: Ðā cwæð Simon Petrus tō him, Drihten, ne þweh þū nā mīne fēt āne, ac ēac mīn hēafod and mīne handa.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Simon Petrus to him, Drihten, ne þweh þu na mine fet ane, ac eac min heafod and mine handa.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Sē þe clǣne byþ ne beðearf būton þæt man his fēt þwēa, ac ys eall clǣne; and gē synt sume clǣne, næs nā ealle.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Se þe clæne byþ ne beðearf buton þæt man his fet þwea, ac ys eall clæne; and ge synt sume clæne, næs na ealle.

text: Hē wiste witodlīce hwā hyne sceolde belǣwan; for þām hē cwæð, Ne synt gē ealle clǣne.
text_bare: He wiste witodlice hwa hyne sceolde belæwan; for þam he cwæð, Ne synt ge ealle clæne.

text: Syððan hē hæfde hyra fēt āþwogene, hē nam his rēaf, and þā hē sæt, hē cwæð eft tō him, Wite gē hwæt ic ēow dyde?
text_bare: Syððan he hæfde hyra fet aþwogene, he nam his reaf, and þa he sæt, he cwæð eft to him, Wite ge hwæt ic eow dyde?

text: Gē clypiað mē Lārēow and Drihten; and wel gē cweðaþ; swā ic eom sōþlice.
text_bare: Ge clypiað me Lareow and Drihten; and wel ge cweðaþ; swa ic eom soþlice.

text: Gif ic þwōh ēowre fet ic þe eom ēower Lārēow and ēower Hlāford, gē sceolon þwēan ēower ǣlc ōðres fēt.
text_bare: Gif ic þwoh eowre fet ic þe eom eower Lareow and eower Hlaford, ge sceolon þwean eower ælc oðres fet.

text: Ic ēow sealde bȳsene þæt gē dōn swā ic ēow dyde.
text_bare: Ic eow sealde bysene þæt ge don swa ic eow dyde.

text: Sōþlice ic ēow secge, Nys sē ðēowa furðra þonne his hlāford; nē ǣrenddraca nys mǣrra þonne sē þe hyne sende.
text_bare: Soþlice ic eow secge, Nys se ðeowa furðra þonne his hlaford; ne ærenddraca nys mærra þonne se þe hyne sende.

text: Gif gē þās þing witon, gē bēoð ēadige gif gē hig dōð.
text_bare: Gif ge þas þing witon, ge beoð eadige gif ge hig doð.

text: Ne secge ic be ēow eallon; ic wāt hwylce ic gecēas; ac þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled þe cwyþ, Sē þe ytt hlāf myd mē āhefþ hys hō ongēan mē.
text_bare: Ne secge ic be eow eallon; ic wat hwylce ic geceas; ac þæt þæt halige gewrit sy gefylled þe cwyþ, Se þe ytt hlaf myd me ahefþ hys ho ongean me.

text: Nū ic ēow secge ǣr þām þe hyt gewurþe, þæt gē gelȳfon, þonne hyt geworden bið, þæt ic hit eom.
text_bare: Nu ic eow secge ær þam þe hyt gewurþe, þæt ge gelyfon, þonne hyt geworden bið, þæt ic hit eom.

text: Sōð ic ēow secge, Sē ðe underfehð þone þe ic sende underfēhð mē; sē þe underfehp mē underfehþ ðone ðe mē sende.
text_bare: Soð ic eow secge, Se ðe underfehð þone þe ic sende underfehð me; se þe underfehp me underfehþ ðone ðe me sende.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend þās þing sǣde, hē wæs gedrēfed on gāste, and cȳðde and cwæð, Sōð ic ēow secge þæt ēower ān mē belǣwð.
text_bare: Ða se Hælend þas þing sæde, he wæs gedrefed on gaste, and cyðde and cwæð, Soð ic eow secge þæt eower an me belæwð.

text: Ðā leorningcnihtas behēold hyra ǣlc ōðerne, and him twȳnode be hwām hē hit sǣde.
text_bare: Ða leorningcnihtas beheold hyra ælc oðerne, and him twynode be hwam he hit sæde.

text: Ān þǣra leorningcnihta hlinode on þæs Hǣlendes bearme þone sē Hǣlend lufode.
text_bare: An þæra leorningcnihta hlinode on þæs Hælendes bearme þone se Hælend lufode.

text: Symon Petrus bīcnode tō þyson, and cwæð tō him, Hwæt is sē ðe hē hyt big segð?
text_bare: Symon Petrus bicnode to þyson, and cwæð to him, Hwæt is se ðe he hyt big segð?

text: Witodlīce þā hē hlinode ofer ðæs Hǣlendes brēostum, hē cwæð tō him, Drihten, hwæt ys hē?
text_bare: Witodlice þa he hlinode ofer ðæs Hælendes breostum, he cwæð to him, Drihten, hwæt ys he?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hē ys sē ðe ic rǣce bedyppedne hlāf.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, He ys se ðe ic ræce bedyppedne hlaf.

text: And þā þā hē bedypte þone hlāf, hē sealde hyne Iudas Scariothe.
text_bare: And þa þa he bedypte þone hlaf, he sealde hyne Iudas Scariothe.

text: And þā æfter þām bitan, Satanas ēode on hyne.
text_bare: And þa æfter þam bitan, Satanas eode on hyne.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Dō rāðe þæt þū dōn wylt.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Do raðe þæt þu don wylt.

text: Nyste nān þāra sittendra tō hwām hē þæt sǣde.
text_bare: Nyste nan þara sittendra to hwam he þæt sæde.

text: Sume wēndon, for þām Iudas hæfde scrīn, þæt sē Hǣlend hit cwǣde be him, Bige þā þing be ūs þarf sȳ tō þām frēolsdæge; oððe þæt hē sealde sum þing þearfendum mannum.
text_bare: Sume wendon, for þam Iudas hæfde scrin, þæt se Hælend hit cwæde be him, Bige þa þing be us þarf sy to þam freolsdæge; oððe þæt he sealde sum þing þearfendum mannum.

text: Ðā hē nam þone bitan, hē ēode ūt; þārrihte hit was niht.
text_bare: Ða he nam þone bitan, he eode ut; þarrihte hit was niht.

text: Þā hē ūt ēode, and sē Hǣlend cwæð, Nū ys mannes Sunu geswutelod, and God ys geswutelod on him.
text_bare: Þa he ut eode, and se Hælend cwæð, Nu ys mannes Sunu geswutelod, and God ys geswutelod on him.

text: Gif God ys geswutelod on him, and God geswutelað hine on hym sylfum.
text_bare: Gif God ys geswutelod on him, and God geswutelað hine on hym sylfum.

text: Lā bearn, nū gȳt ic eom gehwǣde tīd mid ēow.
text_bare: La bearn, nu gyt ic eom gehwæde tid mid eow.

text: Gē mē sēceað; and swā ic þām Iudeon sǣde, Gē ne magon faran þyder þe ic fare; and nū ic ēow secge.
text_bare: Ge me seceað; and swa ic þam Iudeon sæde, Ge ne magon faran þyder þe ic fare; and nu ic eow secge.

text: Ic ēow sylle nīwe bebod, þæt gē lufion ēow betwȳnan, swā ic ēow lufode.
text_bare: Ic eow sylle niwe bebod, þæt ge lufion eow betwynan, swa ic eow lufode.

text: Be þām oncnāwað ealle menn þæt gē synt mīne leorningcnihtas, gif gē habbað lufe ēow betwȳnan.
text_bare: Be þam oncnawað ealle menn þæt ge synt mine leorningcnihtas, gif ge habbað lufe eow betwynan.

text: Simon Petrus cwæð tō him, Drihten, hwyder gǣst þū?
text_bare: Simon Petrus cwæð to him, Drihten, hwyder gæst þu?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne miht þū mē fylian þyder ic nū fare; þū færst eft æfter mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne miht þu me fylian þyder ic nu fare; þu færst eft æfter me.

text: Petrus cwæð tō him, Hwī ne mæg ic þē nū fylian?
text_bare: Petrus cwæð to him, Hwi ne mæg ic þe nu fylian?

text: Ic sylle mīn līf for ðē.
text_bare: Ic sylle min lif for ðe.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ðīn līf þū sylst for mē?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Ðin lif þu sylst for me?

text: Sōð ic þē secge, Ne crǣwð sē cocc ǣr ðū wiðsæcst mē þrīwa.
text_bare: Soð ic þe secge, Ne cræwð se cocc ær ðu wiðsæcst me þriwa.

text: And hē cwæð tō his leomingcnihton,
text_bare: And he cwæð to his leomingcnihton,

text: Ne sȳ ēower heorte gedrēfed; gē gelȳfað on God, and gelȳfað on mē.
text_bare: Ne sy eower heorte gedrefed; ge gelyfað on God, and gelyfað on me.

text: On mīnes Fæder hūse synt manega eardungstōwa; ne sǣde ic ēow.
text_bare: On mines Fæder huse synt manega eardungstowa; ne sæde ic eow.

text: Hit ys lȳtles wana þæt ic fare and wylle ēow eardungstōwe gearwian?
text_bare: Hit ys lytles wana þæt ic fare and wylle eow eardungstowe gearwian?

text: And gif ic fare and ēow eardungstōwe gegearwige, eft ic cume and nime ēow tō mē sylfon; þæt gē sȳn þǣr ic eom.
text_bare: And gif ic fare and eow eardungstowe gegearwige, eft ic cume and nime eow to me sylfon; þæt ge syn þær ic eom.

text: And gē witon hwyder ic fare, and gē cunnon þone weg.
text_bare: And ge witon hwyder ic fare, and ge cunnon þone weg.

text: Thomas cwæð tō him, Drihten, wē nyton hwyder þū færst; and hū mage wē þone weg cunnan?
text_bare: Thomas cwæð to him, Drihten, we nyton hwyder þu færst; and hu mage we þone weg cunnan?

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom weg, and sōðfæstnys, and līf; ne cymð nān tō Fæder butan þurh mē.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Ic eom weg, and soðfæstnys, and lif; ne cymð nan to Fæder butan þurh me.

text: Gif gē cūðon mē, witodlīce gē cūðon mīnne Fæder; and heonon forð gē hyne gecnāwað, and gē hine gesāwon.
text_bare: Gif ge cuðon me, witodlice ge cuðon minne Fæder; and heonon forð ge hyne gecnawað, and ge hine gesawon.

text: Philippus cwæð tō him, Drihten, ætȳw ūs þone Fæder, and we habbað genōh.
text_bare: Philippus cwæð to him, Drihten, ætyw us þone Fæder, and we habbað genoh.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Philippus, swā lange tīd ic wæs mid ēow, and gē ne gecnēowun mē?
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, Philippus, swa lange tid ic wæs mid eow, and ge ne gecneowun me?

text: Sē þe mē gesyhð gesyhð mīnne Fæder; hūmeta cwyst þū, Ætȳw ūs þīnne Fæder?
text_bare: Se þe me gesyhð gesyhð minne Fæder; humeta cwyst þu, Ætyw us þinne Fæder?

text: Ne gelȳfst þū þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on mē?
text_bare: Ne gelyfst þu þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on me?

text: Ðā word þe ic tō ēow sprece, ne sprece ic hī of mē sylfon; sē Fæder þe wunað on mē, hē wyrcð þā weorc.
text_bare: Ða word þe ic to eow sprece, ne sprece ic hi of me sylfon; se Fæder þe wunað on me, he wyrcð þa weorc.

text: Ne gelȳfe gē þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on mē?
text_bare: Ne gelyfe ge þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on me?

text: gelyfað for þām weorcon.
text_bare: gelyfað for þam weorcon.

text: Sōð ic ēow secge, Sē ðe gelȳfð on mē, hē wyrcð þā weorc þe ic wyrce; and hē wyrcð māran þonne þā synt, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder.
text_bare: Soð ic eow secge, Se ðe gelyfð on me, he wyrcð þa weorc þe ic wyrce; and he wyrcð maran þonne þa synt, for þam þe ic fare to Fæder.

text: And ic dō swā hwæt swā gē biddað on mīnon naman, þæt Fæder sī gewuldrod on Suna.
text_bare: And ic do swa hwæt swa ge biddað on minon naman, þæt Fæder si gewuldrod on Suna.

text: Gif gē hwæt mē biddaþ on mīnum naman, þæt ic dō.
text_bare: Gif ge hwæt me biddaþ on minum naman, þæt ic do.

text: Gif gē mē lufiað, healdað mīne beboda.
text_bare: Gif ge me lufiað, healdað mine beboda.

text: And ic bidde Fæder, and hē sylþ ēow ōðerne Frēfriend, þæt bēo ǣfre mid ēow, .
text_bare: And ic bidde Fæder, and he sylþ eow oðerne Frefriend, þæt beo æfre mid eow, .

text: sōðfæstnysse gāst þe ðēs middaneard ne mæg underfōn; hē ne cann hyne, for ðām þe hē ne gesyhþ hyne; gē hyne cunnon, for þām hē wunað mid ēow, and bið on ēow.
text_bare: soðfæstnysse gast þe ðes middaneard ne mæg underfon; he ne cann hyne, for ðam þe he ne gesyhþ hyne; ge hyne cunnon, for þam he wunað mid eow, and bið on eow.

text: Ne lǣte ic ēow stēopcild; ic cume tō ēow.
text_bare: Ne læte ic eow steopcild; ic cume to eow.

text: Nū gȳt ys ān lȳtel fyrst, and middaneard mē ne gesyhþ; gē mē gesēoð; for þām ic lybbe, and gē lybbað.
text_bare: Nu gyt ys an lytel fyrst, and middaneard me ne gesyhþ; ge me geseoð; for þam ic lybbe, and ge lybbað.

text: On þām dæge gē gecnāwaþ þæt ic eom on mīnum Fæder, and gē synt on mē, and ic eom on ēow.
text_bare: On þam dæge ge gecnawaþ þæt ic eom on minum Fæder, and ge synt on me, and ic eom on eow.

text: Sē þe hæfð mīne bebodu, and gehylt þā, hē ys þe mē lufað.
text_bare: Se þe hæfð mine bebodu, and gehylt þa, he ys þe me lufað.

text: Mīn Fæder lufað þone þe mē lufað, and ic lufige hyne, and geswutelige him mē sylfne.
text_bare: Min Fæder lufað þone þe me lufað, and ic lufige hyne, and geswutelige him me sylfne.

text: Iudas cwæð tō him, - næs nā sē Scarioth, - Drihten, hwæt ys geworden þæt þū wylt þē sylfne geswuteligan ūs, næs middanearde?
text_bare: Iudas cwæð to him, - næs na se Scarioth, - Drihten, hwæt ys geworden þæt þu wylt þe sylfne geswuteligan us, næs middanearde?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him,
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarode and cwæð to him,

text: Gif hwā mē lufað, hē hylt mīne sprǣce; and mīn Fæder lufað hine, and wē cumað tō him, and wē wyrceað eardungstōwa mid him.
text_bare: Gif hwa me lufað, he hylt mine spræce; and min Fæder lufað hine, and we cumað to him, and we wyrceað eardungstowa mid him.

text: Sē ðe mē ne lufað ne hylt hē mīne sprǣce; and nis hyt mīn sprǣc þe gē gehȳrdon, ac ðæs Fæder þe mē sende.
text_bare: Se ðe me ne lufað ne hylt he mine spræce; and nis hyt min spræc þe ge gehyrdon, ac ðæs Fæder þe me sende.

text: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde, þā ic mid ēow wunode.
text_bare: Ðas þing ic eow sæde, þa ic mid eow wunode.

text: Sē Hāliga Frōfre Gāst, þe Fæder sent on mīnum naman, ēow lǣrð ealle þing, and hē lǣrð ēow ealle þā þing þe ic ēow secge.
text_bare: Se Haliga Frofre Gast, þe Fæder sent on minum naman, eow lærð ealle þing, and he lærð eow ealle þa þing þe ic eow secge.

text: Ic lǣfe ēow sibbe; ic sylle ēow mīne sibbe; ne sylle ic ēow sibbe swā middaneard sylþ.
text_bare: Ic læfe eow sibbe; ic sylle eow mine sibbe; ne sylle ic eow sibbe swa middaneard sylþ.

text: Ne sȳ ēower heorte gedrēfed, nē ne forhtige gē.
text_bare: Ne sy eower heorte gedrefed, ne ne forhtige ge.

text: Gē gehȳrdon þæt ic ēow sǣde, Ic gā, and ic cume tō ēow.
text_bare: Ge gehyrdon þæt ic eow sæde, Ic ga, and ic cume to eow.

text: Witodlīce gif gē mē lufedon, ge geblissodon, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder; for þām Fæder ys māra þonne ic.
text_bare: Witodlice gif ge me lufedon, ge geblissodon, for þam þe ic fare to Fæder; for þam Fæder ys mara þonne ic.

text: And nū ic ēow sǣde ǣr ðām þe hit gewurðe, þæt gē gelȳfon þonne hit geworden bið.
text_bare: And nu ic eow sæde ær ðam þe hit gewurðe, þæt ge gelyfon þonne hit geworden bið.

text: Ne sprece ic nū nā fela wið ēow; ðyses middaneardes ealdor cymð, and hē næfð nān ðing on mē;
text_bare: Ne sprece ic nu na fela wið eow; ðyses middaneardes ealdor cymð, and he næfð nan ðing on me;

text: ac þæt middaneard oncnāwe þæt ic lufige Fæder, and ic dō swā Fæder mē bebēad.
text_bare: ac þæt middaneard oncnawe þæt ic lufige Fæder, and ic do swa Fæder me bebead.

text: Arīsað, uton gān heonon.
text_bare: Arisað, uton gan heonon.

text: Ic eom sōð wīneard, and mīn Fæder ys eorðtilia.
text_bare: Ic eom soð wineard, and min Fæder ys eorðtilia.

text: Hē dēð ǣlc twig aweg on mē þe blǣda ne byrð; and hē feormað ǣlc þāra þe blǣda byrþ, þæt hyt bere blǣda ðē swīðor.
text_bare: He deð ælc twig aweg on me þe blæda ne byrð; and he feormað ælc þara þe blæda byrþ, þæt hyt bere blæda ðe swiðor.

text: Nū gē synt clǣne for þǣre sprǣce þe ic tō ēow spræc.
text_bare: Nu ge synt clæne for þære spræce þe ic to eow spræc.

text: Wuniað on mē, and ic on ēow.
text_bare: Wuniað on me, and ic on eow.

text: Swā twig ne mæg blǣda beran him sylf, būton hit wunige on wīnearde; swā gē ne magon ēac, būton gē wunion on mē.
text_bare: Swa twig ne mæg blæda beran him sylf, buton hit wunige on winearde; swa ge ne magon eac, buton ge wunion on me.

text: Ic eom wīneard, and gē synt twigu.
text_bare: Ic eom wineard, and ge synt twigu.

text: Sē ðe wunað on mē, and ic on him, sē byrð mycle blǣda; for ðām gē ne magon nān ðing dōn būtan mē.
text_bare: Se ðe wunað on me, and ic on him, se byrð mycle blæda; for ðam ge ne magon nan ðing don butan me.

text: Gif hwā ne wunað on mē, hē byð āworpen ūt, swā twig, and fordrūwað; and hig gaderiað þā, and dōð on fȳr, and hig forbyrnað.
text_bare: Gif hwa ne wunað on me, he byð aworpen ut, swa twig, and fordruwað; and hig gaderiað þa, and doð on fyr, and hig forbyrnað.

text: Gyf gē wuniað on mē, and mīne word wuniað on ēow, biddað swā hwæt swā gē wyllon, and hyt byð ēower.
text_bare: Gyf ge wuniað on me, and mine word wuniað on eow, biddað swa hwæt swa ge wyllon, and hyt byð eower.

text: On ðām ys mīn Fæder geswutelod, þæt gē beron mycle blǣda, and bēon mīne leorningcnihtas.
text_bare: On ðam ys min Fæder geswutelod, þæt ge beron mycle blæda, and beon mine leorningcnihtas.

text: And ic lufode ēow, swā Fæder lufode me: wuniað on mīnre lufe.
text_bare: And ic lufode eow, swa Fæder lufode me: wuniað on minre lufe.

text: Gif gē mīne bebodu gehealdað, gē wuniað on mīnre lufe; swā ic gehēold mīnes Fæder bebodu, and ic wunige on hys lufe.
text_bare: Gif ge mine bebodu gehealdað, ge wuniað on minre lufe; swa ic geheold mines Fæder bebodu, and ic wunige on hys lufe.

text: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde þæt mīn gefēa sȳ on ēow, and ēower gefēa sȳ gefulled.
text_bare: Ðas þing ic eow sæde þæt min gefea sy on eow, and eower gefea sy gefulled.

text: Ðis ys mīn bebod, þæt gē lufion ēow gemǣnelīce, swā ic ēow lufode.
text_bare: Ðis ys min bebod, þæt ge lufion eow gemænelice, swa ic eow lufode.

text: Næfð nān man māran lufe þonne ðēos ys, þæt hwā sylle his līf for his frēondum.
text_bare: Næfð nan man maran lufe þonne ðeos ys, þæt hwa sylle his lif for his freondum.

text: Gē synt mīne frȳnd, gif gē dōð þā þing þe ic ēow bebēode.
text_bare: Ge synt mine frynd, gif ge doð þa þing þe ic eow bebeode.

text: Ne telle ic ēow tō ðēowan; for þām sē ðēowa nāt hwæt sē hlāford dēð.
text_bare: Ne telle ic eow to ðeowan; for þam se ðeowa nat hwæt se hlaford deð.

text: Ic tealde ēow tō frēondum; for þām ic cȳðde ēow ealle þā þing þe ic gehȳrde æt mīnum Fæder.
text_bare: Ic tealde eow to freondum; for þam ic cyðde eow ealle þa þing þe ic gehyrde æt minum Fæder.

text: Ne gecure gē mē, ac ic gecēas ēow, and ic sette ēow þæt gē gān and blǣda beron, and ēowre blǣda gelǣston; þæt Fæder sylle ēow swā hwæt swā gē biddað on mīnum naman.
text_bare: Ne gecure ge me, ac ic geceas eow, and ic sette eow þæt ge gan and blæda beron, and eowre blæda gelæston; þæt Fæder sylle eow swa hwæt swa ge biddað on minum naman.

text: Ðās þing ic ēow bēode, þæt gē lufion ēow gemǣnelīce.
text_bare: Ðas þing ic eow beode, þæt ge lufion eow gemænelice.

text: Gif middaneard ēow hatað, witað þæt hē hatede mē ǣr ēow.
text_bare: Gif middaneard eow hatað, witað þæt he hatede me ær eow.

text: Gif ge of middanearde wǣron, middaneard lufode þæt his wæs; for þam þe gē ne synt of middanearde, ac ic ēow gecēas of middanearde, for ðī middaneard ēow hatað.
text_bare: Gif ge of middanearde wæron, middaneard lufode þæt his wæs; for þam þe ge ne synt of middanearde, ac ic eow geceas of middanearde, for ði middaneard eow hatað.

text: Gemunað mīnre sprǣce þe ic ēow sǣde, Nis se ðēowa mǣrra þonne his hlāford.
text_bare: Gemunað minre spræce þe ic eow sæde, Nis se ðeowa mærra þonne his hlaford.

text: Gif hī mē ēhton, hī wyllað ehtan ēower; gif hī mīne sprǣce hēoldon, hī healdað ēac ēowre.
text_bare: Gif hi me ehton, hi wyllað ehtan eower; gif hi mine spræce heoldon, hi healdað eac eowre.

text: Ac ealle þās þing hi doð ēow for mīnum naman, for þām hi ne cunnon þone þe mē sende.
text_bare: Ac ealle þas þing hi doð eow for minum naman, for þam hi ne cunnon þone þe me sende.

text: Gif ic ne cōme and tō him ne sprǣce, næfdon hig nāne synne; nū hī nabbað nāne lāde be hyra synne.
text_bare: Gif ic ne come and to him ne spræce, næfdon hig nane synne; nu hi nabbað nane lade be hyra synne.

text: Sē þe mē hatað hatað mīnne Fæder.
text_bare: Se þe me hatað hatað minne Fæder.

text: Gif ic nāne weorc ne worhte on him þe nān ōðer ne worhte, næfdon hī nāne synne; nu hī gesāwon, and hī hatedon ǣgðer ge mē ge mīnne Fæder.
text_bare: Gif ic nane weorc ne worhte on him þe nan oðer ne worhte, næfdon hi nane synne; nu hi gesawon, and hi hatedon ægðer ge me ge minne Fæder.

text: Ac þæt sēo sprǣc sȳ gefylled þe on hyra ǣ āwriten ys, Þæt hī hatedon mē būton gewyrhton.
text_bare: Ac þæt seo spræc sy gefylled þe on hyra æ awriten ys, Þæt hi hatedon me buton gewyrhton.

text: Ðonne sē Frēfriend cymð þe ic ēow sende fram Fæder, sōðfæstnysse Gāst þe cymð fram Fæder, hē cȳð gewitnesse be mē;
text_bare: Ðonne se Frefriend cymð þe ic eow sende fram Fæder, soðfæstnysse Gast þe cymð fram Fæder, he cyð gewitnesse be me;

text: and gē cȳðað gewitnesse, for ðām gē waron fram fruman mid mē.
text_bare: and ge cyðað gewitnesse, for ðam ge waron fram fruman mid me.

text: Ðās ðing ic ēow sǣde þæt gē ne swicion.
text_bare: Ðas ðing ic eow sæde þæt ge ne swicion.

text: Hī dōð ēow of gesomnungum; ac sēo tīd cymð þæt ǣlc þe ēow ofslyhð wēnþ þæt hē þēnige Gode.
text_bare: Hi doð eow of gesomnungum; ac seo tid cymð þæt ælc þe eow ofslyhð wenþ þæt he þenige Gode.

text: And þās ðing hig dōð, for þām þe hī ne cūþon mīnne Fæder, nē mē.
text_bare: And þas ðing hig doð, for þam þe hi ne cuþon minne Fæder, ne me.

text: Ac þās þing ic ēow sǣde, þæt gē gemunon þonne hyra tīd cymð, þæt ic hit ēow sǣde.
text_bare: Ac þas þing ic eow sæde, þæt ge gemunon þonne hyra tid cymð, þæt ic hit eow sæde.

text: Ne sǣde ic ēow þās ðing æt fruman, for þām þe ic wæs mid ēow.
text_bare: Ne sæde ic eow þas ðing æt fruman, for þam þe ic wæs mid eow.

text: Nū ic fare tō ðām þe mē sende; and ēower nān ne āhsað mē hwyder ic fare.
text_bare: Nu ic fare to ðam þe me sende; and eower nan ne ahsað me hwyder ic fare.

text: Ac for þām þe ic spræc ðās þing tō ēow, unrōtnyss gefylde ēowre heortan.
text_bare: Ac for þam þe ic spræc ðas þing to eow, unrotnyss gefylde eowre heortan.

text: Ac ic ēow secge sōðfæstnysse; Ēow fremað þæt ic fare.
text_bare: Ac ic eow secge soðfæstnysse; Eow fremað þæt ic fare.

text: Gif ic ne fare, ne cymð sē Frēfriend tō ēow; witodlīce gif ic fare, ic hyne sende tō ēow.
text_bare: Gif ic ne fare, ne cymð se Frefriend to eow; witodlice gif ic fare, ic hyne sende to eow.

text: And þonne hē cymð, hē þȳwþ þysne middaneard be synne, and be rihtwīsnysse, and be dōme:
text_bare: And þonne he cymð, he þywþ þysne middaneard be synne, and be rihtwisnysse, and be dome:

text: be synne, for þām hi ne gelyfdon on mē;
text_bare: be synne, for þam hi ne gelyfdon on me;

text: be rihtwīsnysse, for þām ic fare tō Fæder, and gē mē ne gesēoð;
text_bare: be rihtwisnysse, for þam ic fare to Fæder, and ge me ne geseoð;

text: be dōme, for þām þyses middaneardes ealdur ys gedēmed.
text_bare: be dome, for þam þyses middaneardes ealdur ys gedemed.

text: Gyt ic hæbbe ēow fela tō secgenne, ac gē hyt ne magun nū ācuman.
text_bare: Gyt ic hæbbe eow fela to secgenne, ac ge hyt ne magun nu acuman.

text: Donne þǣre sōþfæstnysse Gāst cymð, hē lǣrð ēow ealle sōþfæstnysse; ne sprycð hē of him sylfon, ac hē sprycð þā þing þe hē gehȳrð, and cȳð ēow ðā þing þe tōwearde synt.
text_bare: Donne þære soþfæstnysse Gast cymð, he lærð eow ealle soþfæstnysse; ne sprycð he of him sylfon, ac he sprycð þa þing þe he gehyrð, and cyð eow ða þing þe towearde synt.

text: Hē mē geswutelað; for þām hē nimð of mīnum, and cȳð ēow.
text_bare: He me geswutelað; for þam he nimð of minum, and cyð eow.

text: Ealle þā þing þe mīn Fæder hæfð synt mīne; for þig ic cwað þæt hē nimð of mīnum, and cȳþ ēow.
text_bare: Ealle þa þing þe min Fæder hæfð synt mine; for þig ic cwað þæt he nimð of minum, and cyþ eow.

text: Nū ymbe ān lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð; and eft embe lȳtel gē mē gesēoþ, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder.
text_bare: Nu ymbe an lytel ge me ne geseoð; and eft embe lytel ge me geseoþ, for þam þe ic fare to Fæder.

text: Ðā cwǣdon his leorningcnihtas him betwynan, Hwæt ys þæt hē ūs segð, Ymbe lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð, and eft embe lȳtel and gē mē gesēoð; and, Þæt ic fare tō Fæder?
text_bare: Ða cwædon his leorningcnihtas him betwynan, Hwæt ys þæt he us segð, Ymbe lytel ge me ne geseoð, and eft embe lytel and ge me geseoð; and, Þæt ic fare to Fæder?

text: Hig cwǣdon witodlīce, Hwæt ys þæt hē cwyþ, Embe lȳtel?
text_bare: Hig cwædon witodlice, Hwæt ys þæt he cwyþ, Embe lytel?

text: Wē nytan hwæt hē sprycð.
text_bare: We nytan hwæt he sprycð.

text: Sē Hǣlend wiste þæt hī woldon hyne āhsian, and hē cwæð tō him, Bē þām gē smēageað betwȳnan ēow, for þām ic sǣde, Embe lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð, and eft embe lȳtel gē mē gesēoð?
text_bare: Se Hælend wiste þæt hi woldon hyne ahsian, and he cwæð to him, Be þam ge smeageað betwynan eow, for þam ic sæde, Embe lytel ge me ne geseoð, and eft embe lytel ge me geseoð?

text: Sōð ic ēow secge, þæt gē hēofiað and wēpað; middaneard geblissað; and gē bēoð unrōte, ac ēower unrōtnys byð gewend tō gefēan.
text_bare: Soð ic eow secge, þæt ge heofiað and wepað; middaneard geblissað; and ge beoð unrote, ac eower unrotnys byð gewend to gefean.

text: Ðænne wīf cenð, hēo hæfð unrōtnysse, for þām þe hyre tīd cōm; þonne hēo cenð cnapan, ne geman hēo þǣre hefignysse, for gefēan for þām mann byð ācenned on middaneard.
text_bare: Ðænne wif cenð, heo hæfð unrotnysse, for þam þe hyre tid com; þonne heo cenð cnapan, ne geman heo þære hefignysse, for gefean for þam mann byð acenned on middaneard.

text: And witodlīce gē habbað nū unrōtnysse; eft ic ēow gesēo, and ēower heorte geblissað, and nān man ne nimþ ēowerne gefēan fram ēow.
text_bare: And witodlice ge habbað nu unrotnysse; eft ic eow geseo, and eower heorte geblissað, and nan man ne nimþ eowerne gefean fram eow.

text: And on þām dæge gē ne biddað mē nānes þinges.
text_bare: And on þam dæge ge ne biddað me nanes þinges.

text: Sōð ic ēow secge, Gif gē hwæt biddað mīnne Fæder on mīnum naman, hē hyt sylþ ēow.
text_bare: Soð ic eow secge, Gif ge hwæt biddað minne Fæder on minum naman, he hyt sylþ eow.

text: Oþ þis ne bǣde gē nān þing on mīnum naman: biddaþ, and gē underfōð, þæt ēower gefēa sȳ full.
text_bare: Oþ þis ne bæde ge nan þing on minum naman: biddaþ, and ge underfoð, þæt eower gefea sy full.

text: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde on bigspellum.
text_bare: Ðas þing ic eow sæde on bigspellum.

text: Sēo tīd cymð þænne ic ēow ne sprece on bigspellum, ac ic cȳðe ēow openlīce be mīnum Fæder.
text_bare: Seo tid cymð þænne ic eow ne sprece on bigspellum, ac ic cyðe eow openlice be minum Fæder.

text: On ðām dæge gē biddað on mīnum naman; and ic ēow ne secge, for þām ic bidde mīnne Fæder be ēow.
text_bare: On ðam dæge ge biddað on minum naman; and ic eow ne secge, for þam ic bidde minne Fæder be eow.

text: Witodlīce sē Fæder ēow lufað, for þām þe gē lufedon mē, and gelȳfdon þæt ic cōm of Gode.
text_bare: Witodlice se Fæder eow lufað, for þam þe ge lufedon me, and gelyfdon þæt ic com of Gode.

text: Ic fōr fram Fæder, and cōm on middaneard; eft, ic forlǣte middaneard, and fare tō Fæder.
text_bare: Ic for fram Fæder, and com on middaneard; eft, ic forlæte middaneard, and fare to Fæder.

text: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon tō him, Nū ðū sprycst openlīce, and ne segst nān bigspell.
text_bare: His leorningcnihtas cwædon to him, Nu ðu sprycst openlice, and ne segst nan bigspell.

text: Nū wē witon þæt þū wāst ealle ðing, and þē nis nan þearf þæt ǣnig þē āxie; on ðyson wē gelȳfað þæt þū cōme of Gode.
text_bare: Nu we witon þæt þu wast ealle ðing, and þe nis nan þearf þæt ænig þe axie; on ðyson we gelyfað þæt þu come of Gode.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Nū gē gelȳfað?
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Nu ge gelyfað?

text: Nū cōm tīd and cymð þæt gē tōfaron ǣghwylc tō his āgenon, and forlǣton mē ānne; and ic ne eom āna, for þām mīn Fæder is mid mē.
text_bare: Nu com tid and cymð þæt ge tofaron æghwylc to his agenon, and forlæton me anne; and ic ne eom ana, for þam min Fæder is mid me.

text: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde, þæt gē habbon sibbe on mē.
text_bare: Ðas þing ic eow sæde, þæt ge habbon sibbe on me.

text: Gē habbað hefige byrðene on middanearde; ac getrūwiað; ic forswīðde middaneard.
text_bare: Ge habbað hefige byrðene on middanearde; ac getruwiað; ic forswiðde middaneard.

text: Ðās þing sē Hǣlend spræc, and āhōf upp his ēagan tō heofenum, and cwæð, Fæder, tīd ys cumen; geswutela þīnne Sunu, þæt þīn Sunu geswutelige þē:
text_bare: Ðas þing se Hælend spræc, and ahof upp his eagan to heofenum, and cwæð, Fæder, tid ys cumen; geswutela þinne Sunu, þæt þin Sunu geswutelige þe:

text: and swā þū him sealdest anweald ǣlces mannes, þæt hē sylle ēce līf eallum þām þe þū him sealdest.
text_bare: and swa þu him sealdest anweald ælces mannes, þæt he sylle ece lif eallum þam þe þu him sealdest.

text: Ðis ys sōðlīce ēce līf, þæt hī oncnāwon þæt þū eart ān sōþ God, and sē ðe þū sendest, Hǣlende Crīst.
text_bare: Ðis ys soðlice ece lif, þæt hi oncnawon þæt þu eart an soþ God, and se ðe þu sendest, Hælende Crist.

text: Ic þē geswutelode ofer eorþan; ic geendode þæt weorc þæt þū mē sealdest tō dōnne.
text_bare: Ic þe geswutelode ofer eorþan; ic geendode þæt weorc þæt þu me sealdest to donne.

text: And nū, ðū Fæder, gebeorhta mē mid þē sylfon, mid ðǣre beorhtnysse þe ic hæfde myd þē ǣr ðām þe middaneard wǣre.
text_bare: And nu, ðu Fæder, gebeorhta me mid þe sylfon, mid ðære beorhtnysse þe ic hæfde myd þe ær ðam þe middaneard wære.

text: Ic geswutolode þīnne naman þām mannon þe ðū mē sealdest of middanearde; hig wǣron þīne, and þū hȳ sealdest mē; and hī gehēoldon þīne sprǣce.
text_bare: Ic geswutolode þinne naman þam mannon þe ðu me sealdest of middanearde; hig wæron þine, and þu hy sealdest me; and hi geheoldon þine spræce.

text: Nū hī gecnēowon þæt ealle þā þing þe þū mē sealdest synd of ðē;
text_bare: Nu hi gecneowon þæt ealle þa þing þe þu me sealdest synd of ðe;

text: for þām ic sealde him þā word ðe ðū sealdest mē; and hig underfengon, and oncnēowon sōðlīce þæt ic cōm of þē, and hig gelȳfdon þæt þū mē sendest.
text_bare: for þam ic sealde him þa word ðe ðu sealdest me; and hig underfengon, and oncneowon soðlice þæt ic com of þe, and hig gelyfdon þæt þu me sendest.

text: Ic bidde for hig; ne bidde ic for middanearde, ac for þā þe ðū mē sealdest, for þām hī synt þīne;
text_bare: Ic bidde for hig; ne bidde ic for middanearde, ac for þa þe ðu me sealdest, for þam hi synt þine;

text: and ealle mīne synt þīne, and þīne synt mīne; and ic eom geswutelod on him.
text_bare: and ealle mine synt þine, and þine synt mine; and ic eom geswutelod on him.

text: And nū ic ne eom on middanearde, and hī synt on middanearde, and ic cume tō ðē.
text_bare: And nu ic ne eom on middanearde, and hi synt on middanearde, and ic cume to ðe.

text: On ðǣre tīde sē Hǣlend behēold his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð, Hāliga Fæder, heald on ðīnum naman þæt þū mē sealdest, þæt hi sȳn ān, swā wyt synt.
text_bare: On ðære tide se Hælend beheold his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð, Haliga Fæder, heald on ðinum naman þæt þu me sealdest, þæt hi syn an, swa wyt synt.

text: Þā ic wæs mid him, ic hēold hī on þīnum naman; ic hēold þā þe þū mē sealdest, and ne forwearð hyra nān, būton forspillydnysse bearn; þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled.
text_bare: Þa ic wæs mid him, ic heold hi on þinum naman; ic heold þa þe þu me sealdest, and ne forwearð hyra nan, buton forspillydnysse bearn; þæt þæt halige gewrit sy gefylled.

text: Nu ic cume tō þē; and ðās þing ic sprece on middanearde, þæt hī habbon mīnne gefēan gefyllydne on him sylfon.
text_bare: Nu ic cume to þe; and ðas þing ic sprece on middanearde, þæt hi habbon minne gefean gefyllydne on him sylfon.

text: Ic sealde him þīne sprǣce; and middaneard hī hæfde on hatunge, for þām hī ne synt of middanearde, swā ic ēac ne eom of middanearde.
text_bare: Ic sealde him þine spræce; and middaneard hi hæfde on hatunge, for þam hi ne synt of middanearde, swa ic eac ne eom of middanearde.

text: Ne bidde ic þæt þū hī nyme of middanearde, ac þæt þū hī gehealde of yfele.
text_bare: Ne bidde ic þæt þu hi nyme of middanearde, ac þæt þu hi gehealde of yfele.

text: Ne synt hī of middanearde, swā ic ne eom of middanearde.
text_bare: Ne synt hi of middanearde, swa ic ne eom of middanearde.

text: Gehālga hī on sōðfæstnysse; þīn sprǣc ys sōðfæstnyss.
text_bare: Gehalga hi on soðfæstnysse; þin spræc ys soðfæstnyss.

text: Swā þū mē sendest on middaneard, ic sende hī on middaneard.
text_bare: Swa þu me sendest on middaneard, ic sende hi on middaneard.

text: And for hig ic hālgige mē sylfne, þæt hig sȳn ēac gehālgode on sōðfæstnysse.
text_bare: And for hig ic halgige me sylfne, þæt hig syn eac gehalgode on soðfæstnysse.

text: Witodlīce ne gebidde ic for hī āne, ac ēac for ðā þe gȳt sceolon gelȳfan þurh hyra word on mē;
text_bare: Witodlice ne gebidde ic for hi ane, ac eac for ða þe gyt sceolon gelyfan þurh hyra word on me;

text: þæt ealle sȳn ān; swā þū Fæder eart on mē, and ic com on ðē, þæt hig sȳn ēac ān on unc; þæt middaneard gelȳfe þæt þū mē sendest.
text_bare: þæt ealle syn an; swa þu Fæder eart on me, and ic com on ðe, þæt hig syn eac an on unc; þæt middaneard gelyfe þæt þu me sendest.

text: And ic sealde him þā beorhtnysse þe ðū mē sealdest; þæt hī sȳn ān, swā wyt sȳn ān.
text_bare: And ic sealde him þa beorhtnysse þe ðu me sealdest; þæt hi syn an, swa wyt syn an.

text: Ic eom on him, and þū eart on mē, þæt hī sȳn geendode on ān; þæt middaneard oncnāwe þæt þū mē sendest, and lufodest hig, swā þū mē lufodest.
text_bare: Ic eom on him, and þu eart on me, þæt hi syn geendode on an; þæt middaneard oncnawe þæt þu me sendest, and lufodest hig, swa þu me lufodest.

text: Fæder, ic wylle þæt þā þe þū mē sealdest sȳn mid mē þār ic eom; þæt hig gesēon mīne beorhtnysse þe þū mē sealdest; for þām þū lufodest mē ǣr middaneard gesett wæs.
text_bare: Fæder, ic wylle þæt þa þe þu me sealdest syn mid me þar ic eom; þæt hig geseon mine beorhtnysse þe þu me sealdest; for þam þu lufodest me ær middaneard gesett wæs.

text: Lā, rihtwīīsa Fæder, middaneard þē ne gecnēow; witodlīce ic ðē gecnēow; and hī oncnēowon þæt þū mē sendyst;
text_bare: La, rihtwiisa Fæder, middaneard þe ne gecneow; witodlice ic ðe gecneow; and hi oncneowon þæt þu me sendyst;
