text: and ic him cȳðde ðīnne naman, and gȳt wylle cȳþan; þæt sēo lufu ðe þū mē lufodest sȳ on him, and ic on him.
text_bare: and ic him cyðde ðinne naman, and gyt wylle cyþan; þæt seo lufu ðe þu me lufodest sy on him, and ic on him.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend þās þing cwæð, þā ēode hē ofer ðā burnan Cedron, ðǣr wæs ān wyrtūn, intō þām hē ēode and his leorningcnihtas.
text_bare: Þa se Hælend þas þing cwæð, þa eode he ofer ða burnan Cedron, ðær wæs an wyrtun, into þam he eode and his leorningcnihtas.

text: Witodlīce Iudas, þe hyne belǣwde, wiste þā stōwe; for þām þe sē Hǣlend oftrǣdlīce cōm ðyder mid his leorningcnihton.
text_bare: Witodlice Iudas, þe hyne belæwde, wiste þa stowe; for þam þe se Hælend oftrædlice com ðyder mid his leorningcnihton.

text: Þā underfēng Iudas þæt folc and þā þegnas æt þām bisceopum and æt ðām Phariseon, and cōm þyder mid lēohtfatum and mid blasum and mid wǣpnum.
text_bare: Þa underfeng Iudas þæt folc and þa þegnas æt þam bisceopum and æt ðam Phariseon, and com þyder mid leohtfatum and mid blasum and mid wæpnum.

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend wiste ealle þā þing þe him tōwearde wǣron; hē ēode ðā forð, and cwæð tō him, Hwæne sēce gē?
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend wiste ealle þa þing þe him towearde wæron; he eode ða forð, and cwæð to him, Hwæne sece ge?

text: Hig andswaredon him and cwǣdon, Ðone Nazareniscean Hǣlend.
text_bare: Hig andswaredon him and cwædon, Ðone Nazareniscean Hælend.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð, Ic hit eom.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð, Ic hit eom.

text: Sōðlīce Iudas þe hine belǣwde stōd mid him.
text_bare: Soðlice Iudas þe hine belæwde stod mid him.

text: Ðā hē openlīce sǣde, Ic hit eom, ðā ēodon hig under bæc and fēollon on ðā eorþan.
text_bare: Ða he openlice sæde, Ic hit eom, ða eodon hig under bæc and feollon on ða eorþan.

text: Eft hē hī āxode, Hwæne sēce gē?
text_bare: Eft he hi axode, Hwæne sece ge?

text: Hī cwǣdon, Þone Nazareniscean Hǣlend.
text_bare: Hi cwædon, Þone Nazareniscean Hælend.

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Ic sǣde ēow þæt ic hit eom.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode, Ic sæde eow þæt ic hit eom.

text: Gif gē witodlīce me seceað, lǣtað þās faran:
text_bare: Gif ge witodlice me seceað, lætað þas faran:

text: þæt sēo sprǣc wǣre gefylled þe hē cwæð, Þæt ic nānne þǣra ne forspille þe ðū mē sealdest.
text_bare: þæt seo spræc wære gefylled þe he cwæð, Þæt ic nanne þæra ne forspille þe ðu me sealdest.

text: Witodlīce Simon Petrus ātēah his swurd, and slōh ðæs bisceopes þēowan, and ācerf him of swȳðre ēare.
text_bare: Witodlice Simon Petrus ateah his swurd, and sloh ðæs bisceopes þeowan, and acerf him of swyðre eare.

text: Þæs þēowan nama wæs Malchus.
text_bare: Þæs þeowan nama wæs Malchus.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō Petre, Dō þīn swurd on scēaðe; þone calic þe mīn Fæder mē sealde, ne drince ic hine?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to Petre, Do þin swurd on sceaðe; þone calic þe min Fæder me sealde, ne drince ic hine?

text: Ðæt folc and sē ealdor and þǣra Iudea ðegnas nāmon þone Hǣlend and bundon hine, .
text_bare: Ðæt folc and se ealdor and þæra Iudea ðegnas namon þone Hælend and bundon hine, .

text: and lǣddon hine ǣrest tō Annan, sē wæs Caiphas swēor, and sē Caiphas wæs ðæs gēares bisceop.
text_bare: and læddon hine ærest to Annan, se wæs Caiphas sweor, and se Caiphas wæs ðæs geares bisceop.

text: Witodlīce Kaiphas dihte ðām Iudeon and cwæð þæt hyt wǣre betere þæt ān man swulte for folc.
text_bare: Witodlice Kaiphas dihte ðam Iudeon and cwæð þæt hyt wære betere þæt an man swulte for folc.

text: Simon Petrus fylide þām Hǣlende, and ōðer leorningcniht.
text_bare: Simon Petrus fylide þam Hælende, and oðer leorningcniht.

text: Sē ōðer leorningcniht wæs ðām bisceope cūð, and hē ēode inn mid þām Hǣlende on ðæs bisceopes cafertūn.
text_bare: Se oðer leorningcniht wæs ðam bisceope cuð, and he eode inn mid þam Hælende on ðæs bisceopes cafertun.

text: Petrus stōd at ðǣre dura þǣr ūte.
text_bare: Petrus stod at ðære dura þær ute.

text: Þā ēode sē leorningcniht ūt þe wæs ðæs bisceopes cūða, and cwæð tō ðǣre dureþīnene, and lǣdde Petrum inn.
text_bare: Þa eode se leorningcniht ut þe wæs ðæs bisceopes cuða, and cwæð to ðære dureþinene, and lædde Petrum inn.

text: Ðā cwæð sēo duruðīnen tō Petre, Cwyst ðū eart ðū of ðyses leorningcnihtum?
text_bare: Ða cwæð seo duruðinen to Petre, Cwyst ðu eart ðu of ðyses leorningcnihtum?

text: Ðā cwæð hē, Nicc, ne eom ic.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he, Nicc, ne eom ic.

text: Ðā þēowas and ðā þegnas stōdon at ðām glēdon and wyrmdon hig, for þām hit was ceald; witodlīce Petrus stōd mid him and wyrmde hyne.
text_bare: Ða þeowas and ða þegnas stodon at ðam gledon and wyrmdon hig, for þam hit was ceald; witodlice Petrus stod mid him and wyrmde hyne.

text: Sē bisceop āxode þone Hǣlend embe his leorningcnihtas, and embe his lāre.
text_bare: Se bisceop axode þone Hælend embe his leorningcnihtas, and embe his lare.

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð, Ic spræc openlīce tō middanearde, and ic lǣrde symble on gesomnunge, and on temple, þār ealle Iudeas tōgædere cōmon; and ic ne spæc nān þing dīgelīce.
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend and cwæð, Ic spræc openlice to middanearde, and ic lærde symble on gesomnunge, and on temple, þar ealle Iudeas togædere comon; and ic ne spæc nan þing digelice.

text: Hwī āxast ðū mē?
text_bare: Hwi axast ðu me?

text: āxa þā þe gehȳrdon hwæt ic tō him spræc; hī witon þā ðing þe ic him sǣde.
text_bare: axa þa þe gehyrdon hwæt ic to him spræc; hi witon þa ðing þe ic him sæde.

text: Ðā hē þis cwæð, þā slōh ān ðǣra þēna þe ðār stōdon ðone Hǣlend mid his handa, and cwæð, Andswarast ðū swā þām bisceope?
text_bare: Ða he þis cwæð, þa sloh an ðæra þena þe ðar stodon ðone Hælend mid his handa, and cwæð, Andswarast ðu swa þam bisceope?

text: Sē Hǣlend andswarode him and cwæð, Gif ic yfele spræc, cȳð gewittnysse be yfele; gif ic wel spræc, hwī bēatst þū mē?
text_bare: Se Hælend andswarode him and cwæð, Gif ic yfele spræc, cyð gewittnysse be yfele; gif ic wel spræc, hwi beatst þu me?

text: Ðā sende Annas hine tō þām bisceope gebundene.
text_bare: Ða sende Annas hine to þam bisceope gebundene.

text: And Symon Petrus stōd and wyrmde hync.
text_bare: And Symon Petrus stod and wyrmde hync.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hī tō him, Cwyst þū eart þū of his leorningcnihton?
text_bare: Ða cwædon hi to him, Cwyst þu eart þu of his leorningcnihton?

text: Hē wiðsōc, and cwæð, Ic ne eom.
text_bare: He wiðsoc, and cwæð, Ic ne eom.

text: Ðā cwæð ān ðæs bisceopas þēowena, hys cūða þæs ēare slōh Petrus of, Hū ne geseah ic ðē on ðām wyrtūne mid hym?
text_bare: Ða cwæð an ðæs bisceopas þeowena, hys cuða þæs eare sloh Petrus of, Hu ne geseah ic ðe on ðam wyrtune mid hym?

text: Petrus þā eft wiðsōc; and sōna se cocc crēow.
text_bare: Petrus þa eft wiðsoc; and sona se cocc creow.

text: Ðā gelǣddon hī þone Hǣlend tō Caiphan on þæt dōmern; hit wæs þā morgen; and hig sylue ne ēodon intō ðām dōmerne, þæt hyg nǣron besmitene, ac þæt hi ǣton hyra ēastron.
text_bare: Ða gelæddon hi þone Hælend to Caiphan on þæt domern; hit wæs þa morgen; and hig sylue ne eodon into ðam domerne, þæt hyg næron besmitene, ac þæt hi æton hyra eastron.

text: Þā ēode Pilatus ūt tō him, and cwæð, Hwylce wrōhte bringe gē ongēan þysne man?
text_bare: Þa eode Pilatus ut to him, and cwæð, Hwylce wrohte bringe ge ongean þysne man?

text: Hig answaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Gif hē nǣre yfeldǣde, ne sealde wē hine ðē.
text_bare: Hig answaredon and cwædon to him, Gif he nære yfeldæde, ne sealde we hine ðe.

text: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Nimað hine, and demað him be ēowre ǣ.
text_bare: Þa cwæð Pilatus to him, Nimað hine, and demað him be eowre æ.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas tō him, Ūs nis nā ālȳfed þæt wē ǣnigne mann ofslēan;
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa Iudeas to him, Us nis na alyfed þæt we ænigne mann ofslean;

text: þæt þæs Hǣlendes sprǣc wǣre gefylled þe hēe cwæð þā hē geswutelode hwylcon dēaðe hē swulte.
text_bare: þæt þæs Hælendes spræc wære gefylled þe hee cwæð þa he geswutelode hwylcon deaðe he swulte.

text: Ðā ēode Pilatus eft intō þām dōmerne, and clypode ðone Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Eart ðū Iudea Cining?
text_bare: Ða eode Pilatus eft into þam domerne, and clypode ðone Hælend and cwæð to him, Eart ðu Iudea Cining?

text: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, Cwyst þū þis of ðē sylfum, hwæðer ðe hyt þē ōðre sǣdon?
text_bare: Ða andswarode se Hælend him and cwæð, Cwyst þu þis of ðe sylfum, hwæðer ðe hyt þe oðre sædon?

text: Pilatus him andswarode and cwæð, Cwyst þū eom ic Iudeisc?
text_bare: Pilatus him andswarode and cwæð, Cwyst þu eom ic Iudeisc?

text: Þīn þēod and þīne bisceopas ðē sealdon mē; hwæt dydest ðū?
text_bare: Þin þeod and þine bisceopas ðe sealdon me; hwæt dydest ðu?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Mīn rīce nys of ðyson middanearde; gif mīn rīce wǣre of ðyson middanearde, witodlīce mīne þegnas fuhton þæt ic nǣre geseald Iudeon; nis mīn rīce of ðyson middanearde.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend, Min rice nys of ðyson middanearde; gif min rice wære of ðyson middanearde, witodlice mine þegnas fuhton þæt ic nære geseald Iudeon; nis min rice of ðyson middanearde.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Eart ðū witodlīce cyning?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus to him, Eart ðu witodlice cyning?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ðū hit segst þæt ic eom cyng.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode and cwæð, Ðu hit segst þæt ic eom cyng.

text: On ðām ic eom geboren, and tō þām ic cōm on middaneard, þæt ic cȳðe sōþfæstnysse.
text_bare: On ðam ic eom geboren, and to þam ic com on middaneard, þæt ic cyðe soþfæstnysse.

text: Ǣlc þǣra þe ys on sōðfæstnysse gehȳrð mīne stefne.
text_bare: Ælc þæra þe ys on soðfæstnysse gehyrð mine stefne.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Hwæt ys sōðfæstnyss?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus to him, Hwæt ys soðfæstnyss?

text: And þā hē ðis cwæð, þā ēode hē eft ūt tō þām Iudeon, and cwæð tō him, Ne funde ic nānne gylt on ðyson menn.
text_bare: And þa he ðis cwæð, þa eode he eft ut to þam Iudeon, and cwæð to him, Ne funde ic nanne gylt on ðyson menn.

text: Hit ys ēowor gewuna þæt ic forgyfe ēow ānne mann on ēastron; wylle gē þæt ic forgyfe ēow Iudea Cyning?
text_bare: Hit ys eowor gewuna þæt ic forgyfe eow anne mann on eastron; wylle ge þæt ic forgyfe eow Iudea Cyning?

text: Hig clypodon ealle and cwǣdon, Nā ðysne, ac Barrabban.
text_bare: Hig clypodon ealle and cwædon, Na ðysne, ac Barrabban.

text: Witodlīce Barrabbas was þēof.
text_bare: Witodlice Barrabbas was þeof.

text: Ðā nam Pilatus þone Hǣlend, and swang hyne.
text_bare: Ða nam Pilatus þone Hælend, and swang hyne.

text: And þā þēnas wundon þyrnenne cynehelm, and āsetton hyne on his hēafod, and scrȳddon hyne mid purpuran rēafe;
text_bare: And þa þenas wundon þyrnenne cynehelm, and asetton hyne on his heafod, and scryddon hyne mid purpuran reafe;

text: and hī cōmon tō hym, and cwǣdon, Hāl bēo ðū, Iudea Cyning!
text_bare: and hi comon to hym, and cwædon, Hal beo ðu, Iudea Cyning!

text: and hī plætton hyne mid hyra handum.
text_bare: and hi plætton hyne mid hyra handum.

text: Ðā ēode Pilatus eft ūt, and cwæð, Nū ic hyne lǣde hider ūt tō ēow, þæt gē ongyton þæt ic ne funde nānne gylt on him.
text_bare: Ða eode Pilatus eft ut, and cwæð, Nu ic hyne læde hider ut to eow, þæt ge ongyton þæt ic ne funde nanne gylt on him.

text: Þā ēode sē Hælend ūt, and bær þyrnenne cynehelm and purpuran reaf.
text_bare: Þa eode se Hælend ut, and bær þyrnenne cynehelm and purpuran reaf.

text: And Pilatus sǣde him, Hēr is mann!
text_bare: And Pilatus sæde him, Her is mann!

text: Witodlīce þā þā bisceopas and ðā þegnas hine gesāwon, ðā clypodon hig and cwǣdon, Hōh hyne, hōh hyne.
text_bare: Witodlice þa þa bisceopas and ða þegnas hine gesawon, ða clypodon hig and cwædon, Hoh hyne, hoh hyne.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Nime gē hine and hōð; ic ne funde nānne gylt on him.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus to him, Nime ge hine and hoð; ic ne funde nanne gylt on him.

text: Þā Iudeas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, Wē habbað ǣ, and be ūre ǣ hē sceal sweltan, for þām þe hē cwæð þæt hē wǣre Godes Sunu.
text_bare: Þa Iudeas him andswaredon and cwædon, We habbað æ, and be ure æ he sceal sweltan, for þam þe he cwæð þæt he wære Godes Sunu.

text: Þā Pilatus gehȳrde þās sprǣce, þā ondrēd hē him þæs þē swīðor;
text_bare: Þa Pilatus gehyrde þas spræce, þa ondred he him þæs þe swiðor;

text: and ēode eft intō þām dōmerne, and cwæð tō ðām Hǣlende, Hwanon eart ðū?
text_bare: and eode eft into þam domerne, and cwæð to ðam Hælende, Hwanon eart ðu?

text: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend him ne sealde nāne andsware.
text_bare: Witodlice se Hælend him ne sealde nane andsware.

text: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Hwī ne sprycst ðū wiþ mē?
text_bare: Þa cwæð Pilatus to him, Hwi ne sprycst ðu wiþ me?

text: Nāst þū þæt ic hæbbe mihte þē tō hōnne, and ic hæbbe mihte þē tō forlǣtenne?
text_bare: Nast þu þæt ic hæbbe mihte þe to honne, and ic hæbbe mihte þe to forlætenne?

text: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Næfdest þū nāne mihte ongēan mē, būton hyt wǣre þē ufan geseald; for þām sē hæfð māran synne sē ðe mē þē sealde.
text_bare: Se Hælend him andswarode, Næfdest þu nane mihte ongean me, buton hyt wære þe ufan geseald; for þam se hæfð maran synne se ðe me þe sealde.

text: And syðan sōhte Pilatus hū hē hyne forlēte.
text_bare: And syðan sohte Pilatus hu he hyne forlete.

text: Ðā Iudeas clypodon and cwǣdon, Gif þū hine forlǣtst, ne eart ðū þæs Cāseres frēond; ǣlc þǣra þe hyne tō cynge dēð ys þæs Cāseres wiðersaca.
text_bare: Ða Iudeas clypodon and cwædon, Gif þu hine forlætst, ne eart ðu þæs Caseres freond; ælc þæra þe hyne to cynge deð ys þæs Caseres wiðersaca.

text: Ðā Pilatus þās sprǣce gehȳrde, þā lǣdde hē ūt þone Hǣlend, and sæt ætforan þām dōmsetle on ðǣre stōwe þe is genemned Lithostrōtus, and on Ebrēisc, Gabbatha.
text_bare: Ða Pilatus þas spræce gehyrde, þa lædde he ut þone Hælend, and sæt ætforan þam domsetle on ðære stowe þe is genemned Lithostrotus, and on Ebreisc, Gabbatha.

text: Hit wæs þā ēastra gegearcungdæg; and hyt wæs sēo syxte tīd.
text_bare: Hit wæs þa eastra gegearcungdæg; and hyt wæs seo syxte tid.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō ðām Iudeon, Hēr ys ēower Cyning!
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to ðam Iudeon, Her ys eower Cyning!

text: Hī clypodon ealle and cwǣdon, Nim hyne, nim hyne, and hōh.
text_bare: Hi clypodon ealle and cwædon, Nim hyne, nim hyne, and hoh.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus, Sceal ic hōn ēowerne Cyning?
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus, Sceal ic hon eowerne Cyning?

text: Him andswaredon þā bisceopas and cwǣdon, Næbbe wē nānne cyning būton Kāsere.
text_bare: Him andswaredon þa bisceopas and cwædon, Næbbe we nanne cyning buton Kasere.

text: Ðā sealde hē hyne hym tō āhōnne.
text_bare: Ða sealde he hyne hym to ahonne.

text: Ðā nāmon hȳ þone Hǣlend, and tugon hine ūt;
text_bare: Ða namon hy þone Hælend, and tugon hine ut;

text: and hē bær his rōde mid him on þā stōwe þe ys genemned hēafodpannan stōw, and on Ebrēisc Golgotha;
text_bare: and he bær his rode mid him on þa stowe þe ys genemned heafodpannan stow, and on Ebreisc Golgotha;

text: þǣr hī hyne ahēngon, and twēgen ōðre mid him on twā healfa, and þone Hǣlend on middan.
text_bare: þær hi hyne ahengon, and twegen oðre mid him on twa healfa, and þone Hælend on middan.

text: Witodlīce Pilatus wrāt ofergewrit, and sette ofer his rōde; þǣr wæs on gewriten, Þis ys sē Nazareniscea Hǣlend, Iudea Cyning.
text_bare: Witodlice Pilatus wrat ofergewrit, and sette ofer his rode; þær wæs on gewriten, Þis ys se Nazareniscea Hælend, Iudea Cyning.

text: Manega ðǣra Iudea rǣddon þis gewrit; for þām þe sēo stōw was gehende þǣre ceastre þǣr sē Hǣlend wæs āhangen.
text_bare: Manega ðæra Iudea ræddon þis gewrit; for þam þe seo stow was gehende þære ceastre þær se Hælend wæs ahangen.

text: Hit was āwriten Ebrēisceon stafon, and Grēcisceon, and Lēdenstafon.
text_bare: Hit was awriten Ebreisceon stafon, and Grecisceon, and Ledenstafon.

text: Ðā cwǣdon þā bisceopas tō Pilate, Ne wrīt ðū Iudea Cyng, ac þæt hē cwǣde, Ic eom Iudea Cyning.
text_bare: Ða cwædon þa bisceopas to Pilate, Ne writ ðu Iudea Cyng, ac þæt he cwæde, Ic eom Iudea Cyning.

text: Ðā cwæð Pilatus, Ic wrāt þæt ic wrāt.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Pilatus, Ic wrat þæt ic wrat.

text: Ðā þā cempan hine āhēngon, hī nāmon his rēaf, and worhton fēower dǣlas, ǣlcon cempan ānne dǣl; and tunecan: sāo tunece was unāsīwod, and was eall āwefen.
text_bare: Ða þa cempan hine ahengon, hi namon his reaf, and worhton feower dælas, ælcon cempan anne dæl; and tunecan: sao tunece was unasiwod, and was eall awefen.

text: Ðā cwǣdon hī him betwēonan, Ne slīte wē hȳ, ac uton hlēotan hwylces ūre hēo sȳ; þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled þe þus cwyþ, Hī tōdǣldon him mīne rēaf, and ofer mine rēaf hī wurpon hlott.
text_bare: Ða cwædon hi him betweonan, Ne slite we hy, ac uton hleotan hwylces ure heo sy; þæt þæt halige gewrit sy gefylled þe þus cwyþ, Hi todældon him mine reaf, and ofer mine reaf hi wurpon hlott.

text: Witodlīce þus dydon þā cempan.
text_bare: Witodlice þus dydon þa cempan.

text: Ðā stōdon wið þā rōde þæs Hǣlendes mōdor, and his mōdor swustor, Maria Cleophe, and Maria Magdalenisce.
text_bare: Ða stodon wið þa rode þæs Hælendes modor, and his modor swustor, Maria Cleophe, and Maria Magdalenisce.

text: Ðā sē Hǣlend gesēah his mōdor, and þone leorningcniht standende þe hē lufode, þā cwæð hē tō his mēder, Wīf, hēr ys þīn sunu!
text_bare: Ða se Hælend geseah his modor, and þone leorningcniht standende þe he lufode, þa cwæð he to his meder, Wif, her ys þin sunu!

text: Eft hē cwæð tō þām leorningcnihte, Hēr ys þīn mōdor!
text_bare: Eft he cwæð to þam leorningcnihte, Her ys þin modor!

text: And of þǣre tīde sē leorningcniht hī nam tō him.
text_bare: And of þære tide se leorningcniht hi nam to him.

text: Æfter ðyson, þā sē Hǣlend wiste þæt ealle ðing wǣron geendode, þæt þæt hālige gewrit wǣre gefylled, þā cwæð hē, Mē þyrst.
text_bare: Æfter ðyson, þa se Hælend wiste þæt ealle ðing wæron geendode, þæt þæt halige gewrit wære gefylled, þa cwæð he, Me þyrst.

text: Ðā stōd ān fæt full ecedes; hī bewundon āne spyngan mid ysopo, sēo wæs full ecedes, and setton tō his mūðe.
text_bare: Ða stod an fæt full ecedes; hi bewundon ane spyngan mid ysopo, seo wæs full ecedes, and setton to his muðe.

text: Þā sē Hǣlend onfeng þæs ecedes, ðā cwæð hē, Hyt ys geendod: and hē āhylde his hēafod, and āgef his gāst.
text_bare: Þa se Hælend onfeng þæs ecedes, ða cwæð he, Hyt ys geendod: and he ahylde his heafod, and agef his gast.

text: Ðā Iudeas bǣdon Pilatum þæt man forbrǣce hyra sceancan, and lēte hī nyðer, for þām þe hit was gegearcungdæg, þæt þā līchaman ne wunodon on rōde on restedæge; - sē dæg was mǣre restedæg.
text_bare: Ða Iudeas bædon Pilatum þæt man forbræce hyra sceancan, and lete hi nyðer, for þam þe hit was gegearcungdæg, þæt þa lichaman ne wunodon on rode on restedæge; - se dæg was mære restedæg.

text: Ðā cōmon þā cempan, and brǣcon ðæs forman sceancan, and ðæs ōðres, þe mid him āhangen wæs.
text_bare: Ða comon þa cempan, and bræcon ðæs forman sceancan, and ðæs oðres, þe mid him ahangen wæs.

text: Þā hī tō þām Hǣlende cōmon, and gesāwon þæt hē dēad wæs, ne brǣcon hī nā his sceancan;
text_bare: Þa hi to þam Hælende comon, and gesawon þæt he dead wæs, ne bræcon hi na his sceancan;

text: ac ān þǣra cempena geopenode his sīdan mid spere, and hrædlīce þār flēow blōd ūt and wæter.
text_bare: ac an þæra cempena geopenode his sidan mid spere, and hrædlice þar fleow blod ut and wæter.

text: And sē ðe hit geseah cȳðde gewitnesse, and his gewitnes is sōð; and hē wāt þæt hē sōð sǣde, þæt gē gelȳfon.
text_bare: And se ðe hit geseah cyðde gewitnesse, and his gewitnes is soð; and he wat þæt he soð sæde, þæt ge gelyfon.

text: Ðās þing wǣron gewordene þæt þæt gewrit wǣre gefylled, Ne forbræce gē nān bān on him.
text_bare: Ðas þing wæron gewordene þæt þæt gewrit wære gefylled, Ne forbræce ge nan ban on him.

text: And eft ōðer gewrit segð, Hī gesēoð on hwæne hig onfæstnodon.
text_bare: And eft oðer gewrit segð, Hi geseoð on hwæne hig onfæstnodon.

text: Witodlīce Iosep fram Arimathea bæd Pilatum þæt hē mōste niman þæs Hǣlendes līchaman, for þām þe hē wæs þæs Hǣlendes leorningcniht; þis hē dyde dearnunga for ðǣra Iudea ege; and Pilatus him lȳfde.
text_bare: Witodlice Iosep fram Arimathea bæd Pilatum þæt he moste niman þæs Hælendes lichaman, for þam þe he wæs þæs Hælendes leorningcniht; þis he dyde dearnunga for ðæra Iudea ege; and Pilatus him lyfde.

text: Ðā cōm hē, and nām þæs Hǣlendes līchaman.
text_bare: Ða com he, and nam þæs Hælendes lichaman.

text: And Nichodemus cōm ðyder, sē þe ǣrest cōm tō þām Hǣlende on niht, and brōhte wyrtgemang and alewan, swylce hundtēontig boxa.
text_bare: And Nichodemus com ðyder, se þe ærest com to þam Hælende on niht, and brohte wyrtgemang and alewan, swylce hundteontig boxa.

text: Hig nāmon þæs Hǣlendes līchaman, and bewundon hine mid līnenum clāðe mid wyrtgemangum, swā Iudea þēaw ys tō bebyrgenne.
text_bare: Hig namon þæs Hælendes lichaman, and bewundon hine mid linenum claðe mid wyrtgemangum, swa Iudea þeaw ys to bebyrgenne.

text: Witodlīce þār wæs wyrtūn on ðǣre stōwe þār sē Hǣlend āhangen wæs; and on þām wyrtūne wæs nīwe byrgen, on þǣre þā gȳt nān mann næs ālēd.
text_bare: Witodlice þar wæs wyrtun on ðære stowe þar se Hælend ahangen wæs; and on þam wyrtune wæs niwe byrgen, on þære þa gyt nan mann næs aled.

text: Sōðlīce pār hig lēdon þone Hǣlend, for þām þǣra Iudea gearcung wæs wið þā byrgene.
text_bare: Soðlice par hig ledon þone Hælend, for þam þæra Iudea gearcung wæs wið þa byrgene.

text: Witodlīce on ānon restedæge sēo Magdalenisce Maria cōm on mergen, ǣr hit lēoht wǣre, tō þǣre byrgenne, and hēo geseah þæt sē stān aweg ānumen wæs fram þǣre byrgynne.
text_bare: Witodlice on anon restedæge seo Magdalenisce Maria com on mergen, ær hit leoht wære, to þære byrgenne, and heo geseah þæt se stan aweg anumen wæs fram þære byrgynne.

text: Ðā arn hēo and cōm tō Simone Petre and tō þām oðron leorningcnihte þe sē Hǣlend lufode, and hēo cwæð tō him, Hī nāmon Drihten of byrgene, and wē nyton hwār hī hyne lēdon.
text_bare: Ða arn heo and com to Simone Petre and to þam oðron leorningcnihte þe se Hælend lufode, and heo cwæð to him, Hi namon Drihten of byrgene, and we nyton hwar hi hyne ledon.

text: Petrus ēode ūt and sē ōðer leorningcniht, and cōmun tō þǣre byrgene.
text_bare: Petrus eode ut and se oðer leorningcniht, and comun to þære byrgene.

text: Witodlīce hig twēgen urnon ætgædere; and sē ōðer leorningcniht forarn Petre forne, and cōm raðor tō ðǣre byrgenne;
text_bare: Witodlice hig twegen urnon ætgædere; and se oðer leorningcniht forarn Petre forne, and com raðor to ðære byrgenne;

text: and þā hē nyder ābēah, hē geseah þā līnwǣda licgan; and ne ēode þēah in.
text_bare: and þa he nyder abeah, he geseah þa linwæda licgan; and ne eode þeah in.

text: Witodlīce Simon Petrus cōm æfter him, and ēode intō ðǣre byrgene, and hē geseah līnwāda licgean,
text_bare: Witodlice Simon Petrus com æfter him, and eode into ðære byrgene, and he geseah linwada licgean,

text: and þæt swātlīn þe wæs uppan his hēafde; ne læg hyt nā mid þām līnwādon, ac onsundron gefealden on ānre stōwe.
text_bare: and þæt swatlin þe wæs uppan his heafde; ne læg hyt na mid þam linwadon, ac onsundron gefealden on anre stowe.

text: Ðā ēode ēac in sē leorningcniht þe ǣrest cōm tō ðǣre byrgene, and geseah, and gelȳfde.
text_bare: Ða eode eac in se leorningcniht þe ærest com to ðære byrgene, and geseah, and gelyfde.

text: Witodlīce þā gȳt hī ne cūðon hālig gewrit, þæt hit gebyrede þæt hē sceolde fram dēaðe ārīsan.
text_bare: Witodlice þa gyt hi ne cuðon halig gewrit, þæt hit gebyrede þæt he sceolde fram deaðe arisan.

text: Ðā fōron eft þā leorningcnihtas to þām ōðron.
text_bare: Ða foron eft þa leorningcnihtas to þam oðron.

text: Witodlīce Maria stōd þār ūte æt ðǣre byrgyne, and wēop; and þā hēo wēop, hēo ābeah nyðer and beseah innan þā byrgene,
text_bare: Witodlice Maria stod þar ute æt ðære byrgyne, and weop; and þa heo weop, heo abeah nyðer and beseah innan þa byrgene,

text: and geseah twēgen englas sittan mid hwīton rēafe, ānne æt þām hēafdon and ōðerne æt þām fōtum, þǣr ðæs Hǣlendes līc ālēd wæs.
text_bare: and geseah twegen englas sittan mid hwiton reafe, anne æt þam heafdon and oðerne æt þam fotum, þær ðæs Hælendes lic aled wæs.

text: Hī cwǣdon tō hyre, Wīf hwī wēpst þū?
text_bare: Hi cwædon to hyre, Wif hwi wepst þu?

text: Þā cwæð hēo tō hym, For þām hī nāmon mīnne Drihten, and ic nāt hwār hī hine lēdon.
text_bare: Þa cwæð heo to hym, For þam hi namon minne Drihten, and ic nat hwar hi hine ledon.

text: Ðā hēo þās þing sǣde, þā bewende hēo hī on bæc, and geseah hwār se Hǣlend stōd, and hēo nyste þæt hyt sē Hǣlend wæs.
text_bare: Ða heo þas þing sæde, þa bewende heo hi on bæc, and geseah hwar se Hælend stod, and heo nyste þæt hyt se Hælend wæs.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Wīf, hwī wēpst ðū?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Wif, hwi wepst ðu?

text: hwæne sēcst þū?
text_bare: hwæne secst þu?

text: Hēo wēnde þæt hit sē wyrtweard wǣre, and cwæð tō him, Lēof, gif þū hine nāme, sege mē hwār þū hine lēdest, and ic hine nime.
text_bare: Heo wende þæt hit se wyrtweard wære, and cwæð to him, Leof, gif þu hine name, sege me hwar þu hine ledest, and ic hine nime.

text: Dā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Maria.
text_bare: Da cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Maria.

text: Hēo bewende hī, and cwæð tō him, Rabbōni; þæt ys gecweden Lārēow.
text_bare: Heo bewende hi, and cwæð to him, Rabboni; þæt ys gecweden Lareow.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Ne æthrīn þū mīn; nū gȳt ic ne āstāh tō mīnon Fæder.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to hyre, Ne æthrin þu min; nu gyt ic ne astah to minon Fæder.

text: Gang tō mīnon brōþron, and sege him, Ic āstīge tō mīnon Fæder and tō ēowron Fæder, and tō mīnon Gode and tō ēowron Gode.
text_bare: Gang to minon broþron, and sege him, Ic astige to minon Fæder and to eowron Fæder, and to minon Gode and to eowron Gode.

text: Ðā cōm sēo Magdalenisce Maria, and cȳðde þām leorningcnihton and cwæð, Ic geseah Drihten; and þās þing hē mē sǣde.
text_bare: Ða com seo Magdalenisce Maria, and cyðde þam leorningcnihton and cwæð, Ic geseah Drihten; and þas þing he me sæde.

text: Ðā hit wæs ǣfen, on ānon þǣra restedaga, and ðā dura wǣron belocene ðǣr þā leorningcnihtas wǣron gegaderode for ðǣra Iudea ege, sē Hǣlend cōm and stōd tōmiddes hyra, and cwæð tō him, Sī sibb mid ēow.
text_bare: Ða hit wæs æfen, on anon þæra restedaga, and ða dura wæron belocene ðær þa leorningcnihtas wæron gegaderode for ðæra Iudea ege, se Hælend com and stod tomiddes hyra, and cwæð to him, Si sibb mid eow.

text: And þā hē þæt cwæð, hē ætȳwde him his handa and his sīdan.
text_bare: And þa he þæt cwæð, he ætywde him his handa and his sidan.

text: Ðā leorningcnihtas wǣron blīþe, þā hī hæfdon Drihten gesewen.
text_bare: Ða leorningcnihtas wæron bliþe, þa hi hæfdon Drihten gesewen.

text: Hē cwæð eft tō him, Sī sib mid ēow; swā swā Fæder mē sende, ic sende ēow.
text_bare: He cwæð eft to him, Si sib mid eow; swa swa Fæder me sende, ic sende eow.

text: Ðā hē þæt cwæð, þā blēow hē on hī, and cwæð tō him, Underfōð Hāligne Gāst:
text_bare: Ða he þæt cwæð, þa bleow he on hi, and cwæð to him, Underfoð Haligne Gast:

text: þǣra synna þe gē forgyfað, hig bēoð him forgifene; and þāra þe gē healdað, hig bēoþ gehealdene.
text_bare: þæra synna þe ge forgyfað, hig beoð him forgifene; and þara þe ge healdað, hig beoþ gehealdene.

text: Witodlīce Thomas, ān of þām twelfon, þe ys gecweden Didimus, þæt ys gelīcust, on ūre geþēode, hē næs mid him þā sē Hǣlend cōm.
text_bare: Witodlice Thomas, an of þam twelfon, þe ys gecweden Didimus, þæt ys gelicust, on ure geþeode, he næs mid him þa se Hælend com.

text: Ðā cwǣdon ða ōðre leorningcnihtas tō him, Wē gesāwon Drihten.
text_bare: Ða cwædon ða oðre leorningcnihtas to him, We gesawon Drihten.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Ne gelȳfe ic, buton ic gesēo þǣra nægela fæstnunge on his handa, and ic dō mīnne finger on ðǣra nægela stede, and dō mīne hand tō his sīdan.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, Ne gelyfe ic, buton ic geseo þæra nægela fæstnunge on his handa, and ic do minne finger on ðæra nægela stede, and do mine hand to his sidan.

text: And eft æfter eahta dagun his leorningcnihtas wǣron inne, and Thomas mid him.
text_bare: And eft æfter eahta dagun his leorningcnihtas wæron inne, and Thomas mid him.

text: Sē Hǣlend cōm, belocenum duron, and stōd tōmiddes him, and cwæð, Sȳ ēow sib.
text_bare: Se Hælend com, belocenum duron, and stod tomiddes him, and cwæð, Sy eow sib.

text: Syððan hē sǣde Thome, Dō ðīnne finger hider, and geseoh mīne handa; and nim þīne hand and dō on mīne sīdan; and ne bēo þū ungelēaffull, ac gelēaffull.
text_bare: Syððan he sæde Thome, Do ðinne finger hider, and geseoh mine handa; and nim þine hand and do on mine sidan; and ne beo þu ungeleaffull, ac geleaffull.

text: Thomas andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þū eart mīn God and mīn Drihten.
text_bare: Thomas andswarode and cwæð to him, Þu eart min God and min Drihten.

text: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, þū gelyfdest for þām þū mē gesāwe; þā synt ēadige þe ne gesāwon, and gelȳfdon.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæð to him, þu gelyfdest for þam þu me gesawe; þa synt eadige þe ne gesawon, and gelyfdon.

text: Witodlīce manega ōðre tācen sē Hǣlend worhte on his leorningcnihta gesyhþe, þe ne synt on þysse bēc āwritene.
text_bare: Witodlice manega oðre tacen se Hælend worhte on his leorningcnihta gesyhþe, þe ne synt on þysse bec awritene.

text: Witodlīce þās þing synt āwritene þæt ge gelȳfon þæt sē Hǣlend ys Crīst, Godes Sunu; and þæt gē habbon ēce līf þonne gē gelȳfað on his naman.
text_bare: Witodlice þas þing synt awritene þæt ge gelyfon þæt se Hælend ys Crist, Godes Sunu; and þæt ge habbon ece lif þonne ge gelyfað on his naman.

text: Eft æfter þan sē Hǣlend hine geswutelode þus æt ðǣre Tiberiadiscan sǣ.
text_bare: Eft æfter þan se Hælend hine geswutelode þus æt ðære Tiberiadiscan sæ.

text: Simon Petrus and Thomas, ðe ys gecweden gelīcost, wǣron ætgædere, and Nathanael sē wæs of Chana Galilee, and Zebedeus suna, and ōðre twēgen þǣra leorningcnihta.
text_bare: Simon Petrus and Thomas, ðe ys gecweden gelicost, wæron ætgædere, and Nathanael se wæs of Chana Galilee, and Zebedeus suna, and oðre twegen þæra leorningcnihta.

text: Ðā cwæð Simon Petrus tō him, Ic wylle gān on fixað.
text_bare: Ða cwæð Simon Petrus to him, Ic wylle gan on fixað.

text: Þā cwǣdon hī tō him, And wē wyllað gān mid þē.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hi to him, And we wyllað gan mid þe.

text: And hī ēodon ūt, and ēodon on scip, and ne fēngon nān þing on þǣre nihte.
text_bare: And hi eodon ut, and eodon on scip, and ne fengon nan þing on þære nihte.

text: Witodlīce on ǣrne mergen sē Hǣlend stōd on þām strande; ne gecnēowon þēah ðā leorningcnihtas þæt hit sē Hǣlend wæs.
text_bare: Witodlice on ærne mergen se Hælend stod on þam strande; ne gecneowon þeah ða leorningcnihtas þæt hit se Hælend wæs.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Cnapan, cweðe gē hæbbe gē sufol?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Cnapan, cweðe ge hæbbe ge sufol?

text: Hig andswarodon him and cwǣdon, Nese.
text_bare: Hig andswarodon him and cwædon, Nese.

text: Hē cwæð tō him, Lǣtað þæt nett on þā swīðran healfe þæs rēwettes, and gē gemētað.
text_bare: He cwæð to him, Lætað þæt nett on þa swiðran healfe þæs rewettes, and ge gemetað.

text: Hig lēton witodlīce, and ne mihton hit ātēon for ðǣra fixa menigu.
text_bare: Hig leton witodlice, and ne mihton hit ateon for ðæra fixa menigu.

text: Witodlīce sē leorningcniht þe sē Hǣlend lufode cwæð tō Petre, Hit ys Drihten.
text_bare: Witodlice se leorningcniht þe se Hælend lufode cwæð to Petre, Hit ys Drihten.

text: Ðā Petrus gehȳrde þæt hit Drihten wæs, þā dyde hē on his tunecan, and begyrde hine, - witodlīce hē wæsæ ǣr nacod, - and scēt innan sǣ.
text_bare: Ða Petrus gehyrde þæt hit Drihten wæs, þa dyde he on his tunecan, and begyrde hine, - witodlice he wæsæ ær nacod, - and scet innan sæ.

text: Ðā ōðre leorningcnihtas rēowon þār tō, - hī wǣron unfeor fram lande, swylce hit wǣre twā hund elna, - and tugon hyra fiscnett.
text_bare: Ða oðre leorningcnihtas reowon þar to, - hi wæron unfeor fram lande, swylce hit wære twa hund elna, - and tugon hyra fiscnett.

text: Ðā hig on land ēodun, hī gesāwon licgan glēda, and fisc þǣr ofer, and hlāf.
text_bare: Ða hig on land eodun, hi gesawon licgan gleda, and fisc þær ofer, and hlaf.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Bringað þā fixas þe gē nū gefēngon.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Bringað þa fixas þe ge nu gefengon.

text: Simon Petrus ēode ūpp, and tēh his nett on land, micelra fixa full; þǣra wæs hundtēontig and ðrēo and fīftig; and ðā hyra swā fela wæs, næs þæt net tōbrocen.
text_bare: Simon Petrus eode upp, and teh his nett on land, micelra fixa full; þæra wæs hundteontig and ðreo and fiftig; and ða hyra swa fela wæs, næs þæt net tobrocen.

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gāð hider and etað.
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Gað hider and etað.

text: And nān þǣra þe þar sæt ne dorste hine āxian hwæt hē wǣre; hī wiston þæt hit wæs Drihten.
text_bare: And nan þæra þe þar sæt ne dorste hine axian hwæt he wære; hi wiston þæt hit wæs Drihten.

text: And sē Hǣlend cōm and nām hlāf, and eac fisc, and sealde him.
text_bare: And se Hælend com and nam hlaf, and eac fisc, and sealde him.

text: On ðyson wæs sē Hǣlend þrīwa geswutelud his leorningcnihton, þā hē ārās of dēaðe.
text_bare: On ðyson wæs se Hælend þriwa geswutelud his leorningcnihton, þa he aras of deaðe.

text: Ðā hī ǣton, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō Simone Petre, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē swīðor þænne ðās?
text_bare: Ða hi æton, þa cwæð se Hælend to Simone Petre, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðu me swiðor þænne ðas?

text: Hē cwæð tō him, Gēa, Drihten; þū wāst þæt ic þē lufige.
text_bare: He cwæð to him, Gea, Drihten; þu wast þæt ic þe lufige.

text: He cwæð tō him, Heald mīne lamb.
text_bare: He cwæð to him, Heald mine lamb.

text: Hē cwæð eft tō him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē?
text_bare: He cwæð eft to him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðu me?

text: Hē cwæð tō him, Gēa, Drihten; þū wast þæt ic ðē lufige.
text_bare: He cwæð to him, Gea, Drihten; þu wast þæt ic ðe lufige.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Heald mīne lamb.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, Heald mine lamb.

text: Hē cwæð þriddan sīðe tō him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē?
text_bare: He cwæð þriddan siðe to him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðu me?

text: Ðā wæs Petrus sārig for þām þe hē cwæð þriddan sīðe tō him, Lufast þū mē?
text_bare: Ða wæs Petrus sarig for þam þe he cwæð þriddan siðe to him, Lufast þu me?

text: And hē cwæð tō him, Drihten, þū wāst ealle þing; þū wast þæt ic þē lufige.
text_bare: And he cwæð to him, Drihten, þu wast ealle þing; þu wast þæt ic þe lufige.

text: Ðā cwæð hē tō him, Heald mīne scēap.
text_bare: Ða cwæð he to him, Heald mine sceap.

text: Sōð ic secge þē, þā þū gingra wǣre, þū gyrdest þē, and ēodest þǣr þū woldyst; witodlīce þonne þū ealdast, þū strecst þīne handa, and ōðer þē gyrt, and lǣt þyder þe þū nelt.
text_bare: Soð ic secge þe, þa þu gingra wære, þu gyrdest þe, and eodest þær þu woldyst; witodlice þonne þu ealdast, þu strecst þine handa, and oðer þe gyrt, and læt þyder þe þu nelt.

text: Ðæt hē sǣde witodlīce and tācnude hwylcon dēaðe hē wolde God geswuteligan.
text_bare: Ðæt he sæde witodlice and tacnude hwylcon deaðe he wolde God geswuteligan.

text: And þā hē þæt sǣde, þā cwæð hē tō him, Fylig mē.
text_bare: And þa he þæt sæde, þa cwæð he to him, Fylig me.

text: Ðā Petrus hine bewende, þā gesēah hē þæt sē leorningcniht him fylide þe sē Hǣlend lufode; sē þe hlinode on gebēorscipe ofer his brēost, and cwæð, Drihten, hwæt ys sē ðē belǣwð?
text_bare: Ða Petrus hine bewende, þa geseah he þæt se leorningcniht him fylide þe se Hælend lufode; se þe hlinode on gebeorscipe ofer his breost, and cwæð, Drihten, hwæt ys se ðe belæwð?

text: Witodlīce þā Petrus þysne gesēah, þā cwæð hē tō þām Hǣlende, Drihten, hwæt sceal þēs?
text_bare: Witodlice þa Petrus þysne geseah, þa cwæð he to þam Hælende, Drihten, hwæt sceal þes?

text: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gif ic wylle þæt hē wunige ðus oð ic cume, hwæt tō þē?
text_bare: Ða cwæð se Hælend to him, Gif ic wylle þæt he wunige ðus oð ic cume, hwæt to þe?

text: fylig ðū mē.
text_bare: fylig ðu me.

text: Witodlīce ðēos sprǣc cōm ūt gemang brōþrum, þæt sē leorningcniht ne swylt; and ne cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ne swylt hē; ac gif ic wylle þæt hē wunige oð ic cume, hwæt tō þē?
text_bare: Witodlice ðeos spræc com ut gemang broþrum, þæt se leorningcniht ne swylt; and ne cwæð se Hælend to him, Ne swylt he; ac gif ic wylle þæt he wunige oð ic cume, hwæt to þe?

text: Þis ys sē leorningcniht þe cȳð gewitnysse be þyson, and wrāt ðās þing; and wē witon þæt hys gewitnys ys sōð.
text_bare: Þis ys se leorningcniht þe cyð gewitnysse be þyson, and wrat ðas þing; and we witon þæt hys gewitnys ys soð.

text: Witodlīce ōðre manega þing synt þe sē Hǣlend worhte; gif ðā ealle āwritene wǣron, ic wēne ne mihte þēs middaneard ealle þā bēc befōn.
text_bare: Witodlice oðre manega þing synt þe se Hælend worhte; gif ða ealle awritene wæron, ic wene ne mihte þes middaneard ealle þa bec befon.

text: Amen.
text_bare: Amen.
